jobs.description:
Join the Intelance associate panel. The first engagement starts in late October 2026, subject to client approval.

Intelance is a UK advisory firm working on technology governance, cyber security and data governance. We are looking for an experienced data protection consultant to help a UK non-profit get the data protection terms for its online supply chain platform right. The platform has users in the UK, Europe, the US and Asia, including China. You will work with an Intelance engagement partner, and the client's own solicitors will approve the final legal wording.

Tasks

  • Review the data protection and security sections of the platform's terms of use, and redraft them so they are clear and consistent.

  • Set out the client's position as data controller when users in other countries can see data that is stored in the EU, and the safeguards it needs.

  • Check the supplier's data processing agreement against how the platform is really used.

  • Write plain English answers to the data protection questions that platform users keep asking.

  • Prepare a short list of points for the client's UK solicitor to confirm, and work alongside a law firm that is advising on China's data protection law.

  • Hand over cleanly to the Intelance colleague who will update the client's data security policy.

Requirements

  • 5 years or more working in data protection or privacy, as a consultant, data protection officer or in-house adviser.

  • Hands on experience of international data transfers under UK GDPR and EU GDPR, including Standard Contractual Clauses, the UK International Data Transfer Agreement or Addendum, and transfer risk assessments.

  • You have reviewed or drafted terms of use, data processing agreements or privacy notices for a software platform.

  • A recognised qualification such as CIPP/E or the BCS Practitioner Certificate in Data Protection.

  • You write short, clear documents that people outside legal and IT can act on.

  • Right to work in the UK, and able to work through your own limited company or as a self-employed contractor.

  • Desirable: working knowledge of China's Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL).

  • Desirable: experience with charities, standards or certification bodies, or supply chain platforms.

Benefits

  • Day rate of £500 to £625, depending on experience.

  • About 2 days of work over the first 2 weeks, with a short follow-up if the client's solicitor raises points.

  • Fully remote within the UK, with flexible hours.

  • Contract role through your own limited company or as a self-employed contractor. We expect it to fall outside IR35, and we confirm this before you start.

  • A place on the Intelance associate panel for future data governance work.

Apply with your CV and answer the short screening questions. It takes about five minutes.

We reply to every applicant within three working days. If you are shortlisted, you will have a 30 minute call with us. You join the panel once you sign our panel agreement and NDA. Please do not apply through an agency.

About Whiskey Cask Group

Whiskey Cask Group is a specialist Scotch whisky business focused on developing exclusive whisky products and bespoke bottling programmes for private clients, corporate customers and international brands.

Our services include private-label Scotch whisky, limited-edition bottlings, corporate gifting, exclusive cask projects and premium whisky collections.

We work with established industry partners to manage everything from whisky sourcing and product development to bottling, packaging and international delivery.

As we continue to expand, we are looking for an experienced whisky industry professional to help manage our commercial activities, develop new business opportunities and oversee the successful delivery of client projects.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced General Manager – Scotch Whisky Projects & Business Development to play a key role in growing Whiskey Cask Group.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining business development, project management, supplier relationships and general business operations.

We are particularly interested in candidates who already have extensive experience within the Scotch whisky industry and an established network of contacts across distilleries, independent bottlers, cask suppliers and specialist production partners.

The successful candidate will be comfortable managing the complete lifecycle of a whisky project, from identifying a commercial opportunity and developing a proposal through to coordinating production and final delivery.

This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for someone with genuine whisky industry knowledge who can combine commercial thinking with practical project delivery and operational management.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Commercial Growth

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with private clients, corporate customers, luxury brands and international partners.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients and commercial projects.
  • Develop proposals, commercial pricing and project budgets.
  • Manage client relationships from initial enquiry through to contract negotiation and delivery.
  • Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, new products and international expansion.
  • Support the directors in developing and implementing the company's commercial strategy.

Whisky Sourcing & Industry Relationships

  • Maintain and develop relationships with Scotch whisky distilleries, independent bottlers, cask brokers and suppliers.
  • Source appropriate whisky stocks and bottling solutions for bespoke client projects.

Desirable Experience

Location & Flexible Working

The IT Support Technician provides the first point of contact between internal staff and the Corporate IT department.   • Respond to P1 calls during regular business hours on weekdays as required

  • Strong experience working with ticketing and self-service platforms such as ServiceNow.

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. jobs.description:
As a Full Stack Senior Java Developer, you will design, develop, test, implement, and support enterprise‑grade applications within a fast‑paced banking and financial services environment. You will bring hands‑on expertise across the full technology stack, including front‑end development, backend services, API integrations, databases, cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and modern software engineering methodologies. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and fellow developers to deliver innovative technology solutions.

What You'll Do and How You'll Succeed

Software Development & Engineering

  • Design, develop, enhance, test, and maintain enterprise applications, web services, and system integrations.
  • Develop scalable client‑server applications, RESTful APIs, and microservices.
  • Build and support front‑end applications using modern web technologies and frameworks.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following established coding standards.
  • Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to software development best practices.
  • Troubleshoot, identify, and resolve application defects and production issues.
  • Develop and maintain system‑to‑system integrations and third‑party service integrations.

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Design application architectures ensuring scalability, high availability, security, and performance.
  • Create and maintain logical and physical data models across structured and unstructured data platforms.
  • Participate in technical design sessions and contribute to architecture decisions.
  • Develop technical specifications, design documents, and implementation guides.

DevOps & Cloud Engineering

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate deployments and improve release efficiency.
  • Implement DevOps best practices, automation frameworks, and infrastructure‑as‑code methodologies.
  • Deploy and support applications across cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Manage containerised environments using Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or similar technologies.
  • Support monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance optimisation initiatives.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Develop automated test scripts and frameworks to improve test coverage.
  • Execute unit, integration, system, and performance testing activities.
  • Identify opportunities for test automation and continuous quality improvement.
  • Document testing outcomes and support defect remediation activities.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Designers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand‑ups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement.
  • Support deployment, implementation, and production stabilisation activities.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to existing platforms.

We'd Love to Hear From You If...

Experience

  • You have strong experience in software development with Java, Scala, Python, C#, or C/C++.
  • You have experience with SQL, PL/SQL, Unix shell scripting, and XML.
  • You have experience developing RESTful APIs, web services, and full‑stack applications.
  • You have experience with middleware and messaging technologies such as IBM MQ, IBM WebSphere, or Open Message Queue.
  • You have experience with relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB).
  • You have experience deploying applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • You have experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, and container technologies.
  • You have experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git‑based source control, and DevOps workflows.
  • You have experience with Unix/Linux administration and troubleshooting.

Technical Expertise

  • You have backend expertise in Java, RESTful APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration technologies.
  • You have frontend expertise in JavaScript, AngularJS or modern frameworks, and ASP.NET MVC/Web API.
  • You have database expertise in Oracle, SQL Server, and DynamoDB, with strong data modelling and design skills.
  • You have cloud expertise in AWS, Azure, or GCP, with experience in containerisation and virtualisation technologies.
  • You have DevOps expertise in CI/CD pipeline implementation, automation tools, and monitoring platforms.
  • You have collaboration tool expertise in Jira, Confluence, and the Atlassian suite.

Ways of Working

  • You collaborate effectively with product, business, and technical teams.
  • You communicate clearly and document thoroughly.
  • You focus on delivering scalable, secure, and high‑performance applications.
  • You balance delivery timelines with technical excellence.

Required Qualifications

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline (equivalent work experience considered).
  • You have strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • You have excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
  • You have the ability to collaborate effectively within cross‑functional teams.
  • You have strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • You have the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • You have a continuous learning mindset with passion for emerging technologies.
  • You have sound judgment and decision‑making capabilities.
  • You have a customer‑focused and solution‑oriented approach.
  • You have high ethical standards and professional integrity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have experience within banking, financial services, or fintech environments.
  • You have experience building distributed and multi‑tier enterprise applications.
  • You have experience developing data pipelines and cloud‑native applications.
  • You have knowledge of software architecture and design patterns.
  • You have familiarity with SDLC, SCM, and secure software development practices.
  • You have experience with automated testing frameworks and test‑driven development (TDD).
  • You have exposure to Agile frameworks including Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe.

This is a remote position.

About LetsVenture :

Founded in 2013 LetsVenture is India's largest platform for early-stage investing and fundraising. LetsVenture is organizing India’s private market by making the process of fundraising easy, efficient and transparent for both start-ups and investors and bringing value-added products to the market. In the last 9 years, over 400 start-ups have raised $400mn across 527+ rounds with a total portfolio value of $3 billion and the platform has 10000+ Angel Investors from 60 countries, and 100 Micro VC Funds. LetsVenture is backed by Accel, Chiratae Ventures, Nandan Nilekani, Ratan Tata, Rishad Premji, Mohandas Pai, Sharad Sharma, Anupam Mittal. LetsVenture has partnered with MeitY Startup Hub to accelerate the growth of the start-up ecosystem in India.

About the Role :

We're looking for a strong frontend engineer who can contribute to our initial product, which is a web application. Our stack is Rails on the backend and React/Javascript on the front-end. This is an opportunity to have a big impact and get lots of ownership. We're looking for someone who thrives in the very early stages of a company and is self-driven.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver features in an end-to-end manner: technical design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Provide technical leadership and own specific areas of the LetsVenture platform.
  • Work closely with Product Managers to translate product requirements to engineering specifications.
  • Lead code review efforts and quality efforts in your area of ownership.
  • Participate in product discussions, taking ownership and initiative.
  • Work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years frontend development experience in a professional setting.
  • At least 1 year experience working in the React ecosystem
  • Should be comfortable converting mocks into high quality HTML/CSS
  • Must have an excellent understanding of how the web works.
  • Experience with responsive web design, media queries and delivering functionality that works with a range of client devices/browsers from desktops and laptops to mobile platforms.
  • Experience with UI design patterns, security, performance and usability.
  • Familiar with modern engineering practices: code reviews, continuous-deployment, automated testing.
  • Must be willing to constantly learn new things.
  • Passionate about joining a small team and building a company.

Nice to Haves :

  • A history of working on side/hobby projects and contributing to open source projects is a plus.
  • You've worked at a start-up before.

Lead Generation: Identify and engage potential customers through various channels, including digital marketing, social media, email campaigns, networking events, and direct outreach.

Data Analysis: Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer acquisition and outreach efforts, providing regular reports and insights to guide strategic decisions.

Collaboration: Work closely with the marketing and sales teams to align acquisition strategies with overall business objectives and maintain consistent messaging across all platforms.

Customer Onboarding: Oversee the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a positive experience that supports long-term relationships.

Budget Management: Manage acquisition budgets effectively, ensuring resources are allocated strategically to meet targets.

jobs.description:
The Vice President, Quality & Accreditation is the enterprise executive accountable for clinical quality performance across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial. This role owns HEDIS strategy and operations, accreditation (NCQA, URAC, and applicable state/federal standards), clinical quality programs, and the vendor ecosystem that supports HEDIS data collection, abstraction, and reporting.

This executive unifies quality functions historically siloed by line of business into a single operating model, ensuring consistent measurement, documentation, and improvement practices across Medicare and Commercial populations.

The role is accountable for HEDIS rates and audit results, accreditation status and survey outcomes, clinical quality program performance, and vendor ecosystem governance and cost.

Key Responsibilities:
Enterprise Quality Leadership & Operating Model
• Build a unified quality operating model across all lines of business, including Medicare and Commercial.
• Establish enterprise governance for clinical documentation integrity supporting quality measurement.
• Serve as the executive owner of enterprise HEDIS performance and accreditation status.
• Oversee all HEDIS operations, hybrid strategy, supplemental data, and provider documentation improvement, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Develop best-in-class intervention playbooks for each HEDIS measure.

Clinical Quality

  • Lead enterprise clinical quality programs, including quality improvement initiatives, clinical practice guideline adoption, and provider quality performance programs.
    • Ensure alignment with care management and population health functions on shared clinical priorities.
    • Partner with COO, CFO, Network, Pharmacy, Stars, Risk Adjustment, and Operations leadership to ensure quality initiatives are coordinated enterprise-wide without assuming accountability for their respective programs.
    Accreditation
    • Own enterprise accreditation strategy and execution, including NCQA Health Plan Accreditation, URAC, and other applicable state and federal accreditation or certification requirements.
    • Lead survey readiness, documentation, and corrective action planning for all accreditation activities.
    • Maintain accreditation standards as they evolve and ensure organizational readiness for renewal cycles.
    HEDIS Vendor Ecosystem Leadership
    • Serve as the executive owner of the vendor ecosystem supporting HEDIS data collection, medical record retrieval, abstraction, and supplemental data.
    • Consolidate and manage HEDIS vendors to reduce cost, improve data quality, and strengthen audit defensibility.
    • Establish unified SLAs, KPIs, and performance governance for HEDIS-related vendors.
    • Ensure vendors operate as extensions of the internal quality team.
    Quality Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting
    • Ensure data quality, timeliness, and integration across clinical, operational, and vendor systems supporting quality measurement.
    • In partnership with Health Services Analytics, build a unified reporting architecture for HEDIS, accreditation, and clinical quality programs.
    Governance & Compliance
    • Ensure compliance with NCQA, URAC, and applicable regulatory requirements governing quality and accreditation.
    • Lead enterprise audit readiness for HEDIS and accreditation surveys.
    • Establish governance structures for decision-making, escalation, and cross-functional alignment on quality matters.

Key Requirements:
• 10+ years of leadership experience in health plan Quality, HEDIS, and Accreditation, across Medicare and Commercial lines of business.
• Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, or related field preferred.
• Proven track record of improving HEDIS rates and achieving strong NCQA/URAC accreditation outcomes.
• Deep knowledge of HEDIS technical specifications, NCQA accreditation standards, and clinical quality improvement methodology.
• Experience leading large cross-functional teams and complex vendor ecosystems, particularly HEDIS data and abstraction vendors.
• Strong financial acumen, including forecasting, ROI analysis, and budget management.
• Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and drive enterprise-wide change.
• Master's degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, or related field preferred.

General Physical Demands: Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

What We Offer:

As a Florida Blue employee, you will thrive in our Be Well, Work Well, GuideWell culture where being well as an individual, and working well as a team, are both important in serving our members and communities.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
    • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
    • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
    • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
    • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
    • Additional voluntary benefits available; and

• A comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.title: Senior Managing Director, Healthcare Disputes & Economics, Payer/Provider
jobs.excerpt: Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.
jobs.description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.

Practice Overview:

Ankura’s Health Care team is a recognized leader in health care and life sciences disputes, compliance, and investigations. The team combines clinical, technical, operational, financial, economic, and analytic expertise to help clients and counsel resolve complex matters involving payers, providers, pharmacies, and law firms.

This role is specifically focused on expanding Ankura’s payer/provider disputes platform: matters where commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, exchange, and other health plan arrangements require rigorous data analytics and defensible damages analysis.

Role Overview:

The Senior Managing Director will be an executive-level, self-sustaining rainmaker who originates, sells, leads, and testifies in complex healthcare commercial disputes. The role requires a credible marketplace presence with health plans, law firms, and healthcare-focused private equity or strategic stakeholders.

  • Primary focus: payer/provider contract, payment, reimbursement, claims, coding, utilization, medical policy, network, and financial disputes.

  • Core technical differentiator: ability to direct large-scale data analytics teams and translate complex healthcare datasets into clear, supportable damages opinions.

  • Expected revenue impact: proven, tangible business development record with the ability to produce at least $3M in revenue and a target opportunity to generate $3M to $5M+ annually.

  • Expert role: serve as a consulting expert or testifying expert, including report development, deposition preparation, arbitration or trial testimony, and expert rebuttal work.

Target Candidate Profile:

  • Market position: Recognized rainmaker in healthcare disputes with established relationships among payer/provider counsel, managed care executives, provider finance leaders, and litigation decision-makers.

  • Dispute focus: Deep experience in payer/provider commercial disputes, including underpayment, overpayment, contract interpretation, rate methodology, coding, claim adjudication, stop-loss, risk adjustment, value-based care, network adequacy, medical necessity, utilization, denial, recoupment, and reimbursement disputes.

  • Data analytics leadership: Can lead multidisciplinary teams analyzing large claims, eligibility, encounter, remittance, contract, provider, authorization, utilization, coding, clinical, and financial datasets using scalable, quality-controlled analytics.

  • Damages expertise: Can develop defensible models for lost revenue, underpayment, overpayment, offsets, recoupments, interest, damages scenarios, counterfactuals, and sensitivity analyses.

  • Expert witness credibility: Has authored expert reports and provided deposition, arbitration, trial, or hearing testimony in healthcare disputes.

Responsibilities:

Business Development and Market Leadership

  • Originate and expand relationships with national and regional law firms, health plans, pharmacy organizations, and healthcare investors that routinely face payer/provider reimbursement and damages disputes.

  • Develop a go-to-market plan focused on payer/provider disputes where Ankura can combine healthcare industry expertise, advanced analytics, damages modeling, and expert testimony.

  • Build a visible marketplace presence through panels, publications, law firm briefings, client training, and industry events focused on managed care litigation, reimbursement disputes, and claims analytics.

  • Convert marketplace relationships into consulting expert, testifying expert, privileged advisory, and complex analytics engagements.

Technical and Disputes Expertise

  • Lead matters involving contract breaches, payment disputes, underpayment or overpayment claims, reimbursement methodology, fee schedules, DRG/APC/APG or other payment logic, risk corridors, value-based payment, capitation, shared savings, risk adjustment, denials, recoupments, and claims adjudication issues.

  • Apply knowledge of commercial, Medicare Advantage, Part D, Medicaid managed care, ACA exchange, pharmacy, and provider reimbursement operations when developing case strategy and damages approaches.

  • Assess liability and damages theories in collaboration with counsel while preserving attorney-client privilege, work-product protection, and expert independence where applicable.

  • Prepare expert reports, rebuttal reports, declarations, deposition testimony, arbitration testimony, trial testimony, and demonstratives that explain complex analytics in plain English.

Large-Scale Data Analytics and Damages

  • Direct data teams analyzing high-volume healthcare datasets, including claims, encounters, eligibility, premium, membership, remittance, EOB/EOP, authorization, denial, utilization, coding, provider contract, fee schedule, capitation, risk adjustment, and financial data.

  • Design repeatable analytic workplans that include data intake, normalization, validation, completeness testing, reconciliation, exception handling, sampling or extrapolation where appropriate, quality control, and audit trails.

  • Develop damages models that quantify alleged underpayments, overpayments, lost revenue, leakage, offsets, recoupment exposure, reasonable value, contract-based damages, and alternative damages scenarios.

  • Translate analytic findings into counsel-ready narratives, executive presentations, settlement support, mediation materials, expert reports, and trial or arbitration demonstratives.

  • Partner with data scientists, statisticians, coding experts, clinicians, economists, forensic accountants, and operations professionals to ensure analytic conclusions are technically sound and legally defensible.

Client Delivery and Team Leadership

  • Serve as the accountable executive on complex, multi-workstream matters with law firm, payer, provider, and board-level stakeholders.

  • Scope and price engagements, staff teams, manage budgets, review work product, ensure quality, and deliver concise insights under litigation deadlines.

  • Mentor directors, managing directors, analytics professionals, clinicians, coders, and operational specialists, with a focus on developing future testifying experts and client-facing leaders.

  • Collaborate across Ankura practices, including Health Economics, Data Analytics including AI, Strategy and Performance, Forensic Accounting, Investigations, and other dispute capabilities.

Relevant Matter Experience

  • Payer/provider contract disputes involving alleged underpayment, denial, repricing, reimbursement methodology, rate implementation, or recoupment issues.

  • Managed care disputes involving Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, ACA exchange, commercial group, self-funded, pharmacy, or delegated-risk arrangements.

  • Large-scale claims and encounter analytics supporting affirmative damages, rebuttal damages, settlement valuation, mediation, arbitration, or trial.

  • Hospital, physician, ancillary, pharmacy, behavioral health, and specialty provider reimbursement disputes.

  • Matters requiring expert reports, rebuttal analyses, deposition testimony, arbitration testimony, or trial testimony.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in business, finance, accounting, economics, data analytics, health care operations, health policy, clinical discipline, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

  • 10+ years of litigation, disputes, forensic, damages, payer/provider reimbursement, managed care, healthcare analytics, or consulting experience; senior consulting leadership experience strongly preferred.

  • Proven and tangible business development record with a portable book of relationships and revenue generation of at least $3M; demonstrated ability to grow toward $3M to $5M+ annually.

  • Specific experience originating and leading payer/provider commercial disputes, reimbursement disputes, managed care litigation, claims analytics, damages quantification, or expert witness engagements.

  • Demonstrated ability to direct large project teams analyzing complex healthcare datasets and producing quality-controlled analytic outputs for counsel, executives, and triers of fact.

  • Experience authoring expert reports, rebuttal reports, declarations, affidavits, or damages analyses; prior deposition, arbitration, trial, or hearing testimony strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare legal, regulatory, reimbursement, and operational issues affecting payers, providers, pharmacies, and government program participants.

  • Exceptional executive communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical, analytic, reimbursement, and damages issues to boards, C-suite clients, law firms, regulators, mediators, arbitrators, judges, and juries.

  • Demonstrated commitment to privilege, confidentiality, work-product discipline, expert independence, collaboration, quality, and team development.

  • Ability and willingness to travel; must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Position Summary

The Epilepsy Foundation is seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Senior Manager of Contracts and Procurement with deep experience in government grant compliance, contract negotiation, procurement, and regulatory reporting within the nonprofit sector.

This role is responsible for overseeing the organization’s contracts and procurement functions while ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local requirements, including the Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act (FFATA), Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), and applicable state charitable registration requirements.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience navigating complex regulatory requirements, managing high-stakes contracts and agreements, and partnering across departments to mitigate organizational risk and ensure compliance. This position will serve as a key subject matter expert on grant-related procurement, contracting, and regulatory obligations while supporting the Foundation’s mission and organizational priorities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Contracts & Procurement Management: Execute and oversee the end-to-end contracts and procurement function, with a strong focus on regulatory compliance for federally and state-funded grants.
  • Federal Grant Compliance: Ensure organizational adherence to federal grant requirements, including FFATA reporting, Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), cost principles, procurement standards, and other applicable requirements.
  • Contract Development & Negotiation: Lead the review, drafting, negotiation, and administration of contracts, memoranda of understanding (MOUs), subrecipient agreements, cooperative agreements, and vendor contracts.
  • Charitable Registration Compliance: Coordinate state charitable solicitation registrations, renewals, and related compliance requirements across applicable jurisdictions.
  • Policies & Procedures: Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve procurement and contracting policies and procedures that align with nonprofit best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Grant & Funder Requirements: Monitor and report on compliance with funder-specific procurement requirements, contractual obligations, and reporting requirements.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the organization’s subject matter expert on grant-related procurement, contracting requirements, and regulatory obligations.

ChildFund Australia is a member of the ChildFund Alliance – a global network of 10 organisations which assists almost 36 million children and their families in 66 countries. ChildFund Australia directly manages and implements programs with a range of local partners in Cambodia, Myanmar, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste, Vietnam, and other Pacific nations, and manages projects delivered by partner organisations throughout Asia, Africa, and the Americas.

Purpose

ChildFund seeks to strengthen its existing participation approach so that stakeholders can engage with, validate, challenge, and enrich the findings of Child Rights Situation Analyses, helping to identify priority issues, emerging trends, evidence gaps, and opportunities for action. The resulting insights will inform organisational strategy, country planning, program portfolios, advocacy priorities, and investment decisions, ensuring that these are grounded not only in published evidence but also in the perspectives and experiences of children and communities themselves.

This assignment will develop practical guidelines, tools, and supporting resources that enable this process to be undertaken consistently across country contexts. The approach should be low burden, repeatable, and designed to leverage existing community engagement structures wherever possible, recognising the capacity constraints facing Country Offices and partners. It should also promote accountability by establishing clear mechanisms for reporting back on how participant feedback influenced findings, priorities, and subsequent decisions.

The consultant will also provide technical advice on the role of Youth Voice in ChildFund’s strategy development and broader strategic decision-making, including its evolving purpose, Terms of Reference, engagement processes and feedback mechanisms.

The consultancy period is 20 days spread across 3 months.

Interested consultants should submit an expression of interest including: a technical proposal (max. 3 pages) outlining understanding of the assignment, proposed search strategy and sources, and workplan; a financial proposal/fee schedule in USD; a curriculum vitae including at least two references from similar assignments; and a sample of previous, similar written work.

ChildFund Australia believes in a global community where children are safe and can reach their full potential. We take extensive steps to safeguard children in any work done by our people, i.e., our staff, volunteers and interns, supporters, partners, board members, ambassadors and suppliers. We strive to keep children safe through child safe practices, and rigorously ensure we prevent, oppose, and combat all exploitation and abuse of children and vulnerable people. As part of this commitment, all people working with us will undergo relevant background checks before joining ChildFund Australia.

At ChildFund Australia, all staff must remain alert and responsive to any child safeguarding or sexual exploitation, abuse, or harassment (SEAH) risks. Staff will acquire the knowledge and skills needed to understand our Child Safeguarding and PSEAH policies & procedures, promote strong safeguarding practices, and conduct themselves consistent with these policies.

In line with our values, diversity of people and ideas is critical to our work and our success at ChildFund Australia. We strive for a team culture that is welcoming, inclusive, and supportive. We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

Job Title: Sales Representative – Infectious Disease I Region Bayreuth, Regensburg,

Über Abbott

Abbott ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen, das bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse nutzt und Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Gesundheit der Menschen entwickelt. Wir blicken stets in die Zukunft und antizipieren Veränderungen in der medizinischen Wissenschaft und Technologie.

In Deutschland ist Abbott mit mehr als 4.000 Mitarbeiter:innen in den Bereichen Forschung und Entwicklung, Logistik, Produktion und Vertrieb vertreten. Neben dem deutschen Hauptsitz in Wiesbaden hat Abbott Standorte in Hannover, Neustadt am Rübenberge, Wetzlar, Eschborn, Jena, Köln und Hamburg.

 

Die Position

Die Position wird an unserem Standort Köln (Abbott Rapid Diagnostics Germany GmbH) im Bereich Infectious Diseases angegliedert und für die Region Bayreuth, Regensburg, Rosenheimverantwortlich sein.

Unser Point-of-Care-Diagnoseportfolio umfasst wichtige Gesundheits- und Therapiebereiche, darunter Infektionskrankheiten, kardiometabolische und Toxikologie.

Unsere diagnostischen Lösungen werden in Krankenhäusern, Laboren und Kliniken rund um den Globus eingesetzt. Die entscheidenden Informationen, die aus unseren Tests, Instrumenten und Informatiksystemen gewonnen werden, sind oft der erste Schritt bei der Entscheidungsfindung in der Patientenversorgung für Hunderte von Gesundheitszuständen, von Herzinfarkten über Blutkrankheiten bis hin zu Infektionskrankheiten und Krebs.

Unsere schnellen Diagnoselösungen tragen dazu bei, einige der größten Herausforderungen der Welt im Gesundheitswesen zu bewältigen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung der Vertriebsziele sowie der kommerziellen Planung zur nachhaltigen Erreichung der Leistungsziele in Ihrer Region
  • Aktive Marktbearbeitung und Kundenentwicklung mit Fokus auf Neukundengewinnung sowie langfristige Betreuung und Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen

  • Beobachtung, Analyse und Reporting von Wettbewerbsaktivitäten, inkl. Ableitung geeigneter Vertriebs‑ und Marktstrategien
  • Durchführung von Produktschulungen, Produktdemonstrationen und Implementierungen bei Kunden vor Ort in der Region
  • Repräsentation von Abbott auf nationalen und internationalen Kongressen, Messen und Fachveranstaltungen

Erforderliche Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Naturwissenschaften, alternativ eine medizinische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung im Bereich Diagnostik
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke sowie sicheres Auftreten gegenüber klinischen Ansprechpartnern
  • Hohe Überzeugungskraft und Fähigkeit, nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln
  • Ergebnisorientierte, strukturierte und resiliente Arbeitsweise in einem dynamischen Umfeld
  • Stark ausgeprägte Problemlösungs- und Kundenorientierung
  • Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit hoher Eigeninitiative, Energie und Begeisterungsfähigkeit
  • Sehr gute Organisations‑, Präsentations‑ und Moderationsfähigkeiten
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft (ca. 70–80 %) innerhalb des Vertriebsgebiets
  • Fließende Deutsch - sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb der Medizintechnik‑, Diagnostik‑ oder Pharmaindustrie
  • Gutes Verständnis des Secondary‑Care‑ bzw. Klinikmarktes
  • Unternehmerisches Mindset, Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit in einem sich wandelnden Marktumfeld

  • Fähigkeit, Kundenbedarfe und Geschäftspotenziale klar zu analysieren, zu adressieren und in langfristige strategische Partnerschaften zu überführen – auch mit Kunden von nationaler Bedeutung

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann bewerben Sie sich bei uns.  

Wir freuen uns auf Sie! 

Arbeiten bei Abbott

Bei Abbott finden Sie eine Aufgabe, die wirklich zählt, denn Sie verhelfen anderen Menschen zu einem gesünderen und erfüllten Leben. Wachsen Sie mit uns und lernen Sie stetig dazu – Sie können hier Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung vorantreiben und sich selbst verwirklichen.

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

jobs.description:
Vaan is a Shopify Platinum design & technology agency and the home of Brand Conversion Design.

We migrate, design, and build high performing eCommerce experiences leveraging our Brand Conversion Design framework, industry partnerships & deep eCommerce technical expertise. Solving the tension between optimization and design, we help brands make the most of their eCommerce.

About the role

Vaan partners with direct-to-consumer and B2B brands from $5M to $1B in GMV, across new builds, platform migrations, and ongoing optimization retainers. Our work spans development, design, A/B testing, and strategic roadmapping in one of the fastest-moving platform environments in commerce.

The Solutions Strategist sits between client understanding and technical execution. This is not a developer role and does not require one. It requires someone who can walk into a complex merchant environment, understand how systems connect, identify friction, and turn that into a requirements picture engineering and design can build against.

We value specificity over generalism, forward-thinking over comfort with the status quo, and partners over vendors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery for new engagements, migrations, and major projects, surfacing the requirements others miss
  • Run structured sessions with client stakeholders across technical, marketing, and ops functions, and turn what surfaces into documentation the full team can act on
  • Translate ambiguous business needs into scoped functional and technical requirements, including an explicit account of what is out of scope and why
  • Decompose requirements into epics and stories an engineer can pick up without a follow-up conversation, working alongside the Product Owner to keep the backlog accurate as the engagement moves
  • Maintain the requirements record page by page and section by section, covering features and functions, metafields, and the apps in play, with every line traceable to scope
  • Work with Tech Leads to document architecture, data flows, and business rules, and to validate feasibility and scope before requirements become commitments
  • Build and maintain the discovery frameworks and templates the rest of the team works from
  • Translate what a client asks for into what they actually need, then identify the tool that serves it, with reasoning legible to the client, engineering, and the account team
  • Maintain working awareness of what is already implemented across our portfolio, so recommendations build on existing stack decisions instead of duplicating or contradicting them
  • Evaluate third-party tools across loyalty, search, reviews, personalization, subscriptions, and headless commerce, knowing each category well enough to ask the right questions and judge honestly
  • Recognize when someone else on the team knows a tool better than you, and pull them in early
  • Track Shopify platform updates, deprecations, and roadmap signals, and translate what changes into client guidance
  • Advise on stack composition with a focus on long-term maintainability, scalability, and cost
  • Map complex client environments across ERPs, PIMs, OMS platforms, CRM systems, and marketing stacks, including how they connect and where Shopify fits
  • Identify integration requirements, data flows, and failure points before they become project risks
  • Audit existing Shopify implementations for technical debt, architectural gaps, and unused platform capability, and articulate what should change and why
  • Understand how AI works inside the apps our clients already run. Most of the ecosystem is adding AI features across search, merchandising, personalization, support, and retention. The question is never whether the feature exists. It is whether turning it on moves a business objective this client actually has
  • Hold a working read on where AI creates genuine value in ecommerce and where it is noise, and be able to explain the difference to a client without hedging
  • Identify where AI-enabled tooling could improve conversion, retention, or operational efficiency for a client, and build the case
  • Use AI in your own delivery work: drafting specs, scripting audits, analyzing rulesets, reconciling data, roughing out wireframes to move a conversation along
  • Work as a peer to Growth Strategists. You are the reason a commercially attractive roadmap item is deliverable, or the reason it gets reshaped before it is promised to a client
  • Contribute technical context to scoping and estimation that makes the numbers more accurate
  • Keep engineering, design, and the account team working from the same requirements picture, and surface the conflict early when they are not

Qualifications

  • A track record of picking the right tool for a specific client context and being able to defend the choice to both the client and the engineers who have to live with it
  • Working familiarity with Shopify Plus across admin, metafields, theme architecture, and B2B, enough to reason about what is possible without needing to build it
  • Understanding of headless and composable architectures, and of when they are the wrong call
  • Comfort saying you do not know a tool well, and a habit of finding the person who does
  • A track record of leading discovery on complex digital projects, with documentation habits that survive contact with a deadline
  • Ability to run stakeholder sessions that surface the real requirements, meaning what clients actually need rather than what they say they want
  • Experience writing requirements engineering can execute against with minimal ambiguity, and breaking them down to a granularity a developer can pick up
  • Experience holding requirements for several clients at once without context bleeding between them
  • Exposure to platform migration from Magento, BigCommerce, or Salesforce Commerce Cloud to Shopify Plus
  • Working comfort in Figma or FigJam, Jira, and Excel. You don't need mastery. You should be able to run a session on a canvas, author a story, and keep a structured requirements sheet clean
  • Experience evaluating AI features inside tools a merchant already pays for, rather than only standalone AI products, and judging whether switching one on is worth the change
  • Comfort with rapid change. You update your position when the evidence warrants it, and you say so out loud
  • Confident in client-facing environments, able to ask hard questions diplomatically and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Able to propose a compromise a client will accept, an engineer will respect, and the account team can still deliver inside the SOW
  • Strong written communication. Your requirements documents, briefs, and follow-ups are clear and trusted by the people who use them

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

iTech AG is seeking a ServiceNow FSM Practice Lead to establish and run the Field Service Management (FSM) practice within our Solutions organization. This is a senior player-coach role with a dual mandate: serve as the principal solution architect on the Intelas Next Generation Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) program — a commercial healthcare engagement delivered for Intelas (a Compass Group USA company) — while owning the technical direction, delivery standards, and reusable capability for FSM across iTech AG's entire portfolio of Field Service Management work.

The ideal candidate is a true ServiceNow architect who has implemented FSM end-to-end — from solution and data model design through dispatch, mobile, customer portals, parts/inventory, and integrations — and has since taken technical ownership across more than one engagement, directing and mentoring other architects and developers. They are equally credible in a client design workshop, in a pursuit shaping scope and level of effort, and hands-on in the platform building the hardest components. Experience in an asset-intensive field service setting is expected; healthcare, clinical/medical device (biomed/imaging), or CMMS/EAM depth is strongly preferred.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the technical owner of ServiceNow Field Service Management across all iTech AG FSM engagements — setting the solution standards, reference architectures, and design patterns that every FSM project follows
  • Provide architectural quality assurance and delivery oversight across the FSM portfolio: design and code reviews, project health checks, and escalation support on at-risk engagements
  • Build and maintain the practice's reusable assets — accelerators, scoped applications, integration patterns, demo environments, estimating models, and delivery playbooks — so each new FSM engagement starts further along
  • Act as the FSM technical lead on business development pursuits: qualify opportunities, shape the solution, run technical discovery and client workshops, size level of effort and staffing, and contribute to proposals, orals, and client demonstrations
  • Partner with Business Development and Solutions leadership on FSM offering development, go-to-market positioning, and capture strategy for field service and asset-intensive opportunities
  • Set technical direction for FSM architects, developers, and consultants firm-wide in a matrixed model — defining skill and certification expectations, mentoring the team, and leading the technical evaluation of FSM candidates during hiring
  • Advise on FSM staffing and resource allocation across engagements in partnership with sector delivery leads and the weekly resourcing process
  • Own FSM enablement and capability growth — certification paths, training plans, and knowledge sharing across the broader ServiceNow team
  • Track the ServiceNow FSM and EAM product roadmap and new release capabilities, and translate them into iTech AG offerings and client roadmaps
  • Support the ServiceNow partner relationship for FSM — product specializations, partner enablement, partner-tier advancement, and joint pursuit activity
  • Contribute delivery estimates, staffing plans, and technical risk assessments that inform pricing and margin on FSM work
  • Other duties as assigned

As the principal architect on the Intelas NextGen CMMS program, the role's anchor engagement, the FSM Practice Lead will:

  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture for the Intelas NextGen CMMS on ServiceNow FSM, including solution design, data model, and the phased roadmap across modules
  • Define the multi-product ServiceNow architecture spanning FSM, Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)/CMDB, Customer Service Management (CSM)/Service Portal, Virtual Agent, IntegrationHub, and AI/Now Assist
  • Author and maintain the Technical Solution Document (TSD) — architecture diagrams, data model, integration patterns, and security model — and drive architecture decisions and approvals each sprint
  • Architect and lead the implementation of ServiceNow FSM capabilities across the solution, including:
    • Work Order Management
    • Task Management
    • Scheduling and Dispatch
    • Mobile Workforce Enablement
    • Customer Communication and Self-Service
    • Inventory and Asset Management
    • Route Optimization and Resource Coordination
  • Define configuration standards and the design for digital work orders, field tasks, assignment rules, dispatch queues, and workflow automations
  • Develop and support task bundling, questionnaires, inspection checklists, and compliance verification workflows
  • Configure the work order lifecycle and dispatch model to Intelas' operating rules, including:
    • Work order lifecycle configuration
    • Automated skills-based dispatch is the system of record; manual reassignment is supported as an exception workflow, with dispatch logic and assignment rules
    • Technician Skills & Certifications (eQMS data usage)
    • Onsite/Offsite & Work Hours
    • User Types (e.g., biomed, imaging, cyber, apprentice, intern, etc.)
    • Customer Satisfaction/Preferences by Technician
    • Technician skills and availability, and scheduling setup
    • Overtime Approval Process
    • Technician Manager Discretion
    • First In/First Out, Priority/Impact
    • Workload of technician
    • Travel required?
    • Customer-facing output artifacts, including downloadable PDF work order packets for customer access and audit purposes
  • Support customer-initiated service requests, appointment booking, ticket visibility, and scheduling preferences (including preferred/favorite technicians) through the Service Portal and/or UI Builder
  • Configure route optimization and travel efficiency capabilities for field crews and technicians
  • Design, develop, and support mobile field service experiences including offline functionality and mobile work execution
  • Configure time tracking, labor tracking, and field activity reporting capabilities
  • Support collaboration features including chat, file sharing, and communication between dispatchers and field personnel
  • Configure proactive customer communications including ETA notifications, appointment reminders, and job status updates
  • Develop external customer-facing portals and web-embedded Virtual Agent experiences enabling service request submission, ticket visibility, role-based access, and downloadable PDF work order packets for customer and audit purposes
  • Support inventory and asset management capabilities including:
    • Warehouse inventory visibility
    • Truck stock inventory tracking
    • Consumable and parts usage logging
    • Automated inventory adjustments based on field usage
  • Design and govern the integration architecture between ServiceNow FSM/EAM and external systems including OneSource OEM manuals, Asimly utilization data, Vizzia/Intelligent Locations RFID/RTLS, FedEx/UPS shipment tracking, FDA & recall vendors, customer SSO, and the Snowflake data warehouse
  • Support Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) configuration and data migration — asset hierarchy and classes, preventive maintenance (monthly/quarterly), parts/inventory, and migration of data tables, PMs, and checklists from teamCHAMPS/Nuvolo into ServiceNow
  • Support Clinical Device Management (CDM) workflows and AI-assisted use cases such as recommended repair and skills-based routing as defined in the approved Technical Solution Document (TSD)
  • Establish development standards and hands-on build the most complex components — custom applications, workflows, business rules, UI policies, integrations, and Flow Designer automations
  • Partner with iTech Master Architects (Dustin Barre, Allen Andreas) and the Solution SME on cross-product architecture and technical governance
  • Participate in Agile / Now Create ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives, and contribute to Technical Solution Document (TSD) updates each sprint
  • Lead code and design reviews, mentor developers, and enforce platform best practices and technical governance
  • Support platform upgrades, patching, and performance optimization activities
  • Troubleshoot and resolve FSM defects, mobile issues, and production support requests
  • Ensure configurations and customizations align with Intelas data governance, quality/compliance (e.g., Joint Commission, eQMS, CAPA), and platform security requirements
  • Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness activities
  • Support organizational change management and end-user adoption efforts for FSM capabilities
  • Other duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience, including 5+ years in a ServiceNow architect or technical lead role
  • 4+ years architecting or leading ServiceNow Field Service Management (FSM) implementations end-to-end, including more than one full-lifecycle or green-field FSM implementation
  • Proven experience delivering FSM end-to-end with integrations spanning multiple ServiceNow products (e.g., FSM, EAM/CMDB, CSM/Service Portal, Virtual Agent, IntegrationHub)
  • Deep architecture and hands-on experience across:
    • Work Order and Task Management
    • Scheduling and Dispatch
    • Mobile Workforce Applications
    • Inventory and Asset Tracking
    • Customer Communication and Self-Service
  • Experience configuring ServiceNow Mobile applications and offline capabilities
  • Experience with integrations between ServiceNow and external enterprise systems
  • Strong experience defining ServiceNow data models, CMDB, security models, and overall platform architecture
  • Proficiency with ServiceNow scripting including JavaScript, Glide APIs, Script Includes, and Flow Designer
  • Experience designing integration architecture using IntegrationHub and REST/SOAP APIs, and leading FSM/EAM data migration
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments (ServiceNow Now Create methodology a plus)
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
  • Experience leading, mentoring, and setting technical direction for architects and developers across Agile delivery teams
  • Demonstrated experience as the senior technical authority across more than one concurrent engagement or account — setting standards, reviewing others' designs, and serving as the escalation point on delivery risk
  • Demonstrated pre-sales and business development support experience: technical discovery, solution shaping, level-of-effort and staffing estimates, and contribution to written proposals, orals, or client demonstrations
  • Experience developing technical talent — mentoring, certification planning, and technical interviewing or skills assessment
  • Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to present solution architecture, delivery risk, and roadmap trade-offs to client executives and internal leadership

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) – Field Service Management (FSM) required, or obtained within 90 days of hire
  • Multiple ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications across products (e.g., CSM, ITSM, Discovery) in addition to CIS–FSM
  • ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA) a plus; candidates not yet certified are expected to pursue an expert-level credential

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting healthcare, clinical/medical device, biomedical engineering, or other asset-intensive (CMMS/EAM) operations — including utilities, manufacturing, transportation/dealer service, or federal field operations
  • Experience with Indoor mapping
  • Experience implementing enterprise field service operations, workforce coordination, or logistics management solutions
  • Familiarity with asset lifecycle management, warehouse operations, and inventory tracking processes
  • Experience integrating FSM/EAM solutions with OEM manual systems, RFID/RTLS, shipping carriers, recall feeds, or data warehouses (Snowflake)
  • Strong experience with Service Portal, UI Builder, and mobile-first user experience design
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow data model, CMDB relationships, and platform performance optimization
  • Experience with ServiceNow Now Create methodology and IntegrationHub-based integrations
  • Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration skills
  • Experience supporting field operations in healthcare, biomedical/clinical engineering, facilities, or asset-intensive service organizations
  • Familiarity with Nuvolo, teamCHAMPS, or other CMMS/EAM platforms and associated data migration
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow Virtual Agent and AI / Now Assist capabilities
  • Experience building or leading a ServiceNow practice, capability, or center of excellence within a consulting or systems integrator environment
  • Experience delivering in a professional services model with billable utilization targets and multiple concurrent clients
  • Experience with ServiceNow partner programs, product specializations, partner enablement, and partner-tier advancement
  • Experience delivering ServiceNow in federal, state, or local government environments in addition to commercial work, including FedRAMP-authorized instances
  • Depth in ServiceNow Hardware and Software Asset Management (HAM/SAM) as a complement to EAM/CMMS operational asset management

BACKGROUND / ELIGIBILITY

  • Ability to pass standard pre-employment and any customer-required healthcare background checks

PAY INFORMATION

The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $200,000 - 250,000. The final salary offered will be determined on a variety of factors, including the selected candidate's qualifications, experience, education, skills, internal equity, and market considerations, as well as contract specific affordability and organizational requirements. Mindoula Health’s Collaborative Care Program (CCP) is expanding in Oregon. Our mission is to improve quality of life for patients living with behavioral health challenges and chronic medical conditions. We do this by embedding behavioral health into primary care so patients receive coordinated, effective care without barriers.

The Behavioral Health Integration Clinician is a central member of a patient’s collaborative care team. The core team includes the patient’s medical provider and psychiatric consultant. The Behavioral Health Integration Clinician is responsible for providing high quality and evidence based patient support by performing individual assessment and development of treatment plans, providing psychotherapy, coordinating the community and the mental and physical health care of patients on an assigned patient caseload.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Screen and assess patients for mental health and substance abuse disorders. Facilitate patient engagement, treatment plans, and follow-up care.
  • Provide brief behavioral interventions using evidence-based techniques such as behavioral activation, problem-solving treatment, motivational interviewing, or other treatments as appropriate supported by the clinical technology software.
  • Support psychotropic medication management as prescribed by medical providers, focusing on treatment adherence monitoring, side effects, and effectiveness of treatment.
  • Provide health behavior and social determinants of health interventions to improve functioning and improvements in medical outcomes.
  • Systematically track treatment response and monitor patients (in person, video or by telephone) for changes in clinical symptoms and treatment side effects or complications.
  • Provide patient education about common mental health and substance abuse disorders and the available treatment options.
  • Provide or facilitate in-clinic or outside referrals to evidence-based psychosocial treatments (e.g. problem-solving treatment or behavioral activation) as clinically indicated.
  • Participate in regularly scheduled (usually weekly) caseload consultation with the psychiatric consultant and communicate resulting treatment recommendations to the patient’s medical provider.
  • Track patients follow up and clinical outcomes using the EHR. Document in-person, video and telephone encounters in the EHR and use the system and established clinical workflows to identify and re-engage patients.
  • Document patient progress and treatment recommendations in EHR and other required systems to be shared with medical providers, psychiatric consultants, and other treating providers.
  • Facilitate treatment plan changes for patients who are not improving as expected in consultation with the medical provider and the psychiatric consultant and who may need more intensive or more specialized mental health care.
  • Actively participate in process improvement by identifying areas of inefficiency and contributes to opportunities for enhancement.
  • Attend meetings and complete therapy primary by video conference with periodic (approximately once a month) visits in person to clinics to connect with the clinicians and administrators to ensure collaborative workflows are in place.
  • Clinician will be expected to meet performance metrics each month as determined by the clinical manager and clinical director.

Requirements:

  • A minimum of a master’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, Counseling, Rehabilitation, or other relevant field.
  • 3-5+ years of experience in behavioral health intervention clinical work, case management, and/or community care coordination.
  • Working with various populations, including older adult Medicare populations, who have chronic medical and behavioral health challenges.
  • Active independent clinical license in Oregon. Eligible licenses include:
    • Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
    • Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC)
    • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
    • Licensed Psychologist
  • Current enrollment in the state’s Medicaid & Medicare is preferred but eligibility is required.
  • The position is hybrid with the many of services provided telephonically or via video. High speed home internet is required.
  • Must be proficient in utilizing electronic health records (EHR), scheduling systems, remote phone systems and video systems.

Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Pacific Time

Setting: Remote, must be located in United States. Some travel to Oregon will be required.
