We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems.
  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.
  • Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions.
  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.
  • Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership.
  • Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity.

Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with a long-term perspective.
  • Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery.
  • The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • Varied projects with practical business impact.
  • Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work.

Please submit your CV and a short overview of:

  • A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results.
  • A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures.
  • A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed.
  • A project you managed or a team you led or mentored.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential information or credentials.

Job Description

You will work closely with other members of the Information Security team to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities and develop strategies and solutions to mitigate these risks, securing the end-user device estate and the mobile platforms through which the enterprise increasingly operates, and contributing to our overall information security strategy.

This position can be virtual anywhere in the U.S.

You will join the Business Technology Solutions (BTS) Information Security and Risk Management (ISRM) Architecture organization. Our team translates business objectives and cyber risk strategy into concrete security measures — processes, technologies, and services — across a diverse and complex infrastructure landscape, including on-premises, cloud, and X-as-a-Service models.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and evaluate security architecture for the end-user device estate — workstation and laptop hardening, EDR/endpoint protection (e.g., CrowdStrike, Defender), data protection, and configuration baselines.

  • Perform Security Architecture Reviews — adjudicate submissions, align the risk and controls with the system owner, and ensure review quality.
  • Deliver Security Architecture Consulting engagements with business partners — own each engagement end to end, with timely turnaround and clear customer communication.
  • Provide Risk Evidence Review on request, partnering with Risk Management to evaluate control and mitigation effectiveness for risk owners.
  • Plan, design, build, and implement enterprise security architecture, and create relevant documentation of same.
  • Evaluate security technologies and controls across the environment — including those employed by third-party providers — developing strategies, determining which controls fit a given situation, and adapting them to business needs, risk, and the threat landscape.
  • Identify and communicate current and emerging security threats and risks; design security architecture elements and propose new or revised measures to mitigate them as they emerge.
  • Help develop solutions that balance information security needs with the needs of the business, in collaboration with team members and business and IT stakeholders.

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

jobs.description:
Payroll Supervisor (Full-Time, Remote)

Remote — United States | Full-Time | $65,000 – $70,000 / year

Ensemble Performing Arts is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and people-focused Payroll Supervisor to join our Finance team and lead payroll operations across our growing portfolio of performing arts businesses. This role oversees the payroll team, ensures accurate and timely processing across multiple pay schedules, and safeguards payroll reporting and regulatory compliance.

This is the right fit for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment, enjoys coaching a team, and takes pride in maintaining accuracy and compliance in payroll operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership
    • Supervise and develop payroll coordinators, setting priorities and workloads around each pay cycle
    • Review work for accuracy, provide regular feedback, and conduct performance reviews
    • Serve as the escalation point for complex payroll issues, employee inquiries, and manager questions
    • Oversee the payroll group inbox to ensure timely, accurate responses
  • Payroll Processing
    • Oversee end-to-end processing of weekly, biweekly, and semi-monthly payrolls for hourly and salaried employees
    • Review timekeeping data, overtime, shift differentials, bonuses, commissions, and retro adjustments before each run
    • Approve payroll registers, resolve discrepancies, and release payments, including direct deposits, paper checks, and off-cycle payments
    • Process garnishments, child support orders, and other deductions accurately and on schedule
    • Ensure timely, accurate processing of adjustments and final pay
  • Reporting & Reconciliation
    • Reconcile payroll to the general ledger and coordinate with Accounting on journal entries and accruals
    • Prepare payroll reports, such as labor cost, headcount, and overtime, for Finance and HR leadership
    • Maintain controls that protect confidential employee and compensation data
  • Tax & Compliance
    • Ensure compliance with the FLSA and federal, state, and local wage-and-hour, payroll tax, and reporting requirements
    • Oversee payroll tax deposits, quarterly filings (Form 941 and state equivalents), and year-end W-2/1099 processing
    • Stay current on regulatory changes and update procedures and system settings as needed
    • Support internal and external audits with clear documentation
  • Systems & Process Improvement
    • Administer the payroll system and partner with HR and IT on upgrades, integrations, and data accuracy
    • Document procedures and identify opportunities to automate and streamline processes

Who You Are

  • A people leader: you coach and develop your team, set clear priorities, and give feedback that helps people grow
  • Compliance-minded: you know multi-state payroll and wage-and-hour rules, and you stay ahead of changes
  • Accurate and detail-oriented: you catch discrepancies before payroll is released, not after
  • A process improver: you document, streamline, and automate so the team can do more, more consistently
  • Discreet and trustworthy: you protect sensitive employee and compensation data

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with core payroll functions, including 2+ years in a lead or supervisory role
  • Working knowledge of multi-state payroll and wage-and-hour compliance
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and lead a team
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and reconciliations
  • Excellent communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with Paylocity is a plus

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation range for this position is 65,000–70,000 per year, commensurate with experience. A competitive benefits package is provided, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and AD&D coverage; supplementary/voluntary benefit plans; Paid Time-Off; and a 401(k) with employer match.

To Apply

Please submit the following:

  • A resume
  • A brief cover letter outlining your interest in this role
  • Responses to our short questionnaire about your background. Applications without a cover letter and questionnaire response will be considered incomplete and will not be reviewed.

Diversity is a strength of our community. If you meet most but not all of the qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

About Ensemble Performing Arts

Ensemble Performing Arts, a four-time Inc. 5000 honoree, is one of the fastest-growing platforms of independently-run performing arts schools and businesses in the United States. We are powered by passionate educators and supported by a team that believes in preserving what makes each school and business unit special. With a multi-state, multi-entity footprint and active M&A pipeline, we are committed to operational excellence and a people-first culture grounded in respect, flexibility, and shared purpose. We offer opportunities for growth and leadership in a fast-scaling organization.

Who We Are

Our mission is to empower artists by safeguarding the businesses that love them ♡. Our values include:

  • Stewardship: We are caretakers of our performing arts businesses and communities, helping them thrive by making it easy for our teams and educators to cultivate an enriching experience for the students we serve.
  • Growth: Our performing arts businesses are integral to our success, and we are committed to their professional growth. As an ever-growing partnership across the performing arts education space, we seek to increase the high-quality resources provided to our businesses and the people who run them.
  • Stagehands: Our Shared Services team runs in the background to support our businesses. By doing this, we champion students to be the real stars of the show!

To learn more about Ensemble Performing Arts, visit .

jobs.excerpt: About NLA and TCS New Left Accelerator (NLA) and its 501(c)(3) affiliate, The Capacity Shop (TCS), lead operational capacity-building programs that empower social justice organizations and movements to execute bold work safely.
jobs.companyName: New Left Accelerator and The Capacity Shop
jobs.description:
About NLA and TCS

New Left Accelerator (NLA) and its 501(c)(3) affiliate, The Capacity Shop (TCS), lead operational capacity-building programs that empower social justice organizations and movements to execute bold work safely. We bridge the gap between ambitious strategy and operational excellence, scaling structures and impact without sacrificing legal compliance or integrity. To achieve systemic change, organizations must use every tool in their toolbox effectively—including multi-entity structures.

Through deep collaboration with field experts, we build the financial and compliance training systems that allow movement organizations to manage risk and remain resilient. Our work is rooted in a commitment to:

  • Power Building For Systemic Change: Equipping organizations to build power to dismantle oppressive structures.
  • Operational Power: Building the "operational" capacity to execute bold work and to strategically manage risk.
  • A Multi-Entity Lens: Optimizing the diverse legal structures necessary to win critical battles.
  • Transformative Partnerships: Prioritizing those working at the intersections of race, gender, and class.

At NLA, our work is guided by a Theory of Change. We accompany organizations and movements in building sustainable, resilient ecosystems prepared to win the most ambitious fights of our time.

Overview of Project

Background

NLA and TCS develop training on a range of operations topics, focused on what multi-entity organizations need to know. We are developing foundational content for a training module for HR staff at mid-size, multi-entity social justice organizations that do election-year work. The content will focus on the HR issues specific to these organizations when they hire for organizing positions during an election cycle and then end those positions afterward.

Scope of Work

The HR Subject Matter Lead will work under the direction of the TCS, Senior Director of Training and Curriculum to develop a four-part, role-based education module for HR specialists. The module will:

  • Apply a nonprofit multi-entity Human Resources lens throughout
  • Apply a social justice lens to HR in the organizing and election year context
  • Build on existing NLA/TCS content
  • Incorporate NLA's learning frameworks and practices
  • Be customizable for state content

Deliverables and Outcomes

December 2026 through June 2027

  • Content Audit Report: An assessment of existing NLA/TCS HR content that sorts it into what can be used as is, what needs updating, and what's missing. It will include recommendations for the Content Lead.
  • Co-Design Program Line with NLA: Work with TCS and NLA staff to propose the format of the TCS HR pilot program line; consider implications for integration of content into other NLA/TCS program lines.
  • Module Design Proposal: A proposed outline for how we might break out role-based HR education modules segmenting existing content and identifying modifications or needed updates, propose for each training, learning objectives, key topics, and clarity which pre-existing source content that training will draw on and how content will hold together to create an integrated learning experience (define elements like office hours)
  • Training Materials (one set for each of the four trainings): Facilitator guides, slide decks, tools and resources and participant materials, all finalized with the NLA/TCS T&C and content team.
  • Supporting Tools & Resources: Work with content team to co-create HR focused tools, guides, and templates that go with each training in the module.
  • Delivery of Four Trainings (pilot): Conduct live training and facilitation of the module in collaboration with TCS training team; document what works and what does not for improvement.
  • Pilot Debrief and Revision Recommendations: A summary of what was learned from the pilots, with recommended changes. It will also include updated materials that reflect the changes the Content Lead approves.

Steers

  • Start with what exists. Adapt and strengthen current materials rather than redesigning by default.
  • Learn and apply the NLA/TCS competencies (Attitudes & Beliefs, Knowledge & Skills, People & Resources, Systems & Processes) as a diagnostic lens.
  • Prioritize practical application. Use realistic scenarios, decision points, and tools that participants can apply in their organizations.
  • Make distinctions clear. Identify when an issue is a routine management matter, an HR matter, or one that requires employment counsel or other specialized expertise.
  • Design for adult learners with varied levels of HR responsibility and experience. Ensure the content and guides are useful for organizations with limited HR infrastructure as well as those with dedicated HR staff.
  • Keep organizational decisions internal. The consultant will advise and develop content in partnership with staff; NLA/TCS retains final approval.
  • Keep the scope focused on content development, training delivery, and transfer. New legal research, state-by-state guidance, or broader HR consulting must be separately approved.
  • Engage in quality control process and help ensure accuracy and compliance of products

What We Are Looking For

  • 10 years HR experience within multi-entity election-cycle workforces, including employee relations, people management, HR operations, and employment compliance
  • Experience translating complex HR concepts into clear, practical training for non-HR audiences.
  • Training and curriculum development and adult-learning facilitation skills, including virtual training experience (can be public or within organizations).
  • Significant experience supporting movement-building organizations, especially 501(c)(3)s, 501(c)(4)s, campaigns, and/or PACs, with a strong understanding of shared staffing structures and multi-entity operations.
  • Ability to work with HR attorneys to translate legal advice into training content; ability to distinguish general HR education from legal advice and to flag areas requiring review by employment counsel and help manage compliance, accuracy and quality of content.
  • A collaborative working style and demonstrated ability to incorporate feedback without losing technical accuracy or instructional coherence.

Proposal Requirements

Please submit:

  • Letter of Interest (1 page maximum) that covers:
    • Your experience with multi-entity Human Resources including in an election year context.
    • Proposed approach to the scope of work and why you are best positioned to execute this work
    • A fee proposal, including your assumptions about level of effort (for example, estimated hours per deliverable)
  • Resume showing relevant experience in:
    • Human resources in the nonprofit, movement or social justice space, election-cycle settings
    • Curriculum and training development
    • Facilitation
    • Movement building
    • Multi-entity organizations (for example, 501(c)(3), 501(c)(4), and PAC structures)

Submission Information

  • Submissions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Priority deadline is November 6, 2026

jobs.excerpt: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive.
jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are seeking a Director, EMEA Professional Services to lead our EMEA Platform Services organisation and drive delivery excellence across our scientific software portfolio. Reporting to the VP, Global Professional Services, you will lead the regional delivery organisation through a management layer, initially comprising Application Scientist Managers and an India Services Manager responsible for both direct hires and outsourced delivery capability.

You will be accountable for regional delivery execution, commercial performance, customer governance, organisational capability and delivery excellence across EMEA, while helping shape the evolution of Professional Services as we continue our transition to Luma. This is a regional business leadership role with accountability for services revenue, utilisation, margin, forecasting, delivery quality, customer outcomes and people leadership.

In this role you will,

Lead the EMEA Services Organisation

  • Lead and develop a high performing management team across scientific implementation and regional delivery.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Develop an organisation capable of supporting both established Platform implementations and next generation Luma solutions.
  • Build management capability and succession across the region.
  • Lead offshore resources

Drive Commercial Performance

  • Own regional services bookings, revenue, utilisation, margin, forecasting and delivery predictability.
  • Partner with Sales, PreSales, Support and Customer Success to shape, scope and govern services engagements.
  • Ensure strong commercial discipline across Statements of Work, change control, financial management and resource planning.
  • Identify delivery risks early and drive practical mitigation plans.

Deliver Customer Success

  • Act as the senior Professional Services leader for strategic EMEA customer engagements.
  • Build trusted executive relationships with customer stakeholders.
  • Lead executive governance, steering committees and major delivery escalations.
  • Ensure programmes consistently deliver quality outcomes, customer value and commercial success.

Strengthen Delivery Operations

  • Lead regional resource planning across Application Scientists, India-based teams and partner delivery.
  • Develop scalable delivery capacity through offshore teams and strategic partners.
  • Partner closely with the Global PMO to ensure consistent delivery governance, forecasting and project management standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery quality, operational maturity and implementation predictability.

Partner Across the Business

  • Work closely with Sales, PreSales, STS, Support, Customer Success, Product, Finance, Legal and Partner teams.
  • Provide implementation insight that helps shape product evolution and service offerings.
  • Represent Professional Services in planning for Luma, partner enablement and regional growth.
  • Support the evolution of repeatable, scalable delivery models across the Platform business.

We're looking for an experienced Professional Services leader who combines commercial thinking with strong operational execution. You will bring experience in Scientific software, R&D informatics, ELN, LIMS, SDMS, lab automation and orchestration, data platforms or scientific workflow software or similar industry. Ideally you will hold experience working in/with the Life sciences, pharma, biotech, chemicals, CROs or regulated research environments.

You have a deep understanding of services delivering enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms, data platforms, digital transformation with complex workflow implementation

The key skills we are looking for

  • Significant leadership experience within Professional Services, consulting or enterprise software delivery.
  • Experience leading managers and building high performing regional organisations.
  • Ownership of commercial metrics including revenue, utilisation, margin, forecasting and capacity planning.
  • Experience leading complex customer implementations and executive governance.
  • Strong understanding of Statements of Work, project governance, scope management and change control.
  • Experience working closely with Sales, PreSales, Support, Product, Customer Success and Finance.
  • Experience building offshore, partner or blended delivery models.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across a global organisation.

You may also have;

  • Scientific software, R&D informatics, ELN, LIMS, SDMS, laboratory orchestration/automation or scientific workflow platforms.
  • Life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical or chemicals industries.
  • Enterprise SaaS, cloud platforms or digital transformation programmes.
  • Partner-led delivery or systems integrators.
  • PSA, CRM and project governance platforms such as OpenAir, Salesforce or Jira.
  • Regulated environments, including GxP.

Total Rewards

Dotmatics utilises a national market-based approach to base pay benchmarking and pay band development. The candidate's final starting pay is based on job-related skills, experience, job specific qualifications & location. In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition.

Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

Other Total Rewards Offered

  • Private Medical
  • Wellness Benefits (Mental Health Apps and Fitness Perks)
  • Company-paid Life cover
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
  • Pension/Retirement Plan

This is the range that we, in good faith, believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.

Base Pay Range
£91,452—£123,730 GBP

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

jobs.title: Senior Microsoft AI Engineer - Copilot, Foundry & Power Automate
jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with substantial growth potential during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems.
  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.
  • Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions.
  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.
  • Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership.
  • Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity.

Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with a long-term perspective.
  • Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery.
  • The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • Varied projects with practical business impact.
  • Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work.

Please submit your CV and a short overview of:

  • A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results.
  • A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures.
  • A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed.
  • A project you managed or a team you led or mentored.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential information or credentials.

Applications to be Submitted in English

With millions of diners, 60,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

As a Sales Manager (Account Executive) based in Vienna, you will drive the expansion of our dining network by acquiring new restaurant partners through a consultative sales approach. You will act as a trusted advisor to top restaurants, demonstrating how our industry-leading front-of-house management and online reservation technology can optimize their revenue potential. In this remote position with up to 60% domestic travel, you will play a crucial role in empowering restaurants to focus on their teams and guests. Your strategic efforts will directly influence our market presence and the continued success of the hospitality industry in your territory.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, target, and approach prospective restaurant customers within your assigned territory to drive revenue and consistently exceed acquisition targets.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with elite restaurant partners, acting as a strategic consultant to challenge their business perspectives and offer industry insights.
  • Deliver high-quality, customized, data-driven demonstrations of our solutions in person and online to address specific partner needs.
  • Develop comprehensive business plans to define selling strategies, overcome competitive objections, and drive long-term business value.
  • Utilise Salesforce effectively to manage your territory, forecast sales activity, process contracts, and stay organized.
  • Gather and present valuable customer feedback to product and marketing teams while maintaining visibility in the hospitality industry through networking.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in business-to-business (B2B) enterprise sales.
  • Native-level proficiency in German and business-level proficiency in English.
  • Proven track record of goal-oriented sales performance, including outbound lead generation and pipeline management.
  • Proficiency with CRM software (such as Salesforce) and Google Workspace.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with up to 60% domestic travel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Prior restaurant management or sales experience within the food and beverage industry.
  • Strong ability to leverage data and analytics to inform strategic decision-making and build compelling business cases.
  • Exceptional time management, discovery, and negotiation skills.
  • A highly collaborative, team-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous learning and
    hospitality technology.

Pay, Benefits and Perks

  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday:
    • 25 days of paid vacation
    • Enhanced paid parental leave
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The salary range for this Austria located role is 55-60k€ basic + uncapped commissions.

In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for additional compensation and benefits in accordance with local law and company policy.

Work Environment & Flexibility

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Manufacturing
jobs.excerpt: Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders.
jobs.description:
Rezolute is a late-stage rare disease biopharmaceutical company focused on developing transformative therapies for patients living with severe metabolic and endocrine disorders. Our mission is to bring hope and meaningful solutions to patients and families affected by rare and difficult-to-treat diseases through scientific innovation, collaboration, and integrity. Rezolute’s lead investigational therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is a fully human monoclonal antibody in late-stage clinical development for the treatment of hypoglycemia due to congenital and acquired forms of hyperinsulinism (HI).

Position Description: Overview

A key member of Rezolute’s Technical Operations Leadership team, the Vice President, Global Manufacturing has the mandate to provide the vision, leadership, strategy and management skills to build, lead and oversee Rezolute’s fully externalized, global biologics manufacturing network, from cell line through Drug Product. The role is accountable for the reliable, robust and redundant manufacture of ersodetug in support of late-phase clinical supply, global submissions, approval, launch and continuous commercial supply.

The Vice President, Global Manufacturing will build and lead executive-level relationships across the global service provider network, engaging both at the Site Head level and with above-site executive leadership to influence and resolve capability, capacity, reliability and readiness. The position reports to the Senior Vice President, Operations (and Head of Technical Operations), and works daily in partnership with the Head of Quality and the Vice President, Global Supply Chain to deliver one seamless manufacture and supply platform, while acting as a pivotal source of information for the RZLT Management Team and Board of Directors. This role may be performed remotely within the US.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities Include:

    • Charged with designing, developing and implementing the transition of Rezolute’s clinically oriented manufacturing operations toward a robust, reliable and redundant commercial manufacturing network, positioned to support global markets. In this, the organization must maintain its agile operational capability while installing the rigor necessary to meet market demand through a fully externalized network of service providers.

    • Accountable for all externalized manufacturing from cell line through Drug Product, including cell line development, cell bank manufacture and maintenance, Drug Substance manufacture and Drug Product (aseptic fill-finish) manufacture, across a global network of qualified service providers.

    • Accountable for the storage and depot facilities supporting the manufacturing network, including cell banks, Drug Substance and Drug Product held within the manufacturing network. Accountability for Drug Product transfers to the Global Supply Chain upon shipment of Drug Product from the manufacturing site.

    • Accountable for the manufacturing elements of the current Plan of Record, inclusive of Drug Substance and Drug Product supporting two advanced P3 programs, now pre-BLA enabled and preparing for potential launches globally.

    • Owns the Manufacturing Plan as a byproduct of the S&OP process led by the Global Supply Chain. Translates the consensus supply plan into Drug Substance and Drug Product campaign schedules, capacity reservations, slot commitments and critical materials plans; provides capacity, constraint and risk input to S&OP.

    • Builds and sustains executive relationships with each service provider at the Site Head level and with above-site executive leadership, leveraging these relationships to influence priority, capacity and investment, and to resolve capability, reliability and readiness issues.

    • Applies a tiered governance structure with each service provider (operational, site leadership and executive steering) to drive open, contemporaneous and clear understanding of conduct of work, costs, risks and deliverables, with defined escalation paths.

    • Develops and executes the global manufacturing network strategy, including redundancy, second-source and dual-site strategies for Drug Substance and Drug Product, business continuity planning and long-term manufacturing solutions aligned with corporate strategy and evolving goals.

    • Accountable for the robustness and reliability of manufacture; establishes and manages service provider performance to Right First Time and On Time In Full expectations through defined KPIs, routine performance review and corrective action.

    • Accountable for identification and mitigation of risks to the manufacture and supply of Drug Substance and Drug Product; routinely assesses risks within the span of control, creates and implements effective mitigation plans, escalating as appropriate.

    • Builds and leads a Manufacturing Technical team to support routine manufacture, including person-in-plant oversight, campaign technical monitoring, batch record and process performance review, and technical leadership of deviation and investigation resolution at service providers.

    • Builds redundant, reliable capability across the manufacturing platform, enabling site transfers through to registration by establishing the service provider relationship and leading program, contract and deliverable management. Partners with the MSAT team within Quality, which owns technical specification, characterization, qualification and validation, and Module 3 authorship.

    • Leads the team to collaboratively (Quality, MSAT and the Technical Operations Leadership) resolve deviations, investigations and CAPAs, enabling on-time, reliable supply.

    • Supports global submissions and pre-approval inspection readiness at service providers in concert with Quality and Regulatory teams.

    • Works as part of a broader Technical Operations Leadership team, striving for open, honest communication and collaboration.

    Areas of specific responsibility include:

    • Build, lead, manage and develop a best-in-class, high-performance, phase-appropriate team, including external manufacturing leads for Drug Substance and Drug Product, cell line and cell bank management, manufacturing planning and the Manufacturing Technical team.

    • Build phase-appropriate manufacturing systems, procedures and governance for service provider oversight, manufacturing planning, performance management and executive escalation.

    • Work diligently with the Head of Quality to maintain seamless integration with all aspects of the Quality team, including batch disposition support, deviation and change control, supplier qualification and audits, and inspection readiness; support the Head of Quality with respect to registrational compliance evaluation and ongoing release of drug.

    • Partner with the Vice President, Global Supply Chain to ensure a seamless handoff of Drug Product from the manufacturing network to the global supply chain, and alignment between the Manufacturing Plan and the FDP supply plan.

    • Ensure the management of all financial aspects of manufacture, including contracts, budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, capacity commitments and Cost of Goods for Drug Substance and Drug Product.

    • Lead development of relationships and contracting with service providers, including master services, supply, capacity reservation and technical agreements; ensure all manufacturing agreements are effectively negotiated to meet the near- and long-term needs of Rezolute in a cost-efficient manner, as agreed with Legal, Finance, Quality and functional heads.

    • Coordinate the selection and oversight of service providers and suppliers of critical raw materials, consumables and primary components for Drug Substance and Drug Product.

    • Work cross-functionally to identify product lifecycle needs (e.g., scale, presentation and line changes), enabling feasibility and implementation in concert with MSAT, product and corporate strategy.

    • Review technical documentation and summaries to ensure sound rationale, conformance with regulations and existing approvals, and challenge where appropriate the effectiveness of these documents to deliver on the intended purpose.

Qualifications/Requirements - We are looking for a candidate with:

    • B.S. in Engineering, Life Sciences or related field is required; advanced degree preferred.

    • 15+ years of biologics manufacturing experience within biotech/biopharmaceutical organizations, including 5–7+ years in senior leadership with demonstrated executive experience at the Vice President or Executive Director level.

    • Demonstrated hands-on experience building an external manufacturing function, its systems, procedures and team, in the context of a late phase to commercial biotech; Rare Disease experience highly preferred.

    • Expertise in monoclonal antibody Drug Substance and aseptic fill-finish Drug Product manufacturing required; technical awareness of cell line development preferred.

    • Commercial launch experience required, including PPQ, BLA/MAA submission support, pre-approval inspection readiness and transition to commercial supply.

    • Track record of executive relationship management with CDMOs, at the Site Head level and above-site, resulting in resolution of capacity, capability and reliability issues.

    • Demonstrated experience establishing manufacturing redundancy, second-source or dual-site supply for biologics.

    • Experience negotiating master services, supply and capacity reservation agreements.

    • Comfort in leading through influence, acting with agility, leading problem solving and driving toward robust solutions; communication is a critical strength, demonstrated at all levels of the organization; sense of humor and humility are essential.

    • Position may require morning, evening and/or weekend commitments as the RZLT team is spread across the US, and service providers are located offshore.

    • Position requires domestic and international travel (up to 50%).

    Preferred Experience, Special Skills and Knowledge - We are looking for a candidate that has:

    • Experience with multiple CDMO networks across the US, EU and Asia.

    • Board- and executive-level communication of manufacturing risk and strategy.

    • Act with HONOR: Honesty, Open with Direct Communication, Nimbleness, Open-minded, Respect.

Rezolute (RZLT) currently anticipates the base salary for the Vice President, Global Manufacturing role could range from $290,000 to $340,000 and will depend, in part, on the successful candidate’s geographical location and their qualifications for the role, including education and experience. This position will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan (depending, in part, on company and individual performance and at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis). The compensation described above is subject to change and could be higher or lower than the range described based on current market survey data and the qualifications, education, experience and geographical location of the selected candidate.

Rezolute offers competitive compensation, stock options and a rich benefits package.

Qualifying employees are eligible to participate in benefit programs such as:

  • Health Insurance (Medical / Dental / Vision)

  • Disability, Life & Long-Term Care Insurance

  • Holiday Pay

  • Tracking Free Vacation Program

  • 401(k) Plan Match

  • Educational Assistance Benefit

  • Fitness Center Reimbursement

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against applicants due to race, ethnicity, gender, veteran status

  • Checks minimum of once per day for new adoption applications

  • Passes fully screened and vetted applicants to Matchmakers

﻿Needed Skills

  • Professionalism with strong communication skills

  • Detail oriented with follow through on every application

  • Excellent work ethic - you will be expected to be self motivated

  • Collaborative team skills in a remote environment

  • Excellent record keeping

Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.

Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one 'dog destination' in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokane's love of Rescue Dogs.

Core Values:

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

Our Company Culture

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus.

No NGO status here, we don't take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. We're about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We don't do drama. There are no victims here and the system isn't out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We don't bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where it's normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dog's birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isn't being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

"I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

The Clinical Trial Coordinator (CTC) assists in the coordination and administration of the study activities from the start up to execution and close out, and within the Local Study Team (LST) to ensure quality and consistency of interventional study deliverables to time, cost and quality objectives.


CTCs might have different internal titles based on the experience level (CTC, Senior CTC). The experience level depends on the years of experience, performance record, level of independence to execute, ability to take on additional tasks or tutor more junior colleagues. The Director, Country Head may assign this internal title after confirmation with Senior Director, Cluster Head / Executive Director, Regional Head.


Typical Accountabilities

  • Assists in coordination and administration of clinical studies from the start-up to execution and close-out.
  • Collects, assists in preparation, reviews and tracks documents for the application process. Assists in timely submission of proper application/documents to EC/IRB and, where appropriate to Regulatory Authorities for the duration of the study.
  • Interfaces with Investigators, external service providers and CRAs during the document collection process to support effective delivery of a study and its documents.
  • Serves as local administrative main contact and works closely with the CRAs and/or the LSAD for the duration of the study.
  • Operational responsibility for the correct set-up and maintenance of the local eTMF and ISF including document tracking in accordance with ICH-GCP and local requirements.
  • Ensures essential documents under their responsibility are uploaded in a timely manner to maintain the eTMF “Inspection Readiness”.
  • Ensures that all study documents are ready for final archiving and completion of local part of the eTMF and supports the CRA in the close out activities for the ISF.
  • Contributes to the production and maintenance of study documents, ensuring template and version compliance.
  • Creates and/or imports clinical-regulatory documents into the Global Electronic Management System (e.g. ANGEL) ensuring compliance with the client Authoring Guide for Regulatory Documents.
  • Contributes to electronic applications/submissions by handling clinical-regulatory documents according to the requested technical standards i.e., Submission Ready Standards (SRS), supporting effective publishing and delivery to regulatory authorities.
  • Sets-up, populates and accurately maintains information in client tracking and communication tools (e.g. CTMS such as VCV, SharePoint, etc) and supports others in the usage of these systems (with the exception of countries where there is a specific role dedicated to set up and update the systems).
  • Prepares and/or supports contract preparation at a site level (with the exception of countries where there is a specific role dedicated to preparing site contracts).
  • Prepares/supports/performs Health Care Organisations (HCO)/Health Care Professionals (HCP) payments in accordance with local regulations.
  • Manages and contributes to coordination and tracking of study materials and equipment.
  • Coordinates administrative tasks during the study process, audits and regulatory inspections, according to company policies and SOPs.
  • Leads the practical arrangements and contributes to the preparation of internal and external meetings e.g., study team meetings, Monitors’ meetings, Investigators’ meetings. Liaises with internal and external participants and/or vendors, in line with international and local codes.
  • Prepares, contributes to and distributes presentation material for meetings, newsletters and websites.
  • Responsible for layout and language control, copying and distribution of documents. Supports with local translation and spell checks in English to/from local language, as required.
  • Responsible for printing and distribution of documents such as letters and meeting minutes, and for handling and archiving of study/country related e-mails.
  • Interfaces with Data Management Centre and/or Data Management, Global Clinical Solutions representatives to facilitate the delivery of study related documents/material.
  • Ensures compliance with client’s Code of Ethics and company policies and procedures relating to people, finance, technology, security and SHE (Safety, Health and Environment).
  • Ensures compliance with local, national and regional legislation, as applicable.

Additional country-specific tasks might be added depending on local needs.
