jobs.title: Director, Market Growth Strategy, Molecule to Market (Biologics)
jobs.excerpt: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive.
jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are looking for an experienced market leader, thought leader and SME in Biologics
Biologics research is where molecular therapeutic discovery begins. Scientists are discovering and engineering proteins, antibodies, bispecifics, and other large molecule formats, then deciding which candidates are worth taking forward. They run huge numbers of experiments across assays, instruments, and teams. The data is rich but often not well organized, and the best candidates can get lost in the noise. Good decisions here shape everything that comes after.

We’re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. Biologics research is a core part of our Molecule to Market story. We need someone to own the market strategy for it.

This is a customer and market facing role. You’ll spend real time with biologics research leaders at pharma, biotech, and academic and government institutes, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You’ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to this market with confidence and one consistent story. Your job is to drive software adoption and AI use cases in biologics research. You will shape where we play, who we sell to, how we position, and how we win.

How you’ll spend your time

  • Customer engagements: meeting research leaders and scientists, joining pursuits, and bringing what you hear back to the business
  • Market analysis: sizing segments, tracking competitors, and spotting trends early
  • Sales enablement: giving teams across regions the talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and proof points to win
  • Solution marketing: partnering with the Siemens Solution Marketing team on content, campaigns, events, and messaging for the biologics research audience
  • Thought leadership: working with industry thought leaders, inside and outside Siemens, to shape the conversation on AI driven discovery and the future of the research lab
  • Adoption and AI use cases: identifying, proving, and spreading the use cases that get scientists using Luma and putting AI to work on their data
  • Cross organization alignment: working across Siemens DISW and DI Automation teams so we show up as one company with one story for the biologics research market

The goal is simple. Drive excellence in how we represent ourselves to biologics research buyers, and turn that into real software adoption.

What you’ll do

  • Own the market growth strategy for Luma in biologics research, including antibody discovery, protein engineering, lead optimization, and developability
  • Define target segments, buyer personas, and priority accounts, including Heads of Biologics Research, Discovery Biology, Protein Sciences, Antibody Engineering, Research IT, and Lab Automation
  • Build positioning and messaging that speaks to bench scientists, research leaders, and executives
  • Drive software adoption by working with customers and field teams to find the workflows where Luma delivers value fastest, and by capturing what works so others can repeat it
  • Define and prove AI use cases for biologics research, including how scientists prepare, trust, and use their data with tools like NVIDIA BioNeMo
  • Translate research pain points into clear value, including faster design, build, test, and learn cycles, better capture of experimental context, easier sharing of data across teams, and cleaner handoffs into development
  • Partner with the Siemens Solution Marketing team to build content, campaigns, and events for the research market
  • Work with industry thought leaders, analysts, and partners to build credibility and bring outside voices into our story
  • Create the competitive view against other informatics vendors, point solutions, and in house builds
  • Develop the business case, pricing inputs, and value story with Finance and Sales
  • Equip global teams with talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and customer proof points
  • Partner with DISW and DI Automation teams to align messaging, joint offers, and customer conversations
  • Partner with Product on roadmap priorities based on what research teams tell us
  • Connect biologics research to the bigger Molecule to Market narrative, including ELN, Lab Orchestration, and Biologics registration
  • Support strategic pursuits and executive conversations with customers and partners
  • Track market trends, including AI driven discovery, autonomous labs, lab automation, and data analytics, and turn them into action

We are looking for people who have 10 or more years in life sciences, with hands on biologics research experience in a pharma, biotech, or research institute setting. You wiil bring Strong analytical skills, including sizing markets and building a business case, excellent writing and presentation skills, and ideally hold a degree in biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, or a related field. Advanced degree strongly preferred, and a PhD is a plus

The key skills

  • Deep understanding of how biologics discovery works day to day, including target validation, antibody and protein engineering, expression and purification, assay development, screening, characterization, and candidate selection
  • Knowledge of how research leaders make decisions, balance speed and quality, and work with development, automation, and data science teams
  • Familiarity with ELN, LIMS, registration systems, or assay data platforms
  • Experience in product marketing, market strategy, product management, or commercial roles at a software, informatics, or life sciences solutions company
  • A track record of driving software adoption, or of turning new technology such as AI into use cases customers actually adopt
  • Proven ability to turn complex science and technology into clear, simple messaging
  • Comfort working with senior leaders, industry experts, and customers
  • Ability to work across a large, global, matrixed organization and build trust with teams in different regions and business units

Nice to have

  • Experience running or supporting a biologics discovery team
  • Experience with lab automation, high throughput screening, or self driving lab concepts
  • Experience with AI, machine learning, or data platforms in a scientific setting
  • Existing relationships with industry thought leaders, analysts, or research institutes
  • Prior time at a biotech or in a discovery organization at a large pharma

What success looks like

  • A clear biologics research market strategy adopted by Sales, Product, Services, and Solution Marketing
  • Messaging and sales tools that teams around the world actually use
  • One consistent story for biologics research across Dotmatics, DISW, and DI Automation
  • Growing software adoption and a library of proven AI use cases in biologics research
  • Industry voices who help tell our story
  • Growing pipeline and wins tied to biologics research
  • Research leaders who can say, in their own words, why Luma helps their scientists find and advance better molecules faster

Total Rewards

Dotmatics utilises a national market-based approach to base pay benchmarking and pay band development. The candidate's final starting pay is based on job-related skills, experience, job specific qualifications & location. In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition.

Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

Other Total Rewards Offered

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Insurance
  • Health Spending Accounts
  • Wellness Benefits (Mental Health Apps and Fitness Perks)
  • Company-paid Life and Disability Insurance
  • 401k Retirement Plan (with 4% company match; immediate vesting)
  • Flexible Time off Plan (for US exempt employees)

This is the range that we, in good faith, believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.

Base Pay Range
$185,000—$256,000 USD

jobs.description:
Senior Product Designer (iOS 26 / Liquid Glass / Figma) - Portugal Full Remote

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer with native iOS expertise to join a well-established digital product team. They are building a shared, reliable design foundation for multiple product teams. This is a hands-on, fully remote role for a detail-obsessed designer who enjoys bringing order to complexity. You’ll turn a live, evolving product into a structured, well-documented template library that teams will rely on every day.

PROJECT & CONTEXT

The product is live across iOS 26+ and iPadOS 26+, with Apple’s Liquid Glass design language at its core. Your mission is to close the gap between what’s in production and what’s in the design files. You will:

  • Analyse production user journeys and recreate their screens, including states, interactions and platform-specific nuances
  • Compare production components against the design files and identify missing components and discrepancies in structure, appearance or behaviour
  • Document each difference with visual references, deviation descriptions and the affected screens or journeys
  • Build local components and variants that accurately reflect the current product, ready for review and alignment with the Design System
  • Organise screens into reusable templates, named consistently and structured by user journey and platform
  • Make sure templates are easy for different teams to adopt and adapt, with enough context to support new feature design

Expected deliverable: an organised template library that mirrors the live product, with documented discrepancies and local components prepared for review.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR (Required)

  • Native app design specialism, with proven experience designing with Liquid Glass on iOS 26+ and/or iPadOS 26+. This must be clearly stated on your CV.
  • Hands-on experience working with Design Systems, including how components, variants, patterns and tokens relate, and knowing when to reuse a component and when to propose a new variant. This must also be clear on your CV.
  • Advanced Figma mastery: Auto Layout, components, variants, component properties, variables, styles and libraries
  • High attention to detail and visual rigour, with a strong eye for discrepancies in layout, spacing, typography, colour, iconography and behaviour
  • Solid web and app interaction design background: responsive behaviour, platform conventions and states (loading, error, empty, success, unavailable)
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills, so you can describe issues clearly and constructively for designers and developers
  • Systematic, organised thinking to keep screens, journeys and shared files consistent across teams
  • Working knowledge of digital accessibility, to flag issues and guide future decisions
  • Autonomy and clear communication: you manage your own workload, resolve ambiguity and escalate what needs validation
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)

NICE TO HAVE (Preferred)

  • Previous experience building, contributing to or maintaining a Design System, beyond consuming one

This is a remote position.

Are you passionate about building reliable, scalable data platforms and improving data quality at an enterprise level? We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer – Data Quality & Observability to lead the implementation of a modern data quality framework, enabling engineering teams to detect, monitor, and prevent data issues before they impact business operations.

In this role, you'll drive the implementation of engineering-owned data quality practices, operationalize GX Core, establish validation standards, and build observability solutions that improve confidence across reporting, synchronization processes, and operational workflows.

Responsibilities
  • Design and implement a scalable data quality framework across the platform.
  • Lead the implementation and operationalization of GX Core (Great Expectations) as the primary data validation framework.
  • Develop and maintain reusable data quality rules using a Rule-as-Code approach.
  • Create automated validation checks for business-critical datasets and workflows.
  • Implement data observability, monitoring, alerting, and reporting solutions.
  • Define and maintain data lineage across key business domains.
  • Design validation processes for data completeness, accuracy, integrity, consistency, reconciliation, freshness, and anomaly detection.
  • Integrate data quality validations into CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
  • Develop dashboards and reports to monitor data quality trends and operational health.
  • Investigate root causes of recurring data issues and implement preventive solutions.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering, Application Engineering, QA, Product, and Support teams to establish ownership and governance for data quality.
  • Define standards for governance, validation frequency, remediation workflows, and quality metrics.
  • Continuously improve data quality processes and establish long-term observability best practices.

Requisitos

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in similar data engineering roles.
  • Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise Data Quality frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with GX Core (Great Expectations) or similar tools such as Soda.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon Redshift.
  • Experience designing data validation rules, reconciliation processes, and observability solutions.
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL pipelines and large-scale data workflows.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, referential integrity, synchronization, and batch processing.
  • Experience integrating data validation into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Git and engineering best practices such as Rule-as-Code.
  • Experience building dashboards, alerts, and reporting for operational monitoring.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience performing root cause analysis.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.

What We Offer
  • ? Fully remote position.
  • ? Opportunity to build enterprise-scale data quality and observability solutions.
  • ? High-impact role with ownership over data quality strategy and engineering best practices.
  • ? Collaborative environment working alongside Data Engineering, QA, Product, and Application Engineering teams.
  • ? Opportunity to work with modern data validation, observability, and cloud data technologies while driving continuous improvement across the platform.

POSITION SUMMARY

This fixed-term position will provide additional Revenue Management Support (RMS) capacity during the Power of M transition. The role will manage the day-to-day revenue management requirements of a flexible portfolio of hotels, enabling the hotels’ dedicated Revenue Managers to focus on Power of M deployment activities while maintaining continuity of core RMS service delivery and commercial support.

Responsible for delivering agreed business-as-usual revenue management activities across a flexible and changing portfolio of RMS-supported hotels. Portfolio assignments will align with Power of M deployment requirements and may change as hotels enter or complete transition activity. The role will maintain pricing, forecasting, inventory strategy, performance review and hotel communication in line with agreed Core Deliverables, helping protect revenue and profit while the dedicated Revenue Manager concentrates on Power of M tasks.

Provides BAU revenue management coverage that supports the wider RMS team through the Power of M transition. The role is not the primary owner of Power of M deployment tasks but may provide relevant hotel context, commercial input and handover support when required.

Provides revenue management functional expertise to hotels assigned within the flexible transition-support portfolio.

Location requirements: Contracted from Eschborn Office however is a field-based role and therefore supports 100% remote working in the Germany only.

Germany

jobs.excerpt: About InvestEngineInvestEngine is everything the modern investor should need.
jobs.description:
About InvestEngine

InvestEngine is everything the modern investor should need. Unbeatable value, market-leading automation, and built for easy, long-term investing. We've built a strong foundation, have over £3 billion invested, award-winning service, and a passionate team — now we're ready to scale.

About the Role

We're looking for a Complaints Handler to join our newly established Complaints function, reporting to our Complaints and Consumer Duty Officer. Your mission is to make sure every customer complaint and escalation is resolved fairly, on time and to a high standard — through strong investigation, sound decision-making and clear customer communication — and to turn what complaints tell us into meaningful feedback for the business.

You'll sit between our Customer Experience and Operations teams, acting as the bridge between resolving individual cases and improving how the business works. Around 90% of your time will be hands-on complaint handling (roughly 12 complaints a week on average), with the remaining 10% on project work such as complaints MI and root-cause analysis.

This role is ideal for someone who is curious, fair-minded and independent: you dig past the surface to find out what really happened, you're comfortable making a call, and you know when to escalate.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end investigation and resolution of customer complaints and escalations, in writing and by phone, including complex, sensitive or time-critical cases

  • Review the evidence impartially and reach fair, proportionate outcomes, taking account of the customer's individual circumstances and impact

  • Write clear, structured and empathetic final responses that explain your findings and decisions in plain English

  • Manage your caseload to meet internal SLAs and regulatory deadlines, prioritising the most urgent and complex cases

  • Work with Operations, Customer Experience and other internal teams to gather information and get issues fixed

  • Identify root causes behind complaints and contribute to complaints MI, insight and process improvements that reduce repeat issues

What We're Looking For

  • Experience investigating customer complaints, escalations or disputes in financial services, fintech, banking, payments, brokerage, or another regulated or high-volume customer operations environment

  • Sound judgement: you can apply policy, process and customer context to reach fair outcomes, and know when to progress independently and when to escalate

  • Excellent written English — clear, accurate and empathetic, with high standards of grammar and spelling (C1 level and above; we are a UK-based company and you'll be writing to UK customers)

  • Strong time management; you can work independently, juggle a caseload and consistently hit deadlines

  • A curious, analytical mindset and comfort working with spreadsheets to spot patterns

Nice to Have

  • Experience handling formal complaints in a UK FCA-regulated business; familiarity with DISP or Consumer Duty

  • Knowledge of investment products such as ISAs, SIPPs or ETFs

  • Experience with root-cause analysis or complaints MI reporting

  • Experience using Zendesk or similar case-management tools

How We Work

We're a lean, fast-moving team that values clarity, ownership, and transparency. You'll have the freedom to experiment, the responsibility to follow through, and the backing of a team that values clear thinking and open dialogue. We believe in solving problems at the root, not just treating the symptoms.

What We Offer

Impact from day one

You'll take on meaningful work from the start, putting things right for customers and directly improving how we serve investors.

Room to grow

Complaints handling is a fantastic launchpad: you'll gain exposure to regulation, governance and how every part of a growing fintech works. As we scale, you'll have opportunities to expand your responsibilities and help shape a new function.

Transparent and open culture

We share decisions openly, keep communication channels clear, and encourage collaboration across every part of the business.

Supportive, high-calibre team

Work alongside talented professionals who are experts in their fields — smart, driven, and generous with their knowledge.

Remote and flexible

Georgia-based with flexibility. We focus on results and trust you to manage your time effectively.

Our Hiring Process

  1. CV review by our Talent team

  2. Gamified cognitive assessment and a short test task representative of the role

  3. Interview with our Talent team

  4. Skills interview with the Complaints team

  5. Final interview with senior leadership

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care. You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors. Job highlights The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen. In this role, you will:
  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes
  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs
  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role
  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed
  • Conduct virtual visits as needed
  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)
A Note on Our Work Environment: As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants. Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health “Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD “The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD Part-time employees qualify for:

jobs.description:
Mission

The Marketing Manager runs execution for Foundation’s marketing engine. This person takes the plan set by the Head of Marketing and makes it happen across campaigns, the website, SEO, paid media and sales enablement. They work with Sales and Paid to grow pipeline and improve how much of it converts to revenue.

This is a hands-on role for a strong operator who ships quickly, measures everything and keeps standards high. It also leads the Social Media & Marketing Coordinator, which includes delegating work, coaching and holding quality. There’s a clear path to take on more strategic planning over time.

Core Responsibilities

Pipeline Execution with Sales & Paid

  • Work with Sales on lead handoff, MQL/SAL follow-up and regular pipeline reviews, so marketing-sourced leads move quickly and nothing falls through
  • Work with the Paid Department to launch and improve campaigns: audience targeting, landing pages, offers and budget pacing, measured on pipeline outcomes, not just clicks and form fills
  • Find where pipeline stalls (volume, conversion or velocity) and run tests to fix it
  • Build and run nurture and lifecycle email programs that move MQLs toward sales conversations

Website & SEO

  • Own the Foundation website: updates, new pages, landing pages and day-to-day maintenance in the CMS
  • Own on-page and technical SEO for the site, service pages and landing pages, including keyword targeting, metadata, internal linking, schema, site speed, indexation and crawlability for both search engines and AI crawlers
  • Improve the site’s conversion rate through testing forms, CTAs, page layout and offers
  • Monitor site health and performance in tools like Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and fix issues proactively
  • Work with the Content Manager where site SEO and editorial content overlap (for example, internal linking, page templates and topic overlap between service pages and articles)
  • Campaigns, Programs & Go-to-Market Execution
  • Execute integrated marketing campaigns tied to service launches, Industry moments and events, Thought leadership themes (collaborate with the Content Manager)
  • Run webinars, podcasts, partnerships and sponsorships that drive MQLs and pre-sales conversations, covering logistics, promotion and follow-up
  • Coordinate with Creative, Growth, Paid, Sales and Content so campaigns ship on time, on brand and as planned
  • Apply Brand-to-Demand principles and Category Entry Points (CEPs) in targeting, landing pages, paid campaigns and sales materials
  • Team Leadership & Delegation
  • Coach and mentor the Marketing Coordinator: set goals, give regular feedback and build a development plan that grows them toward fully owning social
  • Delegate execution with clear briefs, owners and deadlines, then hold the line on quality and timelines
  • Work with the Creative Director to uphold creative quality standards on everything this role ships

Performance Analytics & Reporting

  • Own funnel reporting: MQL volume, MQL → SAL conversion, pipeline velocity, cost per SAL and marketing-influenced revenue
  • Build and maintain dashboards (HubSpot preferred) that give leadership a clear, trusted view of performance
  • Track performance across Paid media efficiency and pipeline contribution, Website traffic, conversion rate and organic/AI search visibility, Campaign, event and email engagement, Sales enablement asset usage
  • Analyze results and bring the Head of Marketing clear insights and recommended next steps
  • Keep consistent reporting cadences and documentation

Sales Enablement & Pre-Sales Support

  • Act as a subject matter expert on Foundation’s services (SEO, GEO, Reddit, distribution, content) on second and third sales calls, building credibility, clarity and buyer confidence
  • Support audits and proposals as a reviewer and quality partner, making sure they match Foundation’s positioning and the buyer’s needs
  • Oversee production and upkeep of sales enablement assets: pitch decks, templates, one-pagers, service pages and supporting documentation for audits and proposals
  • Make sure Sales always has current messaging, proof points, service positioning and case studies (case study production sits with the Content Manager)
  • Build and maintain repeatable marketing and enablement systems: SOPs, templates and playbooks
  • Capture patterns from sales conversations and buyer questions (objections, CEPs, decision dynamics) and share them with the Head of Marketing, Content Manager and Sales


What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of B2B marketing experience. SaaS, tech or agency experience preferred.
  • Hands-on SEO experience: technical and on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO tools (GSC, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush)
  • Website experience: comfortable building and editing pages in a CMS (WordPress, HubSpot, Webflow or similar). Basic HTML/CSS is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills: CRM (HubSpot preferred), dashboards, spreadsheets and attribution, and you turn data into clear recommendations
  • A track record of working with Sales and Paid teams to drive pipeline
  • A strong executor: organized and fast, you finish what you start and run several projects at once without dropping quality
  • Strong delegation skills and experience coaching or mentoring at least one junior teammate
  • Nice to have: familiarity with GEO/AEO and how AI search is changing B2B buying; CRO or A/B testing experience; webinar experience

KPIs & Measures of Success

  • Pipeline impact: MQL volume and MQL → SAL conversion rate, Pipeline velocity and cost per SAL, Marketing-influenced pipeline and revenue
  • Website & SEO: Organic and AI search visibility for service and landing pages, Website conversion rate, Technical site health (Core Web Vitals, crawl and index issues)
  • Sales enablement: Enablement adoption and asset usage in active deals, Qualitative feedback from Sales
  • Execution & team: Speed and consistency of delivery against the plan, Coordinator growth against their development plan, Fewer enablement gaps and ad hoc requests

Compensation

  • Base salary $60k–$90k CAD depending on experience and location
  • Variable compensation: OTE $65k–$100k CAD (team performance bonus and company-wide profit-sharing)

As an FDE, you are both a master builder and a trusted technical advisor. You will own the full delivery lifecycle for high-impact enterprise accounts—designing scalable data foundations, implementing cutting-edge Generative AI solutions, and migrating complex workloads onto the Databricks Lakehouse platform.   • Data Migration: Proven track record of migrating enterprise legacy data warehouses/lakes onto Databricks.

  • Consulting & Customer-Facing Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; comfortable presenting technical architecture, building POCs/demos, and managing client stakeholders up to the C-suite.
  • Growth Mindset: Ability to spot technical expansion opportunities within existing client accounts and serve as a technical advocate to grow account footprint.

  • Remote-First Working Environment – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Plan for your future with access to a company-sponsored 401(k) program.
  • Annual Learning & Development Stipend – Invest in your skills with conferences, certifications, or courses.
  • Peer Mentorship & Coaching – Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth.
  • Professional Growth Opportunities – Exposure to cutting-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries.
  • Company Outings & Volunteer Opportunities – Build relationships and give back to the community.

jobs.title: ServiceNow IRM Practice Lead
jobs.excerpt: OVERVIEWiTech AG is seeking an SecOps Practice Lead – ServiceNow Architect to lead the solution architecture for a federal customer's cyber risk and Continuous Authorization and Monitoring (CAM) program.
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

iTech AG is seeking an SecOps Practice Lead – ServiceNow Architect to lead the solution architecture for a federal customer's cyber risk and Continuous Authorization and Monitoring (CAM) program. This is a senior, architect-level role responsible for owning the end-to-end IRM solution design on the ServiceNow platform and the integration architecture that connects it across multiple ServiceNow products — IRM/CAM, Policy and Compliance Management, Risk Management, Flow Designer and Workflow Studio, IntegrationHub, Service Portal/UI Builder, Virtual Agent, and AI/Now Assist.

The ideal candidate is a true ServiceNow architect who has implemented IRM end-to-end, from control library and authorization boundary design through SSP management, POA&M and issue remediation, control testing, risk registers, dashboards, and data migration, and can direct developers to deliver it. They bring proven experience architecting cross-product ServiceNow solutions and enterprise integrations in FISMA/FedRAMP-governed environments. This role owns the IRM Technical Solutions, defines integration and security patterns, and collaborates with the iTech Solution SMEs, customers, and iTech Certified Master Architects.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own delivery quality: Bring hands-on technical and business expertise, guide the team, and step in when work goes off track.
  • Build the practice: Develop the offering and expertise, find and help recruit developers, and support their growth.
  • Help grow the business: Support pre-sales and co-selling, build relationships with BD and relevant ServiceNow contacts, and help turn opportunities into work.
  • Stay cost-recoverable while creating room to lead: Do customer work, but also devote time to practice development rather than treating it as an after-hours job

• Advise and sell to CISOs, CIOs, and security leaders—connecting their risk priorities to credible IRM and SecOps solutions.
• Build the SecOps practice through market-facing offerings, repeatable takeout plays, pre-sales leadership, and team mentoring.
• Guide customers on how ServiceNow and Armis fit together, while remaining hands-on through delivery.

  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture for the ServiceNow IRM/CAM solution, including solution design, data model, control hierarchy, and the phased roadmap across modules
  • Architect and lead the implementation of ServiceNow IRM capabilities across the solution, including:
    • Continuous Authorization and Monitoring (CAM)
    • System Security Plans (SSPs) and Authorization Boundaries
    • Control Testing, Assessment, and Continuous Monitoring
    • Issue, Deficiency, and POA&M Management
    • Cyber Risk Register and Risk Assessments
    • Common and Inherited Controls
    • Policy and Compliance Management (authority documents, policies, and control attestations)
    • Audit Management and auditor evidence workflows
    • Third-Party / Vendor Risk Management
    • Business Continuity Management and contingency planning (CP control family)
    • Dashboards, Reporting, and Stakeholder Visibility
  • Author and maintain the Technical Solution — architecture diagrams, data model, control hierarchy, integration patterns, and security model — and drive architecture decisions and approvals each sprint
  • Configure IRM Continuous Authorization and Monitoring (CAM) for SSPs, POA&Ms, control testing, risk assessments, and control inheritance
  • Build automated issue and deficiency workflows, including assignment, notifications, tracking, review, and approval
  • Configure collaborative workflows to replace email-based processes across multiple security and technical teams
  • Design support for multiple authorization boundaries and SSPs, including GSS, ICS, and subsystem relationships
  • Configure common controls and inherited controls so control relationships cascade appropriately across parent systems and subsystems
  • Implement a cyber risk register and the workflows for creating, reviewing, and approving risk assessments
  • Build configurable dashboards and reports for issues, remediation status, SSP and control status, risks, and approvals that end users can adjust without recoding
  • Configure the annual SSP update and approval process, including auditor review and sign-off requirements
  • Ensure the control library supports the required NIST control and enhancement granularity — potentially down to examples such as AC-2(1)(b) — and design a documented workaround if native depth is insufficient
  • Plan and execute the IRM data migration effort, including:
    • Migration of approximately 10–14 SSPs, using OSCAL where feasible
    • An alternate JSON/import-map transformation approach where OSCAL is not viable
    • A practical manual, system-by-system configuration fallback if automation is not possible
    • Validation of migrated control, POA&M, and boundary data against source systems
  • Define and govern the integration architecture between ServiceNow IRM and external systems, including authoritative control and compliance data sources, customer SSO, ITSM/ticketing, and enterprise reporting or data warehouse platforms
  • Identify how digital approvals and signatures will be handled on the current platform, including an interim workflow if native signature capability is unavailable
  • Establish development standards and hands-on build the most complex components — custom applications, workflows, business rules, UI policies, integrations, and Flow Designer automations
  • Partner with iTech AG Master Architects and the Solution SME on cross-product architecture and technical governance
  • Serve as a contributing member of the iTech AG ServiceNow Center of Excellence (CoE), sharing reusable patterns, standards, and lessons learned across programs
  • Act as the organization-wide leader for the IRM product area — advising other programs and pursuits, informing the IRM capability roadmap, and supporting proposal and solutioning efforts beyond this project
  • Lead the approximately four-week discovery with security stakeholders to validate processes, data sources, control hierarchy, and migration assumptions
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives, and contribute to Technical Solution Document (TSD) updates each sprint
  • Lead code and design reviews, mentor developers, and enforce platform best practices and technical governance
  • Support platform upgrades, patching, and performance optimization activities, and resolve IRM defects, workflow issues, and production support requests
  • Ensure configurations and customizations align with federal security, compliance (e.g., NIST 800-53, FISMA, FedRAMP), accessibility, and data governance requirements
  • Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge transfer, operational readiness, and end-user adoption efforts
  • Other duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow experience, including 3+ years in a technical lead role
  • 3+ years leading ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) implementations end-to-end
  • Deep architecture and hands-on experience across:
    • Continuous Authorization and Monitoring (CAM) and SSP management
    • Control libraries, control testing, and continuous control monitoring
    • Issue, deficiency, and POA&M remediation workflows
    • Cyber risk register and risk assessment workflows
    • Dashboards, reporting, and stakeholder self-service
  • Working knowledge of NIST 800-53 control families and enhancements, FISMA, and the authorization boundary / ATO lifecycle
  • Experience designing integration architecture using IntegrationHub and REST/SOAP APIs, and leading GRC/IRM data migration
  • Strong experience defining ServiceNow data models, security models, and overall platform architecture
  • Proficiency with ServiceNow scripting including JavaScript, Glide APIs, Script Includes, and Flow Designer
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments (ServiceNow Now Create methodology a plus)
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, and experience leading, mentoring, and setting technical direction for developers

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years experience
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or equivalent years experience
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) or equivalent years experience
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) – Risk and Compliance (IRM), with additional CIS certifications across products (e.g., Data Foundations (CMDB/CSDM), ITSM, CSM, Discovery) a plus

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting federal government programs subject to FISMA and/or FedRAMP authorization
  • Experience with OSCAL-based SSP export/import and control data transformation
  • Experience migrating from eMASS, Xacta, CSAM, or comparable GRC/ATO platforms into ServiceNow
  • Familiarity with continuous control monitoring, automated evidence collection, and control test automation
  • Experience implementing ServiceNow Policy and Compliance Management, Risk Management, Audit Management, or Vendor Risk Management
  • Experience implementing ServiceNow Business Continuity Management, Privacy Management, or Operational Resilience Management
  • Experience linking ServiceNow Security Operations (Vulnerability Response, Configuration Compliance) findings to IRM issues and POA&Ms
  • Familiarity with Now Assist for IRM, including AI-assisted control mapping and evidence summarization
  • Strong experience with Service Portal, UI Builder, and dashboard and reporting design for executive and auditor audiences
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow data model, CMDB relationships, and platform performance optimization
  • Experience with ServiceNow Now Create methodology and IntegrationHub-based integrations
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow Virtual Agent and AI / Now Assist capabilities
  • Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration skills

SECURITY CLEARANCE

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust
  • Pursuant to government contracts, US Citizenship is required

iTech AG is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws.

accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high

performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,

designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

About The Role

As a Principal Software Engineer at Rosterfy, you are the most senior individual contributor in the engineering team, responsible for setting technical direction while staying deeply hands-on. You work across our two product squads as a force multiplier: designing architecture, pairing on hard problems, and unblocking delivery on critical initiatives. Reporting to the HoE, you connect product strategy to implementation detail, ensuring the client’s v3 (event-driven, domain-driven, AI-augmented) is robust, scalable, and maintainable across our PHP/Laravel backend, Next.js frontend, and AWS/GCP infrastructure. You spend a significant portion of your time building (coding, reviewing, debugging, pairing) while also shaping engineering standards, architecture, and long-term platform evolution. You do not manage people directly; instead, you lead through technical excellence, influence, and mentoring.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the architecture and technical direction for core platform domains used by both squads (e.g. event-driven workflows, modular boundaries, AI capabilities).
  • Spend 60–80% of your time hands-on: designing, coding, reviewing, pairing, and debugging in Laravel, Next.js and our cloud environments.
  • Lead the technical discovery and delivery of high-impact initiatives, especially those that cross team boundaries or require significant architectural change.
  • Define, document, and evangelize architectural principles, coding standards, and patterns for scalable, resilient, observable systems.
  • Raise the bar for quality: champion shift-left testing, CI/CD improvements, and production observability; model best practices in test design and validation.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, pairing, and feedback, helping them own systems end-to-end rather than taking work away.
  • Evaluate and prototype emerging technologies (e.g. Vertex AI, GenAI workflows, data pipelines) and guide pragmatic adoption into product and platform.
  • Act as a senior engineering voice in roadmap planning, estimation and trade-off decisions, ensuring technical health is represented alongside product goals
  • Works across both product squads rather than being embedded in one team, focusing on cross-cutting systems and the hardest technical problems.
  • Partners with the Engineering Leadership on long-term architecture and with Tech Leads on execution and engineering practices.

Technical

  • 8+ years in software engineering, including experience as a staff/principal engineer or architect in a SaaS company
  • Deep expertise in backend engineering with Laravel (Laravel 10+ and PHP 8+) or similar languages, SQL/relational databases, caching, and RESTful APIs
  • Strong frontend design and architectural experience with React/
  • Experience working with scalable, secure cloud infrastructure (AWS required, & CGP)
  • Familiarity with event-driven or modular architectures and containerized environments (e.g., EKS/Kubernetes)
  • Deep understanding of software testing strategies and CI/CD pipelines
  • Bonus: experience with Looker, BigQuery, ML pipelines, or distributed system performance tuning
  • Bonus: Agent AI Architecture

AI Driven Skills

  • Feature delivery velocity (Copilot, Gemini, test automation, scaffolding)
  • Building AI-augmented product experiences (LLM API usage, prompt design)
  • Coaching others on integrating GenAI into workflows

Character & Mindset

  • Resilient and adaptable – You embrace change and help others navigate ambiguity with calm and confidence.
  • Proactive problem solver – You identify issues early, take ownership, and push solutions forward without waiting to be asked.
  • Clear communicator – You articulate ideas clearly, write well, and listen with intent. You create shared understanding.
  • Product-minded – You’re curious about customer needs, ask “why?”, and advocate for solutions that deliver real value.
  • Leads through influence – You raise the bar by mentoring others, setting standards, and sharing knowledge — not by authority.
  • Documentation-first thinker – You value written clarity, and help your team by documenting decisions, code, and processes.

Shift-Left QA Expectation

  • Own test coverage, pipeline health, and regression control

Success Measures

jobs.description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Per Diem - Cedar Falls

Job Location: Work at Home, Iowa, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

12

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$105.00 - $105.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

  • Drive operational excellence by identifying risks, removing barriers, and ensuring effective allocation of scientific resources across projects and accounts.
  • Contribute to business growth through strategic planning, proposal development, client relationship expansion, and new business opportunities.
  • Provide leadership during project challenges, stepping in as needed to guide teams and ensure successful outcomes.
  • Support talent acquisition, onboarding, succession planning, and workforce development initiatives.
  • Represent ENOVA and IQVIA at key client meetings, advisory boards, congresses, and other external engagements.

Qualifications

Required

  • PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent advanced scientific degree.
  • Significant experience in medical affairs, medical communications, the pharmaceutical industry, or a related healthcare environment.
  • Proven success leading and developing scientific teams within a fast-paced, client-focused organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to oversee multiple complex projects and scientific portfolios while maintaining exceptional quality standards.
  • Strong client management and stakeholder engagement experience.
  • Experience leading and influencing cross-functional teams and driving alignment among diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen, including resource planning, operational effectiveness, and organizational growth.
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Attributes

  • Strategic thinker who can translate scientific insights into actionable client solutions.
  • Comfortable operating at both strategic and tactical levels.
  • Effective at influencing without direct authority.
  • Passionate about talent development, scientific excellence, and client success.
  • Thrives in a highly collaborative, matrixed environment.

Travel Requirements

Travel is required for client meetings, advisory boards, congresses, and on-site program support as needed.

Please Note: You must reside within the country where this role is posted to be eligible for this remote job opportunity.

At ENOVA, we combine deep scientific expertise with innovative health communications strategies to help life sciences organizations engage stakeholders, advance healthcare, and improve outcomes. Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are seeking an Associate Account Manager to own the health, retention, and growth of an assigned book of Luma customer accounts. This is a hybrid role that blends renewal ownership with proactive account management: you will manage the full renewal cycle for your named accounts while also identifying and closing expansion opportunities with departmental buyers and smaller research teams. You will work in close partnership with Strategic Account Executives, Customer Success, and the broader sales organization to ensure every customer renews, adopts, and grows with Dotmatics.

This role is for you if you want a defined path from account support and renewal ownership toward a full-cycle Account Executive career, and you can bring enough scientific fluency to speak credibly with bench researchers, lab managers, and departmental decision-makers.

This position requires travel 30%+ for customer meetings, QBRs, and account management activities

In this role you will get to:

Expansion & Independent Sales Ownership

  • Identify and pursue expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including new departments, additional seats, and adjacent Luma products
  • Own the full sales cycle for small to mid-sized expansion opportunities within named accounts (typically <$50K ARR)
  • Conduct needs assessments, build business cases, and deliver compelling proposals for both renewal and expansion motions
  • Achieve or exceed quarterly and annual retention and expansion quotas
  • Work with WW Renewals, where relevant, to ensure renewals are tracked and actioned prior to renewal notice
  • Collaborate with WW Renewals, where relevant, to proactively share account health, Stakeholder feedback and at risk accounts to support the renewals process

Customer Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with scientific researchers, lab managers, and departmental decision-makers
  • Understand customer workflows, pain points, and scientific objectives well enough to speak credibly about ELN, LIMS, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, and data visualization challenges
  • Position Dotmatics solutions to address specific research and data management challenges as part of both renewal conversations and expansion pitches
  • Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure smooth onboarding and continued value realization across the customer lifecycle

Renewal Ownership & Retention

  • Own the end-to-end renewal process for an assigned portfolio of named accounts, from 120-day renewal notice through contract execution
  • Forecast renewal risk and revenue with accuracy, maintaining a rolling view of at-risk, on-track, and expansion-ready accounts
  • Proactively monitor account health signals (usage, adoption, support tickets, stakeholder turnover) and intervene early on accounts showing renewal risk
  • Negotiate renewal terms, pricing, and contract structure within established parameters, escalating complex negotiations as needed
  • Partner with Customer Success to resolve adoption gaps or satisfaction issues before they become renewal risks

Account Support & Collaboration

  • Partner with Strategic Account Executives to support sales activities within named enterprise accounts
  • Collaborate with Presales (Field sales) to conduct product demonstrations and technical discovery calls for prospects and existing customers within assigned accounts
  • Coordinate with field sales teams on account strategies, customer communications, and opportunity progression
  • Maintain accurate CRM records and provide regular updates on renewal status, pipeline activity, and account health

Continuous Learning & Market Intelligence

  • Develop deep product knowledge across the Dotmatics Luma portfolio and stay current on scientific research trends, laboratory informatics challenges, and the competitive landscape
  • Provide market intelligence on customer needs, competitive activity, and industry trends to Sales and Product
  • Participate in regular pipeline and renewal forecast reviews with sales leadership

We are looking forpeople who have at least 4 years of experience in inside sales, renewal management, account management, or sales development, preferably in SaaS, material sciences or technical software, you may also hold a degree in Material or Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific field.

The keys skills

You may also have

  • Familiarity with scientific research workflows and laboratory informatics (ELN, LIMS, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, automation, orchestration)

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

​

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

40

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
