Location: Remote (U.S. based; must be available to work PST/MST hours)

Background Check Requirement

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

About Frontline Wildfire Defense

Founded in 2017 by landscape ecologist and fire mitigation expert Harry Statter, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME’s Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for “Most Innovative Housing Concept” and the Best of IBS Award for “Best Home Technology.”

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We’re building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

About This Opportunity

As a Senior FP&A Analyst at Frontline, you will own the financial models, the 13-week cash flow, and the consolidated reporting that gives leadership a real picture of where the business stands and where it's headed. Frontline operates across multiple entities with three distinct revenue models - milestone-based construction installations, hardware sales, and recurring software subscriptions - each with its own financial dynamics. Pulling that picture together accurately, and communicating it clearly, is the job.

Reporting to the VP of Finance, you will build and maintain the models, own the cash flow forecast, and synthesize data across multiple systems into the KPIs and analysis that drive decisions. This is not a role for someone who runs a model and reports the output. The right person understands the inputs deeply enough to know when the model is missing something - and has the expertise and intellectual rigor to catch it before it reaches leadership.

We use AI tools to accelerate the development of financial models and analysis. What we need from you is not the ability to prompt an AI - it's the financial expertise to know when the output is wrong, what data it didn't account for, and what questions to ask to get it right. That kind of critical thinking, grounded in deep financial knowledge, is what separates meaningful analysis from a fast first draft.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Modeling

  • Build, own, and maintain financial models across revenue, expenses, headcount, and capital - including models that span multiple entities and revenue streams.
  • Develop scenario models and sensitivity analysis that give leadership clear visibility into the financial impact of operational and strategic decisions.
  • Design models that are structurally sound, well-documented, and built to be used and understood by others - not black boxes.

Cash Flow Forecasting

  • Own the 13-week cash flow forecast for a multi-entity company - building it, maintaining it, and communicating what it shows and why it matters.
  • Identify cash flow risks and opportunities proactively, and work with the VP of Finance and Controller to ensure the business has visibility and options.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. As a Metanoia Expeditions Group Leader you will be required to accompany group members on our tours through Asia, Africa & Europe.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

As a Metanoia Expeditions Group Leader you will be required to accompany group members on our tours through Asia, Africa & Europe. You will ultimately be responsible for ensuring that each and every group member has the time of their lives while going over and above to make sure they are comfortable, safe, and happy. You will become everyone’s best friend in the group, be in charge of entertaining, coordinating, guiding, and making sure things go smoothly!

  • You will also continually communicate with the group - managing their expectations, and ensuring they are aware of the day-to-day plans, activities, and movements.
  • At Metanoia Expeditions being a travel ninja is 24/7. We want our leaders to enjoy hanging with the groups in the evenings - showing them the best nightlife and taking them to the best restaurants in the evenings that cater to everyone’s needs.
  • You will be taking part in numerous activities including snorkeling, city tours, viewpoint hikes, boat trips, and a myriad of other things, so you must be reasonably active and not scared to get involved with the activities.
  • There are some admin elements to the job such as coordinating with local partners & drivers, keeping track of expenses, sending welcome emails prior to the trip, staying in contact with groups, engaging on social media, and getting in reviews after the tour (a super important part of the job!)
  • Generally helping to promote Metanoia Expeditions and its products through social media
A Group Leader’s role requires a lot of energy and enthusiasm. You will be required to work abroad independently and fly frequently back and forth.
The position is full time and includes working irregular hours of evening work and weekends. You will be travelling/working up to 220 days a year and You must be available for at least 1 year. No previous Group Leading experience is necessary, although it would be beneficial, and you will receive full training.

Requirements

You must...

  • Be located in Mumbai, Bangalore or Delhi
  • Speak English and Hindi fluently and be able to converse easily in both languages.
  • Have travel experience abroad
  • Enjoy meeting people, be outgoing, energetic and responsible. This role requires a huge amount of energy and can be very tiring at times.
  • Be confident enough to lead a group of up to 20-30 people and communicate with them effectively.
  • Be confident and capable enough to handle the health and safety of your group in, at times, an extremely unpredictable environment and be able to respond accordingly if things go wrong.
  • Be thorough, accurate and timely with all your admin duties.
  • Be outgoing and personable with an enthusiastic attitude and be able to relate to and get along with people from all different walks of life, ages and mindsets.

IMPORTANT: Please read the following BEFORE applying for this job.

Being a Metanoia Expeditions Group leader is an awesome opportunity where you will have unforgettable experiences and make friends and memories to last a lifetime!
However, it will most definitely be a lot harder than you are imagining and there can be downsides to the role which you must be aware of and fully understand and consider before applying;
  • You are not on holiday, your group members are. It is your primary responsibility to make sure their trip is safe, enjoyable and runs as smoothly as possible. You should not apply for the Group Leader role if your sole reason is because you want to travel.
  • You are there to give EVERY single group member the best experience possible. If you can only give that experience to 80% of your Group, then please reconsider your application.
  • People in your group may get sick, suffer culture shock, become emotional, complain a lot or even take a personal dislike to you. You may not get along with particular people. However, you are still expected to do a great job and provide excellent service to your entire group regardless of any of the above.
  • While we make every effort to support you in whatever way we can, you will find yourself in situations where no support is possible (due to the time difference, distance, no coverage etc). You need to be confident in your decision-making skills and ability to think on your feet - and be prepared to deal with the consequences.
  • Our itinerary is fixed and you will be making the same journey repeatedly, which some people might find repetitive or tiring.
  • This job is all about people. You have to be comfortable spending large amounts of time, sharing and living with people of different states, ages and backgrounds.
If you fully understand the above, are serious about becoming a Group Leader and honestly feel you have what it takes then we encourage you to apply ASAP.

Thanks and good luck!

The Metanoia Expeditions Crew

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and proactive Cyber Security Analyst to strengthen our organization's security posture through effective monitoring, threat hunting, endpoint protection, email security, cloud security, vulnerability management, and compliance activities. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with CrowdStrike Falcon EDR, Check Point Harmony Email Security, SIEM platforms, cloud security technologies, and security governance frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Security & Threat Hunting

  • Manage and administer CrowdStrike Falcon EDR platform.

Cloud Security

Job Title: In-Home Nurse Practitioner Part Time - Joplin

Job Location: Work at Home, Missouri, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part-time Nurse Practitioner to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:
  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes
  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs
  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role
  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed
  • Conduct virtual visits as needed
  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Part-time employees qualify for:
  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)
  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)
  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications
  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)
  • Board certification (required)
  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

29.5

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$37.66 - $81.11

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

jobs.excerpt: Windward Consulting is an Elite ServiceNow Partner that delivers real-world Service Reliability solutions using a unique blend of expert process knowledge, technology insight, and deep operational experience.
jobs.description:
Windward Consulting is an Elite ServiceNow Partner that delivers real-world Service Reliability solutions using a unique blend of expert process knowledge, technology insight, and deep operational experience. This combination of skills is grounded in a product- and vendor-agnostic approach that enables Windward to serve as a trusted partner to some of the world’s leading businesses and U.S. government agencies. Since our inception in 1997, Windward has supported over 500 clients worldwide and more than 3,500 projects.
Our dedication to excellence is reflected in our industry-leading metrics. Windward has a Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score of 5.0 and an Employee Net Promoter Score (eNPS) of 82, demonstrating our commitment to both client success and employee engagement. We foster a culture of teamwork, innovation, and ongoing learning—empowering our consultants to tackle complex challenges for innovative clients. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make a difference, Windward is the ideal place to elevate your career.
Windward is seeking a highly skilled and experienced ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM) and Vulnerability Response (VR) Business Process Consultant to play a key role in the successful implementation and adoption of ServiceNow applications across the organization. This role bridges business needs and technical solutions — gathering requirements, defining processes, and working closely with developers, architects, and stakeholders to ensure that the ServiceNow solution aligns with organizational goals and industry best practices for both government and commercial clients. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and exceptional customer-facing skills.
This role combines strong technical expertise in the ServiceNow platform, demonstrated experience in the IRM and VR module, and consulting and implementation skills to deliver high-quality, scalable applications and modules.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage stakeholders to identify, document, and prioritize business requirements for ServiceNow implementations, translating needs into actionable user stories and acceptance criteria.

  • Conduct workshops, interviews, and process mapping sessions to capture current and future workflows, supporting process design and documentation.

  • Collaborate with ServiceNow developers, architects, and platform owners to translate requirements into platform configurations, workflows, and automation, ensuring alignment with best practices and platform capabilities.

  • Support data model, integration, and UI/UX design discussions, and participate in Agile or hybrid delivery activities such as sprint planning, backlog grooming, and user acceptance testing cycles.

  • Ensure delivered solutions meet defined requirements and quality standards, coordinate user acceptance testing, and resolve issues as needed.

  • Serve as the liaison between business units, IT, and the ServiceNow delivery team, providing project updates, status reports, and training sessions as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or related field.

  • 3–5+ years of business analysis experience, with at least 2 years focused on ServiceNow implementations.

  • Demonstrated experience in facilitating requirements gathering via workshops and system/content review, designing processees, and creating user story in an Agile environment.

  • Familiarity with ServiceNow data structures, tables, and workflows

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Understanding of integration points with other enterprise systems (e.g., Tenable, Crowdstrike).

Required Certifications

  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Integrated Risk Management (IRM)
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist - Vulnerability Response (VR)
  • ServiceNow Certified Systems Administrator (CSA)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional ServiceNow certifications in areas such as ITOM or ITSM

Location

  • Remote

We continually strive to create an environment that balances work life and offers benefits that will enhance the compensation package. We offer Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance and AD&D, as well as the option to purchase additional Life Insurance and AD&D, Paid Time Off, Personal Leave, Holidays, 401(k) plan with company match and work/life balance.

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems.
  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.
  • Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions.

Job Summary:

The carbon scientist manages agronomic research and scientific analysis; supports greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting, modelling, regenerative ag practice research and implementation, and Sales and Grower Success Team (GST) technical support. This role bridges applied agronomy, data-driven scientific and carbon program development; supporting carbon market integrity, agronomic and carbon performance of regenerative practices, and program outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

Agronomic Support

  • Provide cross-functional agronomic support and guidance across all teams, ensuring alignment between Science, Data, Modeling, Carbon, GST and Commercial teams. Translate basic and applied research into clear program guidelines, continuous improvements and scalable practice guidance to improve our carbon output
  • Provide technical expertise in range and pasture management, including grazing systems, forage management, soil health, and regenerative grazing practices. Apply this knowledge to support program development, practice guidelines, field implementation, modeling, and carbon outcomes. Candidates with demonstrated experience in range and pasture management are preferred; strong agronomic candidates with the potential and interest to develop into a subject-matter expert in this area will also be considered.
  • Proactively evaluate emerging agronomic practices, technologies, and systems to develop new practice offerings that increase carbon sequestration rates, emissions reductions, and program scalability
  • Lead ongoing evaluation and improvement of agronomic practice guidelines using scientific evidence, field performance data, and modeling insights to maximize carbon yield and credit integrity
  • Continuously working with GST to monitor practice-level data quality, completeness, and consistency, applying agronomic science to identify gaps, risks, or biases and drive improvements in data standards and field-level reporting
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to GST, ensuring training, field visits, and educational resources are scientifically rigorous, practice-aligned, and support carbon credit outcomes
  • Work closely with the modeling team to translate field-level agronomic data into reliable model inputs, proactively addressing data challenges and improving alignment between practice implementation and modeled outcomes
  • Partner with Carbon team and provide agronomic leadership to analyze and resolve Validation and Verification Body (VVB) and Verra findings, including issues related to practice eligibility, data quality, modeling inputs, and scientific justification

Research, Data & Technical Leadership

  • Act as a knowledge hub by regularly updating the company on advances in regenerative agriculture science and technology, fostering continuous learning and improved agronomic decision-making
  • Integrate agronomic science with data analytics, visualization, and reporting to support business success. Support effective communication of complex agronomic and sustainability concepts to farmers, ranchers, and industry partners
  • Attend agronomy and regenerative agriculture conferences to engage with industry experts, identify innovations, and communicate the organization’s scientific achievements
  • Lead preparation of scientific reviews, reports, and white papers based on project outcomes to inform strategy, program development, and external communications.

Background and Training Requirements

  • Education: M.S. or Ph.D. in Soil Science, Rangeland Management, Environmental Science, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in agronomy, regenerative agriculture, agricultural research, soil health, carbon programs, or a related field, with demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and work cross-functionally.
  • Range & Pasture Management: Strong experience in range and pasture management, including grazing systems, forage management, soil health, and regenerative grazing. Candidates with strong agronomic expertise and demonstrated potential to develop into a subject-matter expert in range and pasture systems will also be considered.
  • Carbon & GHG: Working knowledge of agricultural carbon markets, GHG accounting, carbon sequestration, and carbon-credit methodologies. Experience with Verra VCS and VVB processes is highly desirable.
  • Scientific & Analytical Skills: Strong background in applied agronomic research, experimental design, data analysis, scientific interpretation, and translating research into practical field and program recommendations.
  • Modeling & Data: Experience working with agricultural or carbon datasets and models, with the ability to translate field-level information into reliable model inputs and insights.
  • Communication & Leadership: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex science into practical guidance for growers, ranchers, field teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Industry Engagement: Demonstrated ability to stay current with regenerative agriculture and carbon science and represent the organization through technical reports, conferences, presentations, and external engagement.
  • Travel: Approximately 20–30% travel required for field visits, grower and rancher engagement, conferences, research activities, and team meetings

jobs.description:
About Diversified:

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.

What to Expect:

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.

POSITION SUMMARY

Diversified is seeking a VP, Global Supply Chain to lead the global distribution network supporting our AV and Media installation and managed services business, comprising 30 warehouses and 12 forward operating bases across North America, Europe and Australia. This position holds full accountability for the movement of equipment and material from PO tracking, receipt through staging, kitting, deployment to job sites, and reverse logistics on completed projects. The network currently operates on both Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Great Plains, with the international locations on separate ERP systems, supported by manual processes and spreadsheet-based tracking, without a warehouse management system. Operating practices vary across locations, inventory is reconciled manually, and visibility into material in transit is limited. The international locations operate independently of the North American organization, each with its own systems and processes. The Vice President is responsible for both daily operations of the warehouses and the outcome of the modernization program that addresses these conditions. A Manager of Supply Chain Process & Systems reports to this position and leads execution of the modernization work, including WMS selection and implementation, supplier EDI integration, and tracking automation. The Vice President serves as executive sponsor of that program and is accountable for its delivery. Location: Virtual (U.S. Remote)

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Network operations

  • Own operating performance across all warehouse and forward operating base locations globally.
  • The international locations in Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, and Australia are not currently managed as part of a centralized supply chain function. They operate on separate ERP platforms with independent processes, vendor relationships, and inventory practices. This position is responsible for consolidating those locations into a single global function with common standards, reporting, and system direction, while accommodating genuine regional requirements
  • Manage the operating budget, including labor, freight cost, and third-party services, and deliver performance against plan
  • Own headcount planning across all locations, including staffing models by site, use of temporary and contract labor to meet workload demand and span of control
  • Identify and deliver cost reduction across the network, and build the business case for investment where it produces a return
  • Establish and enforce consistent operating standards across sites for shipment tracking, receiving, put-away, cycle counting, staging, kitting, pick/pack, shipping, returns, and RMA handling
  • Define the performance measurement framework for the network, including inventory accuracy, on-time staging to project schedule, dock-to-stock cycle time, shrink, cost per shipment, space utilization, and labor productivity. Several of these metrics are not currently tracked and will require definition and baselining
  • Partner with Technical Operations to align material delivery with installation schedules
  • Evaluate and recommend network footprint decisions in partnership with regional Tech Ops leadership, including forward operating base openings, consolidations, and closures based on project density and service-level requirements

Inventory control

  • Establish inventory accuracy as a managed metric, transitioning from periodic physical audits to ongoing cycle counting
  • Implement controls over customer-owned, project-allocated, and company-owned inventory, including serialized asset tracking
  • Reduce excess, obsolete, and unallocated inventory and establish the review cadence to maintain reductions
  • Own reconciliation between physical inventory and financial records in partnership with Finance

Program sponsorship

  • Hold accountability for the business outcomes of the warehouse modernization initiative, which is executed by the Manager of Warehouse/Inventory Process & Systems in partnership with Business Systems
  • Approve the operating design underlying the program, recognizing that process standardization decisions are operational rather than technical
  • Provide the organizational authority required for adoption, including directing site leaders to implement new processes and resolving conflicts between local preference and network standards
  • Ensure program resourcing is maintained and that reallocation of program capacity to operational demands occurs only through deliberate tradeoff decisions
  • Co-own the investment request and business case and present to the EVP and Finance
  • Escalate and resolve supplier and carrier performance issues affecting integration commitments

Commercial and vendor management

  • Manage carrier, 3PL, and warehouse lease relationships, including rate negotiation, performance scorecards, and service recovery
  • Own cross-border logistics, customs, duty, and trade compliance for international movement of equipment, in partnership with Finance and Legal
  • Own supplier relationships at the escalation level, including data quality and ASN compliance commitments

Leadership and organizational development

  • Lead a globally distributed team of warehouse managers, supervisors, inventory specialists, and logistics coordinators across North America, Europe, and Australia
  • Define roles, establish performance standards, and develop site leadership capable of operating to company standards without central oversight
  • Lead the organization through process and system change, including management of resistance to transitioning away from established manual practices
  • Develop the Manager of Supply Chain Process & Systems toward expanded supply chain leadership responsibility

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 12+ years in supply chain, distribution, or logistics, including 5+ years leading multi-site operations preferably across more than one country or region
  • Experience managing a multi-site operating budget and headcount plan, including labor models, flexible staffing, and cost performance against plan
  • Demonstrated record of standardizing operations across locations previously managed independently
  • Experience as business sponsor or owner of a systems implementation such as WMS, ERP, or TMS. Technical configuration experience is not required; accountability for adoption and business outcomes is
  • Working knowledge of ERP-driven distribution operations; Microsoft Dynamics 365 familiarity preferred
  • Experience operating in a multi-ERP environment, including consolidation, harmonization, or migration of disparate systems
  • Experience building and presenting business cases and operating results to executive leadership
  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business, engineering, or equivalent experience

Preferred

  • Project-based distribution experience in AV, low-voltage, construction, telecommunications, or comparable industries where material flows to job sites on scheduled installation dates
  • Forward operating base, field depot, or field staging model experience
  • Experience managing distribution operations in Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, or Australia, including cross-border compliance, customs, and VAT or duty considerations
  • Serialized asset and customer-owned inventory management
  • Experience integrating distribution operations following acquisition

What We Offer:

We believe great people deserve great benefits. In addition to competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and work-life balance:

  • Multiple medical plan options to fit you and your family’s needs

◦ HSA & HRA company contributions

Company-paid benefits ◦ Basic Life, AD&D ◦ Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance ◦ Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity:

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise.

The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculations, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts.

This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana Cloud scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana Labs also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope.

What You’ll Be Doing:

The Usage squad owns the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations and customer usage calculations. Our domain encompasses maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, cost management and billing applications, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the customer user portal.

Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. We build full-stack web applications, customer portals, backend services, APIs, and data integrations across internal Grafana platforms and third-party systems like NetSuite and Salesforce. When this domain works well, customers get clear usage visibility, reliable billing, and seamless account management workflows. This role is about 75% FrontEnd and 25% BackEnd.

  • Design, build, operate, and evolve reliable full-stack web applications, customer-facing account portals, and backend services that power core customer usage and billing workflows
  • Build and maintain backend APIs (Golang, Node.js) and intuitive user interfaces using modern frontend technologies (TypeScript, React)
  • Design and maintain integrations between Grafana systems and external business platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, and cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Develop and automate business logic for customer usage metering, pricing structures, promotions, and billing reconciliation
  • Collaborate across product management, DealOps, GTM, Support, and adjacent AppCore squads to deliver robust end-to-end features
  • Address technical debt, optimize CI/CD pipelines, strengthen test coverage, and improve system observability and operational resilience
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while shaping pragmatic solutions for complex systems challenges
  • Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations
  • You will help own the production behavior of the systems you build. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks

What Makes You a Great Fit:

At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. We encourage our engineers to thoughtfully leverage AI tools to enhance every stage of the lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, documentation, and operations. We also look for strategic opportunities to embed agentic capabilities within our services to eliminate toil, bolster reliability, and ensure that complex customer workflows remain resilient and safe.

We are seeking a Staff FullStack Engineer who thrives on building production systems where correctness, scalability, and user experience are paramount. As a remote-first organization, you should be comfortable collaborating asynchronously across time zones and taking full ownership of the critical systems powering Grafana Cloud. Our team is small and operates with a high degree of independence; you will be expected to lead major projects, coordinate across service boundaries, and help define the technical direction for our domain.

You will be particularly successful in this role if you enjoy solving challenges related to stateful systems, eventual consistency, and reconciliation loops. We value engineers who can take ambiguous lifecycle requirements and transform them into explicit, modular solutions. You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams.

  • You are willing to work across teams. Your work has to be aligned with the needs of other squads and external stakeholders. You make your plans transparent, bring stakeholders on board, and are open to feedback and suggestions
  • Strong Kubernetes experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.)

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining integrations with third-party business systems (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Cloud Marketplaces)
  • Experience with frontend component libraries, design systems, and modern CSS-in-JS tooling

  • Experience working on SaaS provisioning, tenancy, regional expansion, plugin rollout, or customer lifecycle systems

jobs.title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

jobs.description:
The Role

Moderna continues to expand its innovative mRNA platform, unlocking new applications across diseases and therapeutic areas. As the company advances its oncology pipeline, including intismeran autogene, a personalized investigational mRNA therapy being developed in collaboration with Merck, this role will play a critical part in preparing for the potential launch of Moderna’s first commercial therapeutic in oncology.

Moderna’s intismeran autogene (INT) program represents an exciting advancement in personalized cancer treatment, leveraging the power of mRNA technology to develop therapies tailored to each patient’s unique tumor profile. This innovative approach has the potential to redefine the future of cancer care and marks a significant milestone in Moderna’s evolution beyond infectious diseases. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the commercial launch of a pioneering oncology program and play a foundational role in building Moderna’s oncology business.

Moderna is seeking a Sr. Director, Regional Sales, West, who will build, lead, and develop the West Region Oncology Sales team to drive regional sales strategy and execution for a co-promoted solid tumor oncology asset. This role is accountable for regional sales performance, oncology launch excellence, performance management and field execution across complex account ecosystems, while partnering closely with an alliance partner. The role requires deep expertise in oncology, and knowledge of account dynamics, experience building high performing teams, strong communication skills, analytical skills, ability to execute while partnering closely with the alliance, as well as proven leadership in a launch environment. This position is also responsible for building key business relationships with multi-disciplinary stakeholders across key health systems, accounts and large practice networks.

You combine strong sales and people leadership expertise with deep oncology knowledge and are comfortable partnering with alliance or other matrix partners to drive solutions that are best for patients and business. You are a collaborative thinker who thrives in complex, cross-functional environments and brings a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

Candidates based in California or Colorado are preferred.

Here’s What You’ll Do

  • Establish and lead the West Region Oncology Sales team, recruiting and developing sales professionals to deliver on sales goals and performance KPIs through effective product communication, execution of brand strategy, and collaboration with internal and alliance partners.
  • Develop and execute regional strategic account plans that leverage market insights to strengthen customer relationships, achieve sales targets, and facilitate growth within targeted accounts to support the successful launch of intismeran.
  • Collaborate internally and with our alliance partner to ensure effective, coordinated engagement of key accounts, and account leadership, compliantly tailoring the brand strategy to influence value drivers within each account.
  • Expertise in clinical data, disease state, and account management to provide direction to the field team and insights to the commercial organization.
  • Identify market trends and opportunities and proactively communicate with Oncology leadership.
  • Develop a high-performance culture by consistently providing coaching, performance management, and ongoing development for field teams.
  • Lead from the front through the frequent engagement of customers while partnering with the sales team exemplifying the skills, behaviors and attitude required to be successful by selling an innovative product in a complex environment and creating a culture of continuous learning and development.
  • Use data and digital tools to prioritize opportunities and monitor field performance, adapting quickly to emerging trends or needs.
  • Represent Moderna at high-level external engagements, including conferences, scientific forums, and engagements with key oncology stakeholders.
  • Partner as a peer with cross-functional leads across Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and the alliance ensuring a high level of communication and coordination to foster a positive customer experience.
  • Manage and deploy resources to ensure the achievement of objectives and manage regional budgets to ensure appropriate utilization of funds.
  • Ensure full compliance with Moderna policies and all applicable healthcare laws and regulations.

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s Degree required·
  • Minimum of 10 years of pharmaceutical/biotech commercial experience, with demonstrated experience in oncology and field account strategy
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience leading oncology sales teams
  • Ability to travel up to 75%
  • Must reside within the assigned geographic region

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leading product launches in oncology
  • Prior experience in melanoma is highly preferred
  • Experience successfully launching and executing in an alliance relationship is highly preferred.
  • Proven experience building high performing teams
  • Deep knowledge of key customer types including academic, community, IDN, and GPO affiliated oncology programs
  • Demonstrated background leading teams focused on account management while selling complex products and engaging multiple account stakeholders and specialties
  • Experience working in a solution oriented, dynamic, startup environment
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with cross function partners to ensure the appropriate coordinated engagement of all account types
  • Proven ability to utilize market knowledge and analytics to drive regional strategies, effective targeting, and achievement of sales goals
  • Fluency in data-driven decision-making and CRM utilization for field strategy
  • High adaptability, solution-oriented mindset, comfort operating in ambiguity and a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape
  • Exceptional interpersonal, leadership, communication and influencing skills
  • A desire to make an impact as part of a high-growth, transformational company that is Bold, Relentless, Curious, and Collaborative

Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
  • A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
  • Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
  • Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
  • Location-specific perks and extras

The salary range for this role is $196,700.00 - $353,400.00(for positions that may be performed in California, the expected salary range is $288,300.00 - $331,700.00, which reflects the range permitted under California Labor Code requirements) . This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. ABOUT THE ROLE

You will join our Data Science team as a Data Scientist working at the applied-research end of computer vision. You will frame open-ended problems as testable hypotheses, develop prototypes to validate them, and choose the model architectures and methods best suited to each. Computer vision is the core domain, with scope to work across text, audio, and tabular data. Working with ML Engineers, you will help take validated prototypes into production and see them run at scale.
Even if you don't meet every requirement, your skills and ability to deliver impact are what matter most.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Design and prototype ML and deep learning models, with computer vision as the primary domain (object detection, classification, tracking).
  • Frame business problems as testable hypotheses and develop proofs-of-concept to validate them, iterating on the results.
  • Evaluate and benchmark competing model architectures and pre-trained models to identify the best-fit approach.
  • Collaborate with ML Engineers to scale validated prototypes into production systems and stay engaged through deployment.
  • Track experiments, manage model and data versioning, and define evaluation metrics to compare approaches objectively.
  • Work with product, engineering, and business teams to turn objectives into applied ML solutions.

WHAT WE ASK OF YOU

  • Master's degree in a relevant field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Hands-on experience developing ML and deep learning models, including demonstrated computer vision work.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and a deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Experience with computer vision models for object detection, image classification, and tracking.
  • Solid grounding in deep learning, traditional computer vision, and classical ML.
  • Strong experimentation mindset: benchmarking, ablation studies, and structured evaluation of competing approaches.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets.

Nice to have

  • Experience collaborating with ML Engineers to bring models into production.
  • Experience with any major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) for ML training and deployment.
  • Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, vision transformers, or self-supervised / representation learning.
  • Exposure to generative AI: prompt engineering, RAG, LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack), or LLM fine-tuning.
  • Background in gaming, iGaming, e-commerce, or other consumer-facing applications at scale.

How we work

Our stack includes Python with PyTorch and TensorFlow, experiment tracking and model versioning, containerized deployment with Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Data Scientists and ML Engineers work together across the full lifecycle, from early research through to models running in production.

WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE

  • Work on substantial, real-world computer vision and deep learning problems at scale.
  • End-to-end involvement, from research and prototyping through to production.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A collaborative, cross-functional environment with visible impact.

jobs.excerpt: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive.
jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are looking for an experienced market leader, thought leader and SME in Lab Automation and Orchestration.
Lab automation is where science meets engineering. Robotics, liquid handlers, instruments, and scheduling software are moving labs from manual work toward automated, data driven, and eventually autonomous operation. While we are supporting fully automated labs, most labs still run as islands. Instruments speak different languages, workflows are hard to change, and the data that comes off the line rarely arrives ready for analysis or AI.

We’re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. Lab Orchestration and automation are core to our Molecule to Market story, and they connect directly to the strengths of Siemens in industrial automation. We need someone to own the market strategy for it.

This is a customer and market facing role. You’ll spend real time with lab automation leaders at pharma, biotech, CDMOs, and research institutes across the UK and Europe, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You’ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to the lab automation market with confidence and one consistent story. You’ll work with industry thought leaders to shape the conversation on autonomous labs and AI. Your job is to drive software adoption and AI use cases in lab automation. You will shape where we play, who we sell to, how we position, and how we win.

How you’ll spend your time

  • Customer engagements: meeting automation leaders, scientists, and engineers, joining pursuits, and bringing what you hear back to the business
  • Market analysis: sizing segments, tracking competitors and automation vendors, and spotting trends early
  • Sales enablement: giving teams across regions the talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and proof points to win
  • Solution marketing: partnering with the Siemens Solution Marketing team on content, campaigns, events, and messaging for the lab automation audience
  • Thought leadership: working with industry thought leaders, inside and outside Siemens, to shape the conversation on self driving labs and the future of the automated lab
  • Adoption and AI use cases: identifying, proving, and spreading the use cases that get labs running on Luma and putting AI to work on automated workflows and data
  • Partner and ecosystem engagement: working with instrument makers, robotics providers, and integrators so our joint story is clear to customers
  • Cross organization alignment: working across Siemens DISW and DI Automation teams so we show up as one company with one story for the lab automation market

The goal is simple. Drive excellence in how we represent ourselves to lab automation buyers, and turn that into real software adoption.

What you’ll do

  • Own the market strategy for Luma in lab automation, including workflow orchestration, scheduling, instrument integration, data capture, and autonomous lab concepts
  • Define target segments, buyer personas, and priority accounts, including Heads of Lab Automation, Automation Engineers, Discovery Technologies, Research IT, Core Facilities, and Operations leaders
  • Build positioning and messaging that speaks to automation engineers, scientists, IT leaders, and executives
  • Drive software adoption by working with customers and field teams to find the workflows where Luma delivers value fastest, and by capturing what works so others can repeat it
  • Define and prove AI use cases for lab automation, including closed loop experimentation, smarter scheduling, and data prepared for tools like NVIDIA BioNeMo
  • Translate automation pain points into clear value, including less integration work, faster workflow changes, better use of instruments, trusted data, and a clear path from automation islands to connected labs
  • Partner with the Siemens Solution Marketing team to build content, campaigns, and events for the lab automation market
  • Work with industry thought leaders, analysts, and partners to build credibility and bring outside voices into our story
  • Create the competitive view against other informatics vendors, scheduling and orchestration tools, automation vendors, and in house builds
  • Develop the business case, pricing inputs, and value story with Finance and Sales
  • Equip global teams with talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and customer proof points
  • Partner with DISW and DI Automation teams to align messaging, joint offers, and customer conversations
  • Partner with Product on roadmap priorities based on what automation teams tell us
  • Connect lab automation to the bigger Molecule to Market narrative, including ELN, Biologics, and Tech Transfer
  • Support strategic pursuits and executive conversations with customers and partners
  • Track market trends, including autonomous labs, AI driven discovery, robotics, and data standards, and turn them into action

We are looking for people who have 10 or more years in life sciences, lab automation, or scientific technology, with hands on experience in a pharma, biotech, CDMO, research institute, or automation vendor setting. You will bring Strong analytical skills, including sizing markets and building a business case excellent writing and presentation skills. Ideally holding a degree in life sciences, engineering, robotics, or a related field, with a Masters or PhD a plus

The key skills

  • Deep understanding of how automated labs work day to day, including liquid handling, robotics, instrument integration, workflow scheduling, and the data that flows from them
  • Knowledge of how automation leaders make decisions, balance speed, cost, and flexibility, and work with scientists, IT, and engineering teams
  • Experience in product marketing, market strategy, product management, or commercial roles at a software, automation, informatics, or life sciences solutions company
  • Familiarity with scheduling and orchestration software, LIMS, ELN, or lab data platforms
  • A track record of driving software adoption, or of turning new technology such as AI into use cases customers actually adopt
  • Proven ability to turn complex science and technology into clear, simple messaging
  • Comfort working with senior leaders, industry experts, and customers
  • Ability to work across a large, global, matrixed organisation and build trust with teams in different regions and business units
  • Right to work in the UK

Nice to have

  • Experience running or supporting a lab automation team or an automated lab build
  • Knowledge of industrial automation concepts and how they apply to the lab
  • Familiarity with lab data standards and open interfaces
  • Experience with AI, machine learning, or data platforms in a scientific setting
  • Existing relationships with industry thought leaders, analysts, automation vendors, or research institutes
  • Experience working across the UK and European life sciences community

What success looks like

  • A clear lab automation market strategy adopted by Sales, Product, Services, and Solution Marketing
  • Messaging and sales tools that teams around the world actually use
  • One consistent story for lab automation across Dotmatics, DISW, and DI Automation
  • Growing software adoption and a library of proven AI use cases in lab automation
  • Industry voices who help tell our story
  • Growing pipeline and wins tied to lab automation
  • Automation leaders who can say, in their own words, why Luma helps them connect their labs and move toward autonomous operation

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

Position Title: Court Interpreter
Department: Judicial Services
Reports To: Court Administrator or Designated Supervisor
Position Summary:
The Court Interpreter provides essential interpretation services to non-English speaking or hearing-impaired individuals in judicial settings. They play a pivotal role in ensuring that these individuals fully understand their rights, the court proceedings, and any communications from court officials.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Interpretation Services
Accurately interpret oral statements from one language into another in real-time during court proceedings.
Render a complete and accurate interpretation or translation without omitting, adding to, or altering the intended meaning.
Interpret for witnesses, defendants, plaintiffs, attorneys, judges, and other court personnel.
Document Translation
Translate written legal documents, including court notices, legal forms, and evidence.
Ensure the translated documents retain the original meaning and adhere to the court's requirements.
Maintain Confidentiality
Adhere to a strict code of ethics and maintain the confidentiality of all court-related information.
Avoid conflicts of interest and disclose any potential conflicts.
Continuous Learning
Stay updated on legal terminologies, court procedures, and the ethical guidelines of the profession.
Attend periodic trainings and workshops to enhance interpretation skills.
Cultural Sensitivity
Display awareness of cultural differences and nuances to ensure unbiased and respectful communication.
Provide insight into cultural backgrounds when necessary to aid in court proceedings.
Administrative Tasks
Coordinate and schedule interpretation sessions.
Maintain accurate records of interpretation services provided.

Requirements

jobs.description:
Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto.

Liderar la estrategia global de marketing, comunicación y marca de Marketing Collection, consolidando su posicionamiento como empresa referente en la representación de marcas de turismo de lujo en LATAM. Será responsable de construir una marca sólida, generar visibilidad, engagement y oportunidades de negocio tanto con agencias como con marcas. Este rol combina visión estratégica, sensibilidad estética, liderazgo de equipo y orientación a resultados.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

1. Estrategia global de marketing

  • Diseñar e implementar el plan estratégico de marketing alineado con los objetivos de la empresa y el roadmap comercial.
  • Supervisar su ejecución en los diferentes países y canales, asegurando coherencia y rendimiento.

2. Gestión de marca (Brand Strategy)

  • Definir y custodiar la identidad de marca de Marketing Collection: visión, misión, valores y narrativa visual.
  • Supervisar la aplicación de la marca en todos los puntos de contacto: redes, web, presentaciones, eventos, brochures, emailings, etc.
  • Inspirar una experiencia de marca coherente, atractiva y emocionalmente conectada con agencias y marcas.

3. Posicionamiento y comunicación externa

  • Elevar el posicionamiento de MC como socio estratégico de confianza para marcas de turismo de lujo.

• Aumentar la presencia redes sociales

  • Dirigir campañas institucionales y tácticas (búsqueda de marcas, fidelización de agencias, awareness general).

4. Campañas y generación de leads

  • Diseñar e implementar campañas digitales para generación de leads B2B (marcas y agencias).
  • Liderar estrategias de inbound marketing, email marketing, paid media y alianzas.
  • Analizar resultados y optimizar las campañas en función del rendimiento.

5. Investigación de mercado y competencia

  • Investigar tendencias del sector, oportunidades de diferenciación y percepciones del mercado.
  • Detectar insights para la mejora del storytelling y la propuesta de valor de MC.

6. Liderazgo de equipo y cultura

  • Coordinar, acompañar y desarrollar al equipo de marketing.
  • Fomentar una cultura de iniciativa, responsabilidad y trabajo en equipo.
  • Delegar con claridad, empoderar y dar seguimiento a cada miembro del equipo.

7. Eventos y ecosistema

  • Participar en la planificación estratégica y comunicación de los eventos propios.
  • Diseñar materiales, storytelling, notas de prensa y cobertura digital de eventos.

8. Medición y reporting

  • Establecer KPIs claros de rendimiento de marketing.
  • Reportar avances y resultados al comité ejecutivo.

  • +5 años en roles de liderazgo en marketing estratégico y marca.
