jobs.title: Regulatory Specialist 2
jobs.excerpt: Position Title:This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations.
jobs.description:
Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.
  • Supports regulatory aspects of the quality system and product non-conformities and leads assigned corrective and preventive action activities.
  • Front-room participation in internal audits. Back-room participation in external audits.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and may not necessarily comprise all essential functions.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED AND/OR PREFERRED:

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline, preferably in regulatory, engineering, or biological science plus 3 or more years of relevant experience; in lieu of degree, 5 or more years of relevant experience may suffice.
  • RAC certification(s) a plus

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

Technical Competencies

  • Computer Skills - Skilled with computers, takes advantage of new technology, learns new tools quickly, uses technology to enhance job performance
  • Budget - Uses resources efficiently, strives to reduce cost
  • Innovation - Creative, offers new ideas, amenable to change, risk taker
  • Job Knowledge - Understands facets of job, aware of duties and responsibilities, keeps job knowledge current. Strong understanding of other functional items including product development, design controls and risk management. Strong understanding of medical terminology, regulations, and guidelines related to medical devices and quality systems including FDA’s Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), MDD 93/42/EEC, MDR 2017/745, and ISO 13485.
  • Organization Skills - Information organized and accessible, maintains efficient workspace, manages time well
  • Product Expertise - Knows product features, understands marketplace, shares expertise with others
  • Professional Development - Seeks to identify one’s self-improvement opportunities at work and takes appropriate action to address
  • Project Management - Monitors status of projects, thoroughly deals with project details, holds project owners accountable, delivers clear, accurate depiction of status
  • Quality - Strives to eliminate errors, accurate work is a priority, seeks opportunities to improve product/services
  • Technical Skills - Maintains understanding of technical processes/equipment, uses technology to increase performance/productivity

Behavioral & Basic Skill Competencies

  • Adaptability - Adapts to change, open to new ideas and responsibilities
  • Communication – Communicates proficiently (written and verbal), delivers presentations, has good listening skills
  • Conflict Management - Good listener, committed to finding solution to problems, works well with difficult people
  • Customer Focus - Working cooperatively with internal and external customers in a manner that demonstrates a clear commitment to their needs and success
  • Decision Making - Able to reach decisions, takes thoughtful approach when considering options, seeks input from others, makes difficult decisions
  • Dependability - Meets deadlines, works independently, accountable, maintains focus, punctual, good attendance record
  • Details – High attention to detail
  • Ethics - Honest, accountable, maintains confidentiality
  • Initiative - Takes action, seeks new opportunities, strives to see projects to completion
  • Interpersonal Skills - Builds strong relationships, is flexible/adaptable, works well with others, solicits feedback
  • Problem Solving/Critical Thinking - Strives to understands contributing factors, works to resolve complex situations
  • Productivity - Manages workload, works efficiently, meets goals and objectives
  • Results Driven - Defines appropriate goals, works toward achieving goals, articulates vision and steps for achievement.
  • Results/Productivity - Working in a productive, dependable, and efficient manner to produce high quality results in accordance with deadlines and other expectations.
  • Self-Development - Looks for opportunities to increase knowledge, works to increase responsibility, strives to achieve personal goals
  • Sense of Urgency - Meets deadlines, establishes appropriate priority, gets the job done in a timely manner, able to work under pressure
  • Strategic Thought - Works to establish and articulate visions, shows creativity when defining solutions
  • Teamwork - Demonstrating high levels of teamwork and ability to work cross-functionally

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

What we are seeking – Farsi Linguists to support the federal and local law enforcement community by providing real time translation services in a fast-paced environment.
Job Summary:
Linguist is responsible for performing real-time translations or sensitive material from a foreign language into English; collecting, analyzing, identifying, and decoding of colloquialisms and slang terms; Extracting pertinent information and communicating that information to law enforcement agent(s). Linguist is responsible for transcribing and translating source documents and recordings from storage media, including but not limited to audio files, video files or digital media.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES​
  • Listens to oral intercepts in English or Foreign language and provides verbal and written synopsis. Linguist is responsible for relating all pertinent information to the Client.
  • Contribute to the master list of slang words and codes (used by that group/organization) for the duration of the project/case.
  • Maintains a voice library for the duration of the project.
  • During inactive or low periods of activity, transcribes and translates pertinent calls, other audio files and electronic messages assigned by their supervisor.
  • Produce court ready transcriptions and translations of pertinent calls following the required format.
  • Responsible for using the various reference tools created during the project
  • Ability to transcribe and translate a minimum of 18 - 22 minutes of recorded conversation in an 8-hour day.
  • Operates specialized translation equipment provided by the government to include JSI voice box, Pen-link, Comverse, and other communication collection equipment used at their assigned site.
  • Maintain a daily log of productivity.
  • Duties are performed via a government approved computer system. Employees are required to possess strong computer skills in MS Word and Excel.
  • Perform related duties as assigned, within your scope of practice.

Requirements

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree AND three (3) years’ experiences in a professional setting OR Associate degree AND five (5) years’ experiences in a professional setting OR a High School Diploma AND seven (7) years of experience.
  • U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Must have knowledge of source language colloquial terms and expressions.
  • Knowledgeable is SMS language, social media and Webchat.
  • Must be able to obtain a law enforcement sensitive clearance
  • Demonstrates excellent verbal and written skills in both the source and target language, including correct and accurate grammar, punctuation, and spelling.
  • Must be able to obtain an ALTA Language certificate in Foreign Language and English
  • Must possess strong computer skills in MS Office, including Microsoft Word and Excel; PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • Requires strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with different departments within the company, employees and with clients.
  • Ability to take technical direction and feedback from various sources.
  • Must be able to identify and escalate non-technical issues to Operations Supervisor, Field and Site Supervisors and Team Leads in a timely and effective manner
  • Committed to providing outstanding customer service and representing TE in a Professional manner.
  • Requires the ability to prioritize work, meet stringent deadlines, balance multiple tasks and work in a team environment.
  • Must be able to testify based on completed work product
  • Ability to translate/transcribe 18-22 minutes of recorded conversation in an 8/hour day when performing Linguist duties.
  • Ability to type 45 WPM
  • Available to work a minimum of 32 hours per week.
  • Must be available to work a flexible schedule, to include nights, weekends, and holidays
  • Must be available to work a minimum of 32 consecutive labor hours per week, 8 hours per shift, when assigned to local projects
CLEARANCE:
Applicants selected may be subject to a government background investigation and may be required to meet the following conditions of employment.
SECURITY REQUIREMENTS:
  • Ability to obtain/maintain a Security Clearance
  • Favorable credit check for all cleared positions
  • Successfully pass a background investigation, medical and drug screen.
  • Applicants selected will be subject to a government background investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  • Must be a U.S Citizen or Permanent Resident
  • Residency requirement -3 consecutive years in the last 5 years.
Physical Requirements/Working Conditions:
Standing/Walking/Mobility: Must have mobility to attend meetings with other managers and employees.
Climbing/Stooping/Kneeling: 0% - 10% of the time.
Lifting/Pulling/Pushing: 0% - 10% of the time.
Fingering/Grasping/Feeling: Must be able to write, type and use a telephone system 100% of the time.
Sitting: 90% to 95% of the time.

jobs.description:
Senior Key Account Manager

Department:

Commercial Operations & Global Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning

Reports To:

Director, Commercial Operations & Global Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning

Location:

Remote option or onsite in either Marquette, MI or Bethlehem, PA (travel to sites and customers quarterly, approx. 20%)

FLSA Status:

Exempt

MAIN FUNCTION

The Senior Key Account Manager holds primary ownership of Exalta's most strategically significant original equipment manufacturer (OEM) accounts, serving as the senior customer-facing leader within the Commercial Operations team. This role requires substantial prior customer-facing experience within the OEM industry — medical device OEM experience strongly preferred — combined with demonstrated judgment managing complex, multi-site customer relationships at the executive level. The Senior Key Account Manager owns the customer Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cadence for assigned strategic accounts, serves as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues, and partners directly with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to translate customer demand into the SIOP process. The role also carries responsibility for mentoring and developing Key Account Managers, strengthening the team's account strategy and execution. This position is designed to build the next generation of commercial leadership within a vertically integrated medical device manufacturing environment.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end commercial relationship for Exalta's most strategically significant OEM accounts, serving as the senior point of contact across multiple product lines, programs, and sites.
  • Lead the customer S&OP cadence for assigned strategic accounts, driving rollout, phased maturity, and ongoing governance in partnership with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP.
  • Develop account-level strategic plans that align customer growth expectations with Exalta's capacity and operational constraints.
  • Represent Commercial Operations in executive-level customer business reviews, contract discussions, and new program launch conversations.

SIOP Integration & Demand Ownership

  • Serve as the senior demand data owner for assigned strategic accounts within the SIOP process; validate and reconcile the highest-exposure forecast inputs ahead of the monthly demand review gate.
  • Own forecast accuracy performance for the largest accounts in the portfolio, identify variance drivers, and present trends into the SIOP executive alignment as needed.
  • Partner with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to ensure customer demand inputs are reflected accurately in the SIOP demand plan, surfacing capacity risk early.
  • Support new product introduction onboarding for strategic account programs, coordinating across quality, planning, and operations at the program level.

Escalation & Customer Experience Ownership

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues across assigned strategic accounts, providing strategic direction rather than case-level handling.
  • Own root-cause resolution for significant service disruptions, partnering with planning, supply chain, and quality to protect delivery commitments.
  • Drive proactive, executive-level communication with customers on constraint impacts, delays, or substitutions.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Mentor and coach Key Account Managers on account strategy, escalation handling, and demand data ownership.
  • Provide the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP with structured input on Key Account Manager performance, account coverage, and development needs.
  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer for new Key Account Management team members.

Analytics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Own KPI reporting for the Key Account Management team, consolidating on-time delivery, backorder, and fill rate performance across the portfolio.
  • Identify systemic trends across accounts and lead continuous improvement initiatives in customer operations, demand management, and order fulfillment workflows.
  • Contribute to ERP (Epicor) and Power BI reporting enhancements supporting Commercial Operations and SIOP objectives.
  • Ensure all customer-facing operations comply with FDA, ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and company quality standards.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Customer Focus — advanced ability to build and sustain executive-level relationships with OEM customers.
  • Leadership and Mentorship — proven ability to guide and develop Key Account Managers.
  • Business Acumen — strong understanding of OEM contract manufacturing economics, capacity constraints, and account profitability drivers.
  • Conflict Resolution and Negotiation — expertise managing complex, high-stakes customer issues to resolution.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking — ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account strategy.
  • Communication — executive-level written and verbal communication skills, able to represent Exalta credibly with customer Director- and Vice President-level stakeholders.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of large, complex OEM accounts simultaneously, balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day delivery commitments.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Exalta professionally in high-visibility customer settings.
  • Advanced analytical ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account-level strategy and risk mitigation.
  • Proven skill mentoring and developing less experienced team members.
  • Collaborative working style with a demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional follow-through at senior levels.
  • Deep familiarity with demand planning, Sales and Operations Planning processes, and customer order management.
  • Proficiency in enterprise resource planning systems (Epicor preferred), Microsoft Excel (advanced), and Power BI or equivalent reporting tools.

REQUIRED / PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field required; Master's degree a plus.
  • Minimum of five years of direct, customer-facing experience within the OEM industry required; medical device OEM or contract manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or supporting a formal Sales and Operations Planning or Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning cadence with strategic accounts.
  • Prior experience mentoring, coaching, or informally leading account management team members preferred.
  • Experience navigating FDA-regulated or ISO 13485 quality environments strongly preferred.
  • Epicor enterprise resource planning experience preferred; exposure to order management or demand planning modules is an advantage.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position operates in a professional office environment with periodic interaction with manufacturing and warehouse functions. Travel to customer sites and offices may be required (approximately 20%, generally on a quarterly cadence). Must be able to maintain composure and professionalism in high-visibility, executive-level customer escalation scenarios.

This is a remote position.

Team Lead — High Performing Departments

Remote | Competitive Monthly Wage

About the Role

Fusion Growth Partners is seeking an experienced Team Lead to oversee one of our high-performing production departments. This is a leadership-first role: you will not be hired to personally produce the work, but to manage, coach, and hold accountable the team that does.

Depending on your background, you may lead a team specializing in:

  • Graphic Design & Branding
  • Email Campaigns
  • Database Management
  • Social Media Content & Scheduling
  • Website Development & Maintenance

While each department has its own tools and technical demands, every Team Lead at Fusion is measured the same way: on their ability to manage people, manage volume, and manage deadlines. This is a management role first — subject-matter expertise is what determines which team you lead, not whether you're qualified to lead one.

About Us

Fusion Growth Partners is a business incubator and micro-venture capital company that invests in small service-based businesses and real estate professionals, helping them scale their clientele, systems, and profitability. Our "Partnership as a Service" model earned us recognition as the 813th fastest-growing company in America by Inc. 5000, and we now have more than 300 team members worldwide.

We operate in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment where every task matters and every day brings shifting priorities. If you're a natural leader who stays composed under pressure and knows how to get a team to hit tight deadlines without sacrificing quality, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of specialists in your assigned department
  • Conduct regular quality reviews and deliver actionable, specific feedback
  • Assist with interviewing, onboarding, and training new team members
  • Set performance standards and hold the team accountable to them
  • Serve as the first point of escalation for time-sensitive issues

Production & Workflow Management

  • Manage a high-volume pipeline with multiple competing priorities and deadlines
  • Triage incoming requests and allocate work based on urgency and team capacity
  • Monitor workload distribution to ensure timely, consistent delivery
  • Build, document, and refine SOPs and workflows for your department
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement fixes that improve turnaround time

Quality Control & Standards

  • Review deliverables for accuracy, consistency, and brand alignment before they go out
  • Identify recurring quality issues and address them with targeted training, not just correction
  • Maintain the department's standards even as volume and headcount grow

Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Track key performance metrics and report progress to leadership
  • Work with project managers and other department leads to keep priorities aligned
  • Communicate risks and recommendations clearly and proactively

Requirements

Required

  • 2+ years of experience directly leading or managing a team — not just senior-level individual contributor experience. You should be able to speak concretely about hiring, coaching, and holding people accountable to deadlines and quality.
  • Experience managing a high-volume, deadline-driven production environment
  • Proven ability to prioritize and delegate based on urgency, capacity, and impact
  • Experience building or improving workflows, SOPs, or production processes
  • Strong communication, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills
  • Comfort making fast decisions without sacrificing quality standards
  • Proficiency with task/project management systems (e.g., Asana, Trello, or similar)

Department-specific (varies by team)

  • Video Editing / Graphic Design: Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator) and a strong grasp of visual storytelling and brand consistency
  • Email & Database: Familiarity with CRM/ESP platforms, database hygiene, and campaign workflows
  • Social Media: Understanding of platform-specific content strategy, scheduling tools, and engagement metrics
  • Website Development: Working knowledge of CMS platforms and front-end troubleshooting

A note for applicants: If your background is strong on the technical/creative side but light on formally leading a team (managing people's performance, schedules, and development — not just producing your own work), this likely isn't the right fit yet. We're specifically looking for people who have already done the people-management part.

Preferred

  • Experience managing a remote or distributed team
  • Familiarity with AI-powered tools and workflow automation relevant to your department
  • Experience in the real estate marketing space

Benefits

  • A supportive, fast-moving team culture

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: In-Home Physician Full Time - Madison Job Location: Work at Home, Wisconsin, United States Job Location Type: Remote Job Contract Type: Full time Job Seniority Level: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience.
jobs.description:
Job Title: In-Home Physician Full Time - Madison

Job Location: Work at Home, Wisconsin, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Annual CEU allowance

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

40

Time Type

Full time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$174,070.00 - $374,920.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 12/31/2026

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Indianapolis

Job Location: Work at Home, Indiana, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Anticipated Weekly Hours

29.5

Time Type

Part time

Pay Range

The typical pay range for this role is:

$105.00 - $105.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

Great benefits for great people

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. Depending on hours worked and eligibility, the benefits for this position include dental, vision, wellness resources, employee discounts, access to certain voluntary benefits, and other programs.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

You’ll collaborate with a cross-functional team on large-scale initiatives that deliver high-impact solutions and shape the future of our prime brokerage experience.

Our engineers take pride not just in the value we provide our customers but also in the quality of our work. to succeed.

You are eager to apply technical skills, learn advanced Data & AI patterns, and support delivery teams in designing and implementing modern data and AI solutions.

The Work (What You Will Do)

As a GCP Senior Data Engineer, you will help deliver data modernization, analytics, and AI solutions on GCP. You will support architecture design, build data pipelines and models, perform analysis, and contribute to technical implementations under guidance from senior team members.


1. Hands-On Technical Delivery

  • Build data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and integrations using GCP services such as: BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage
  • Assist with data modeling, performance tuning, and query optimization in BigQuery.
  • Implement data ingestion patterns for batch and streaming data sources.

    Vertex AI, Gemini Foundation Models, Gemini Enterprise, Model APIs & Embeddings
  • Implement ML pipelines and help establish MLOps processes (monitoring, retraining, deployment).

  • Contribute to model testing, validation, and documentation.

3. Requirements Gathering & Client Collaboration

  • Participate in client workshops to understand data needs, use cases, and technical requirements.
  • Help translate functional requirements into technical tasks and implementation plans.
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and insights to project leads and client stakeholders.

4. Data Governance, Quality & Security Support

  • Implement metadata management, data quality checks, and lineage tracking using GCP tools (Dataplex, IAM).
  • Follow best practices for security, identity management, and compliance.
  • Support operational processes for data validation, testing, and monitoring.

5. Continuous Learning & Team Support

  • Learn and apply GCP Data & AI best practices across architectural patterns, engineering standards, and AI frameworks.
  • Collaborate closely with senior data engineers, ML engineers, and architects.
  • Contribute to internal accelerators, documentation, and reusable components.
  • Stay current with GCP releases, Gemini model updates, and modern engineering practices.


Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here's what you need

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Data Analytics, ML Engineering, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 4 years of practical experience with Google Cloud Platform.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience with SQL, data modeling, and building data pipelines.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with Python or AI or GenAI tools (Vertex AI preferred).
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus point if you have

  • Experience with GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, and Looker.
  • Exposure to AI/ML development or experimentation with Vertex AI, Gemini models, embeddings, or RAG patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, Git, or cloud-native engineering practices.

Job highlights The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.   • Conduct virtual visits as needed
  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)
A Note on Our Work Environment: As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants. Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health “Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD “The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

Job Title: Medical Educator - Romandie

Medical Educator - Romandie

Abbott Diabetes Care est un leader mondial dans le domaine de la gestion du diabète et s’engage à permettre aux personnes atteintes de diabète de mener une vie plus saine et plus épanouie. Grâce à une innovation continue et à un engagement constant envers la qualité, Abbott propose des systèmes de surveillance du glucose de pointe, notamment la célèbre gamme de produits FreeStyle Libre™. Ces produits fournissent des valeurs de glucose précises et fiables et aident les patients ainsi que les professionnels de santé à mieux gérer le diabète.

La mission d’Abbott est de faire progresser en permanence la prise en charge du diabète grâce à des technologies innovantes et à un accompagnement durable, pour obtenir les meilleurs résultats de santé possibles à l’échelle mondiale.

Le/la Medical Educator est un poste terrain, orienté vers les professionnels de santé (HCPs), au sein d’Abbott Diabetes Care en Suisse. Sa mission principale consiste à fournir une expertise médico-scientifique en diabétologie et à assurer des formations médicales de haute qualité sur les technologies de surveillance du glucose par capteur (FreeStyle Libre™) en Suisse.

L’objectif central du poste est de soutenir les équipes de traitement du diabète afin qu’elles puissent tirer pleinement parti des systèmes CGM pour leurs populations de patients. Le rôle inclut également la transmission crédible d’informations scientifiques ainsi que le dialogue professionnel avec les acteurs de santé dans la zone géographique attribuée.

Le poste requiert une collaboration étroite et conforme avec les équipes commerciales, tout en garantissant une indépendance médicale totale et une intégrité scientifique maximale.

Vos responsabilités

  • Fournir une expertise médico-scientifique en diabétologie pour soutenir les produits FreeStyle Libre™ en Suisse ; collaborer de manière transversale pour développer, aligner et mettre en œuvre des stratégies et programmes au niveau des clients dans votre secteur
  • Créer et présenter des exposés scientifiques et médicaux destinés aux professionnel·le·s de santé , individuellement ou en groupe, en présentiel, en ligne ou sous forme enregistrée
  • Effectuer des visites terrain auprès des HCPs et échanger sur des sujets médico-scientifiques pertinents sur la base des données scientifiques disponibles
  • Planifier, coordonner et animer des programmes internes de formation et de perfectionnement sur des sujets médico-scientifiques
  • Réaliser des tâches médico-scientifiques internes (par ex. validations, évaluations de Fair Market Value, activités CRM B2B) ainsi qu’un support administratif
  • Développer et entretenir un réseau comprenant sociétés savantes, leaders d’opinion (KOLs), médecins et autres professionnel·le·s de santé pertinents
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Medical Affairs d’ADC en DACH, EMEAP et au niveau global
  • Organiser des programmes médico-scientifiques pour des congrès locaux, y compris la réalisation de présentations spécialisées
  • Soutenir la sélection et la mise en œuvre d’éléments et d’événements spécifiques de la FreeStyle Academy™

Vos qualifications

  • Professionnel de santé reconnu (par ex. éducateur en diabète, diététicien ou médecin) avec une solide expérience clinique dans la prise en charge des personnes atteintes de diabète
  • Expérience dans l’industrie pharmaceutique ou des dispositifs médicaux
  • Réseau établi dans le domaine de la diabétologie en Suisse
  • Capacité démontrée à travailler de manière proactive et orientée solutions
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et en gestion de projet
  • Forte aisance digitale et compréhension technique
  • Esprit d’équipe associé à créativité et autonomie
  • Capacité à collaborer de manière transversale et à évoluer efficacement dans une organisation matricielle
  • Maîtrise du français, de l’allemand et de l’anglais (selon la région), l’italien étant un atout
  • Forte mobilité (environ 80 %, poste terrain)

Poursuivez vos objectifs de carrière chez Abbott et découvrez de nombreuses opportunités au sein d’une entreprise qui peut vous aider à construire votre avenir et à vivre pleinement votre vie. US-Based Staff Veterinarian

Location: Remote, United States

Position Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Expected Commitment: ~ 40 hours per week

About Vetster & The Role

Vetster expands access to veterinary care by connecting pet owners with licensed veterinarians through a digital platform that supports professional veterinary advice, diagnoses, treatment, and prescriptions.

Vetster is seeking an experienced Staff Veterinarian to provide high-quality virtual veterinary care through the Vetster platform. This is a primarily clinical, fully remote 1099 contractor role. The Staff Veterinarian will maintain a consistent virtual appointment caseload, including Vetster marketplace appointments and consultations involving animals cared for through retail and strategic partnerships. In addition to scheduled appointments, the role includes continuity-of-care responsibilities, collaboration with Vetster’s RVT team, and clinical input across other internal teams.

What You’ll Do

Provide Virtual Veterinary Care to Clients

  • Provide virtual assessments, treatment recommendations, and prescriptions within applicable regulatory requirements through the Vetster platform.
  • Identify cases requiring emergency or specialty care and recommend escalation.

Continuity of Care

  • Serve as an Assigned Continuing Veterinarian when the originating Marketplace Veterinarian is unavailable, in accordance with applicable VCPR requirements.
  • Review medical records and support continuity-of-care needs, including:
    • Prescription renewals and fulfillment inquiries
    • Follow-up questions related to established treatment plans
  • Collaborate with the RVT team on escalated cases and cases requiring further review.

Clinical Expertise

  • Provide practical clinical feedback to Product, Engineering, Operations, and other Vetster teams regarding workflows that affect veterinary care.
  • Maintain knowledge of applicable state veterinary telemedicine laws, proposed legislative changes, VCPR requirements, and relevant regulatory changes.

Education & External Engagement

As mutually agreed upon and based on availability, the Staff Veterinarian may also:

  • Participate in media, PR, and industry events.
  • Contribute to educational content for pet owners and veterinarians.

Schedule & Caseload

This role requires an expected commitment of approximately 40 hours per week, inclusive of scheduled appointments, medical records, administrative time, continuity-of-care activities, internal meetings, and clinical follow-up.

  • Appointments with clients are scheduled in 20-minute increments.
  • The anticipated average caseload is approximately 12–16 appointments per day.
  • Appointments are generally scheduled consecutively (varies by demand), with protected time given for meal breaks, medical records, and administrative responsibilities.
  • Veterinarians have flexibility in establishing their schedule while also maintaining consistent Monday through Friday weekday availability.
  • No routine nights, holidays, or on-call responsibilities are expected.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years companion animal clinical experience with a DVM or VMD degree.
  • Active veterinary licensure in good standing within the United States (preference of licensure in Florida, California, Arizona, and/or Ohio).
  • Willingness and ability to obtain additional state licenses.
  • Strong clinical judgment and ability to determine when virtual care is appropriate.
  • Excellent written & verbal communication skills
  • Strong medical record and documentation ability
  • Ability to collaborate with veterinarians, RVTs, and cross-functional teams.

Previous experience in veterinary telemedicine or multi-state practice is considered an asset.

Licensure & Professional Expenses

Vetster will cover veterinary licenses and license renewals required for the role.

The Contractor is responsible for:

  • Continuing education expenses.
  • Maintaining personal professional liability insurance.
  • Any professional association memberships and associated dues.
  • Other individual professional expenses unless otherwise agreed upon.

Remote Work & Travel

The veterinarian is responsible for providing and maintaining the equipment, internet access, audiovisual technology, and private workspace needed to perform the role.

Quarterly travel within Canada and/or the continental United States is expected. Vetster will cover or reimburse reasonable expenses associated with required business travel.

Monthly Contract Compensation

We offer a retainer of $10,500 - $11,050 per month. This is based on experience, qualifications, and applicable state licensure(s). This represents an annualized contract value of approximately $126,000 - $132,600.

The Contractor is responsible for applicable federal, state, and local taxes and other obligations associated with independent contractor status.

Why Join Vetster?

  • Fully remote veterinary practice with flexible scheduling
  • No routine nights, holidays, or on-call responsibilities
  • Protected medical record and administrative time
  • Vetster-paid required veterinary licenses and renewals
  • Predictable clinical caseload
  • Quarterly company-paid travel
  • Opportunities to contribute to the continued growth of virtual veterinary care

Recruitment Process

Our recruitment process includes:

  • A 30-minute introductory video call with People & Culture
  • A 45-minute clinical interview with members of Vetster’s Operations and Veterinary teams
  • A 45-minute final-round interview with members of Vetster leadership

Vetster uses a third-party provider to conduct background checks following an offer

Ready to Make a Difference?

Embark on a fulfilling journey with us to shape the future of pet healthcare. If you're driven by innovation, collaboration, and a love for pets, apply now to join our mission-driven team.

Accommodations

Vetster welcomes and encourages applications from everyone! We are committed to accommodating candidates in ways that will make them comfortable and successful throughout the hiring process - both physically and mentally. These accommodations are available at every stage of the application process upon request.

AI Use Statement

For this role, we will use AI screening in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) to identify keywords and minimum qualifications as well as note-taking in interviews. These tools will assist us in pinpointing qualified candidates and moving the recruitment process along at a progressive pace. If you have any questions about our use of AI, please reach out to us.

Salary: $126,000-$132,600 USD

jobs.description:
A Dito é uma empresa de tecnologia que nasceu em 2008 em meio à atmosfera de inovação do San Pedro Valley, em Belo Horizonte. O objetivo da nossa plataforma é otimizar o relacionamento entre as empresas e seus clientes, com soluções personalizadas, aproximando os consumidores de suas reais necessidades de maneira inteligente, segmentada por meio de diversos canais.

Desde 2017, somos honrados como uma Excelente Empresa para Trabalhar, de acordo com o Great Place to Work®, e esse reconhecimento é, sem dúvidas, devido ao que mais valorizamos por aqui: as PESSOAS!

Quer fazer parte dessa trajetória? Vem ser FERA! Mas afinal, o que é ser FERA?

Ser FERA significa:

  • Absorver e propagar a cultura e os valores da Dito: pega e Faz, com foco e planejamento; age com Ética e transparência; se preocupa com o Resultado do cliente; trabalha com Alegria e sede por Aprender.

  • Agir sob a orientação de metas e dados, sempre com foco na excelência dos resultados dos nossos clientes e no bem-estar das pessoas que tornam isso possível.

  • Interagir, colaborar, usar e aprender, independentemente dos cargos ou das áreas. No mercado, estreitamos desvios e conectamos pessoas. Dentro da empresa não poderia ser diferente. Na Dito, as pessoas torcem umas pelas outras.

  • Compreender, respeitar e admirar as diferenças, transformar as oportunidades de enxergar o mundo a partir de perspectivas diferentes daquelas que já conhecemos.

  • Trabalhar com leveza e equilíbrio, valorizando o próprio bem-estar e, claro, o das outras pessoas.

Por que estamos criando um banco de talentos para Pessoas Negras?

A Dito é uma empresa comprometida com a promoção da diversidade, equidade e inclusão. Nosso time só é tão FERA pois incorporamos as diferenças e buscamos construir um ambiente de acolhimento, pluralidade e respeito às singularidades para que todas as pessoas se sintam livres para serem elas mesmas.

Sabemos que esse é apenas o início de nossa jornada, e estamos engajados no propósito de aumentar a representatividade de pessoas negras no time de FERAs. Por isso, este banco é exclusivo para pessoas pertencentes a essa comunidade.

Valorizamos pessoas que tenham o pega e Faz com Foco e planejamento na veia, que prezem pela Ética e transparência, tenham foco nos Resultados dos clientes, trabalhem com Alegria e sede por Aprender. Então, se você se encaixa e acredita que estes valores fazem a diferença, nós estamos buscando justamente por você!

Quem pode se inscrever?

Sabemos que ainda estamos muito distantes de ter uma sociedade igualitária e com oportunidades iguais para todos e que pessoas negras enfrentam uma forte desigualdade no mercado de trabalho e por esta razão criamos este espaço.

Por isso, se você se identifica como uma pessoa negra, candidate-se e #VemSerFERA!

Nossos benefícios:

  • Dito Flex - VR e VA flexíveis pagos no cartão Caju (você escolhe como usar seu saldo de acordo com suas necessidades e preferência);
  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil com abrangência nacional, sem coparticipação e com inclusão de dependentes (filhos e cônjuges);

  • Auxílio escritório, para ajudar a custear parte dos gastos gerados pelo trabalho remoto;

  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) com planos variados, inclusive um grátis;
  • Parceria com o Sesc, com descontos em serviços de educação, saúde, cultura, esporte, turismo, lazer e assistência;
  • Licenças maternidade e paternidade estendidas, válidas também para casos de adoção e guarda judicial. Durante esse período, a pessoa continua recebendo o VA/VR.

Outras vantagens que tornam a Dito um lugar especial ❤️:

  • Carga horária de 40 horas semanais com horários flexíveis de verdade;
  • Total liberdade de estilo, nada de dress code por aqui;
  • Diversos incentivos ao aprendizado (em participação em cursos, eventos, talks e meetups, compra de livros, biblioteca interna, entre outros);
  • Lanches, games e fliperama à vontade no escritório para relaxar durante os intervalos;
  • Convênios e descontos em vários restaurantes, academias, instituições de ensino, escolas de idiomas, entre outros;
  • Confraternizações constantes e eventos de integração entre equipes para proporcionar novas associações e amizades;
  • Falando em equipes, nossos times de futebol (feminino e masculino), batem um bolão;
  • Para quem não vive sem música, temos uma banda de FERAs!
  • Comitês internos de diversidade que realizam eventos direcionados, debates, aprendizados e iniciativas de conscientização e inclusão de grupos minorizados.

A Dito é uma empresa que respeita e apoia a diversidade e a inclusão. Portanto, não fazemos diferenciação de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, religião ou deficiência. Nosso time só é tão FERA pois incorporamos as diferenças.

Se você gostou do que leu, encontrou uma oportunidade com o seu perfil e quer fazer parte de uma Excelente Empresas para Trabalhar, de acordo com o Great Place to Work®, inscreva-se agora mesmo para ter uma chance de se juntar a nós! Caso você dê match com alguma das nossas oportunidades, entraremos em contato =).

In joining our team, you can expect to be working on challenging IAM projects across a wide range of global clients and industries. The nature of projects will be diverse and will vary across the categories of advisory, assurance, managed services, and system implementation. Whilst being actively engaged in solving business problems, our core practice remains specialised in technical solutions for our clients.

About You

We are looking for an independent, pro-active, and ambitious individual who is committed to making a meaningful contribution to Turnkey. A highly experienced individual who can help us continue the growth of our IAM practice, partnerships with the respective IAM vendors and relationships with our clients, whilst being able to help us deliver successful projects across our global clients.

The candidate will be part of our IAM delivery team, utilising their strong technical experience to implement IAM solutions that best fit our clients’ needs.

We are looking for a driven individual with at least three years’ practical experience in delivering and providing engineering/consulting services on SailPoint IIQ/IDN Projects within the Identity & Access Management domain to join our team as a Senior Consultant (SC).The successful candidate will have a high level of technical ability, and a good understanding of business and strategic needs and challenges, enabling them to ensure design and delivery of the best technical solutions every time.

The ideal candidate will be a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in designing and delivering identity and access management solutions, across some of the following areas:

  1. Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)
  2. Identity Management (IDM)
  3. Ideally with good conceptual/practical knowledge of:
  • Access Management (inc. Single Sign-On (SSO)/Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)/Password-less Authentication)
  • Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  • Consumer Identity (CIAM)

The key technologies we are looking for experience in are:

  • SailPoint IIQ/IDN
  • Optionally any skill in the following technologies would be favourable, but not essential:
  • Okta, CyberArk, SAP IDM, Micro Focus, Thychotic
  • Knowledge of integrations of SailPoint with SAP, HYPR, Okta, CyberArk, ServiceNow will also be an advantage, but not mandatory.

We are looking ideally for someone with the following attributes:

  • 3+ years of professional work experience as an IAM consultant, with a proven track record of delivering projects
  • Background in both delivering and working with major IAM vendors, specifically:
  • 3+ years in delivering SailPoint IIQ/IDN technologies
  • Optionally, a nice-to-have would be experience in integrating with other IAM technologies, such as Okta/Cyber Ark (PAM)/ServiceNow/SAP technologies
  • Working both as part of a team, or individually, and familiar with the relevant non-technical project activities (i.e., project planning, stakeholder management, change management, schedule management, quality assurance, etc)
  • Detailed understanding of business processes and how they contribute to enterprise risks
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to act as an SME to install, design, engineer and configure IAM solutions to meet the client need
  • Detailed understanding of risk and control principles and how processes are implemented and improved in an IAM system (e.g., JML, PAM, Access Request, Access Review, Adaptive Risk, RBAC, SSO, MFA, etc.)
  • Ability to work with a client, as part of a team to deliver an IAM solution across all aspects of the SDLC (Analyse, Design, Develop/Configure, Test, Deploy, Document)
  • Understanding of regulatory frameworks, and their application to IAM, e.g. SOx, ISO27001, NIST, HIPAA, GDPR, PSD2, etc.
  • Ideally, an Education in Business, IT, IT security or related field
  • Ability to effectively manage own time and priorities effectively

The following attributes, while not mandatory, will be advantageous:

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, ITIL, etc.
  • Product certifications from SailPoint, or other IAM vendors such as Okta or CyberArk
  • Experience of working within a team to help develop a client IAM strategy
  • Experience of working in professional services consulting, ideally experience with the ‘Big-4’ or similar
  • Understanding of and experience in developing solutions using one or more of the following languages: XML; JavaScript; Bean Shell; or other languages
  • Understanding of the following concepts/technologies: LDAP; FIDO; SAML; OAUTH; Active Directory; Linux; Databases (SQL/JDBC); Networking (including High Availability, Fault Tolerance, etc), Virtualisation technology
  • Architecture experience, or certification, (e.g. TOGAF)
  • Implementation and project methodologies (e.g. PRINCE2/AGILE)

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Working as part of a team to deliver large/complex IAM implementations across varying project delivery methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Design thinking)
  • Work with clients to understand their requirements and configure solutions to best fit those needs
  • Work with our clients and senior team to help design and define strategies, business cases, and provide RFP support, when needed.
  • The main part of this role will be working as part of our SailPoint Delivery Team, to Design, Develop/Configure and Implement IAM Solutions Sets – this will predominantly be SailPoint IIQ/IDN
  • The expectation will be that you are highly skilled in the design and configuration of SailPoint capabilities (e.g., Life Cycle Management, Application Onboarding, Workflows, Provisioning, Access Review, Reports, Roles, SoDs, etc.)
  • NOTE: Where some experience in SailPoint capabilities may need improving, or keeping up to date, e.g. Role Mining, AI, ML, etc. or additional training/certifications are required, we will provide full training and certification paths.
  • We will also provide training and certifications in other technologies such as Okta, CyberArk, HYPR, ServiceNow, as per requirement or as part of your development.
  • When appropriate, assist in our ability to provide support related services to our existing Managed Service Clients
  • Advise clients on controls relating to regulatory or legislative compliance, e.g. SOX; GDPR; PSD2 etc.
  • Review and advise on security design and remediation projects
  • Build and maintain good relationships with our client project team resources
  • Develop and maintain relationships with third parties and vendors, e.g. SailPoint, SAP, ServiceNow, Microsoft to enhance the relationship with Turnkey and deliver value to our clients
  • Provide SME knowledge to junior members of the team and provide knowledge transfer activities as part of our training initiatives
  • Work with the IAM team to develop internal tools, innovative new propositions and on R&D projects
  • When needed, work alongside our Sales, Marketing & Innovation team to provide materials/Pre-Sales support for sales activities
  • Writing and reviewing reports and other client-facing deliverables, to a high standard
  • Striving for continuous development of team and self
  • Assisting with thought leadership activities, where appropriate

Senior Software Engineer, Engineering (Full-stack)

Full-Time, Remote / Salary, Exempt

Includes Exceptional Benefits, Flexible PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

Steno is growing! We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our winning team, which is revolutionizing the court reporting industry every single day. We’re a diverse team from all over the country (and beyond) and we’re crazy about redefining the boundaries of an outdated industry.

If you are enthusiastic about joining an engineering culture that has a spirit of continuous improvement in all aspects of building products - come join us!

Who are you?

We’re looking for a self-starter who is effective in managing their time in remote working environments. If you love solving problems and collaborating with others to solve those problems then this role is for you!

This is a fast-paced environment, but an amazing opportunity for someone who wants to join a growing tech team at a mid-stage start-up and have a direct impact on building and enhancing our products!

On a regular basis you will

  • Participate in hands-on software development, where you can apply your skills, knowledge and previous experiences
  • Design and implement technical solutions
  • Build and refine engineering team processes and best practices based on project experiences
  • Mentor less experienced engineers on the team, providing guidance and technical expertise

You’re gonna crush it if

  • You love solving problems and collaborating with others to solve those problems
  • You've become familiar with the downsides of both under-engineering and over-engineering, and developed an appreciation for working pragmatically
  • You seek clarity, and as much simplicity as the underlying problem domain will allow
  • You are well organized, able to manage time effectively, and comfortable working through sometimes incomplete designs and product specs
  • You're enthusiastic about defining and cultivating a product-oriented engineering culture that instills a spirit of continuous improvement in all aspects of building products
  • You are humble and recognize no one or system is perfect and you see mistakes being made as an opportunity for improvement
  • You are not easily flustered if someone takes a different approach to solving the same problem

Some requirements:

  • You have extensive experience with git, a high-level programming language (preferably a statically-typed language or JavaScript), and at least one kind of relational database
    • Familiarity with our stack - Node.js with Typescript, React.js front-end, and PostgreSQL
  • You are familiar with unit and integration testing and have put them into practice
  • You have exposure to different software architectures (n-tier, monolithic, distributed, etc)
  • You have exposure to cloud infrastructure and/or cloud based CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering well-engineered products with modern technologies for a variety of domains
  • You have an understanding of web app fundamentals up and down the stack, from pixels to queries and everything in between
  • At least 5 years of development experience
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience
  • Bonus points if you have worked in one or more early-stage startups!

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary - $175k-$215k in base salary, plus a yearly discretionary bonus based on goals set by your manager
  • Health, Vision, & Dental Benefits - low-cost health plans that free up mind space and unlock our employees' best work
  • Wellness/Mental Health - shared benefits to be used among employees and families
  • Flexible Paid Time Off - allowing employees to find balance in their lives
  • Options of Equity - we know our success is nothing without our team
  • Access to a company-provided 401(k) account
  • A home office setup and a monthly stipend to offset internet and phone costs

Our Team

Our Tech Team is a small, highly reliable, constantly innovative team. It is composed of Engineering, QA, Design, Data, and Product. Instead of being siloed, Eng and QA work hand-in-hand with Product and Design for execution of new ideas and solutions. Our Eng team includes people from all levels of seniority and with a variety of backgrounds, from Fortune 500 to startups to FinTech to bootcamps.

Our team is also humble, and each individual recognizes that no one or one system is perfect; we see errors as an opportunity for improvement!

Still, we never disclose or sell your personal information.
