jobs.excerpt: Lead AI Engineer — Bridge-it AI Team Location: Remote Experience: 4–8 years in industry Team: AI Platform (Copilot) About Bridge-itBridge-it is an early-stage EdTech company building a career-readiness platform for K-12 students, counselors, and districts.
jobs.description:
Lead AI Engineer — Bridge-it AI Team

Location: Remote

Experience: 4–8 years in industry

Team: AI Platform (Copilot)

About Bridge-it

Bridge-it is an early-stage EdTech company building a career-readiness platform for K-12 students, counselors, and districts. Students explore careers, colleges, and non-college pathways; build multi-year plans; and get guidance from an AI Copilot that is grounded in their own plans, school data, and a curated knowledge base. Counselors use the same platform to supervise, nudge, and intervene at scale.

The AI Copilot is the heart of the product — a production LangGraph-based agentic system serving real students, where being right matters more than being fluent. We hold ourselves to strict grounding, safety, and tenant-isolation standards, and we measure everything.

About the role

You will join a small AI team that owns the Copilot end to end: the agentic orchestration graph, retrieval and grounding, safety guardrails, response contracts with the frontend, and the evaluation platform that keeps it honest. We are mid-flight on an ambitious redesign — collapsing multiple experimental graph variants into a single workflow-first architecture with typed claim verification, constitutional rules, and per-turn decision records — and you would step directly into that work.

This is a senior role with a visible leadership runway. Beyond writing excellent code, we expect you to analyze ambiguous product requirements, turn them into well-scoped technical specs and tickets, distribute work across the team, and communicate trade-offs clearly to product and leadership. For the right person, this role grows into a techno-management position.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and operate agentic LLM workflows in LangGraph — routing, planning, parallel retrieval, tool execution, verification, and streaming — serving live student and counselor traffic over WebSockets.
  • Own RAG quality: multi-source retrieval across vector stores (Milvus, pgvector), a knowledge graph (Neo4j), and structured platform data; chunking strategy; reranking; and grounded generation with typed claims and evidence citation.
  • Enforce safety and trust: input/output guardrails, constitutional rules, faithfulness verification, abstain/escalate behavior, and strict multi-tenant data isolation.
  • Build and extend our evaluation platform: online LLM-as-judge evaluators, offline regression suites on curated datasets (LangSmith), latency baselines, and A/B experimentation (PostHog feature flags).
  • Drive latency and cost optimization: model selection across providers (OpenAI, Gemini, open-weight models via OpenRouter), prompt and context engineering, selective retrieval, caching, and streaming intermediate responses.
  • Instrument and debug production behavior with LangSmith tracing, OpenTelemetry, New Relic, and Sentry; treat live-QA findings as first-class inputs to design.
  • Partner with backend (Django/Postgres), frontend (Next.js), and product teams on response envelopes, interaction contracts, and rollout plans.
  • Lead by doing: break epics into staged implementation plans with acceptance criteria, sequence work across engineers, review code, and mentor teammates.

What we're looking for (required)

  • 4–8 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2–5 years building LLM-powered products in production (not just prototypes or notebooks) and 2 years of leading a team.
  • Strong Python engineering fundamentals — typing, testing, async, service design.
  • Strong grasp of agentic architecture patterns — supervisor/executor splits, planner–retriever–verifier pipelines, tool/capability registries, routing and fallback tiers — and sound judgment about when a workflow should be deterministic versus agentic.
  • Hands-on experience with agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph strongly preferred; LangChain, or comparable state-machine/agent frameworks acceptable) including multi-step graphs, tool calling, and streaming.
  • Context engineering / harness engineering: deliberate construction of what the model sees each turn — context budgets, retrieval selection, system-prompt and tool-schema design, structured state passed between nodes — and the harness discipline (contracts, guards, fallbacks) that makes model behavior predictable.
  • Experience designing and optimizing agent memory: short-term conversation state (windowing, summarization/compaction, token-budget management) and long-term memory (user profiles, episodic stores, rollups) with sensible retrieval and staleness policies.
  • Deep practical knowledge of RAG systems: embedding models, vector databases (Milvus/Zilliz, pgvector, or similar), hybrid retrieval, rerankers (e.g., Cohere), chunking and knowledge-base design.
  • Proven experience building and operating LLM evaluation systems: online evaluators (LLM-as-judge) on live traffic, offline golden datasets and regression suites, faithfulness/hallucination and groundedness metrics, A/B experiment design — and the discipline to gate releases on eval results.
  • Hands-on AI observability: end-to-end trace instrumentation of agent runs (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, or similar), per-node latency/token/cost tracking, trajectory analysis, drift and quality-regression monitoring, and turning production traces into eval datasets and fixes.
  • Experience shipping structured outputs (JSON contracts, schema-validated responses) as the interface between models and product surfaces.
  • Comfort with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred: Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GCS, BigQuery).
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills: you can explain a retrieval-quality trade-off to a product manager, write a spec another engineer can execute, and disagree constructively.
  • Demonstrated ability in requirement analysis and task decomposition — turning fuzzy asks into staged, dependency-ordered work — and willingness to step up into team-lead responsibilities.

Desirable

  • Experience at an early-stage startup — comfort with ambiguity, wearing multiple hats, and shipping under constraints.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP): working knowledge of the spec and hands-on experience building or integrating MCP servers/clients to expose tools and data to agents.
  • Knowledge graphs (Neo4j/Cypher) in retrieval or recommendation contexts.
  • Durable workflow engines (Temporal) and event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub).
  • Multi-tenant SaaS security models (row-level tenancy, FERPA/COPPA-adjacent compliance awareness).
  • EdTech or other regulated/high-trust consumer domains.

Nice to have

  • AI infrastructure: model serving, GPU inference, gateway/router layers, and cost/latency-aware routing across providers.
  • SLMs and self-hosted LLMs: deploying and operating small language models or open-weight LLMs (vLLM, TGI, Ollama, or similar), quantization, fine-tuning/distillation for task-specific workloads, and knowing when a small model beats an API call.
  • Traditional ML: classification, ranking, embedding fine-tuning; scikit-learn/PyTorch.
  • Recommender systems: candidate generation + ranking pipelines, personalization.
  • Forecasting and data analytics: time-series methods, cohort analysis, product analytics.
  • Big data processing/streaming: BigQuery at scale, Spark/Flink/Kafka or Pub/Sub streaming pipelines, dbt-style transformation workflows.

Our stack (so you know what you're signing up for)

Python · LangGraph/LangChain · OpenAI + Gemini + open-weight models (OpenRouter) · Milvus/Zilliz · pgvector · Neo4j · Cohere reranking · LangSmith · Django + PostgreSQL · Temporal · GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, GCS, BigQuery) · PostHog · OpenTelemetry/New Relic/Sentry · Next.js frontend over a WebSocket streaming protocol.

Bridge-it is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive, respectful remote-first workplace.

jobs.description:
The Value Builder Role at Exelab

Exelab builds custom, AI-powered solutions, each one tailor-made to a client's specific business objective. We run every engagement like a small product effort: we start from a real problem and craft a solution to move a real metric (revenue, efficiency, conversion, retention). We work in small, tight teams, close to the client's business, and we use AI directly in how we design and build. What matters to us is the impact we create for clients.

The Value Builder does what a Product Builder does, and leads a team while doing it. On our larger engagements, the ones that need a team, the Value Builder designs the solution, builds where it counts, and guides the small group that ships it. Working with our revenue team to shape the direction that creates value for the client, the Value Builder owns bringing it to life: on scope, on budget, on time, at quality. It is a builder's role first, with leadership alongside it, leading by doing and by clarity.

Key Responsibilities

The Value Builder owns the outcome of a larger engagement and leads the team that delivers it. The core responsibilities:

  • Own the outcome end to end: Take the direction shaped with the revenue team and be accountable for the result: a solution that answers the need, within scope, budget, and time. The Value Builder owns the how and the quality.

  • Design, and build where it counts: Design the solution and stay hands-on enough to make excellent calls and to prototype, putting hands where they add the most value and delegating the rest.

  • Lead the team that ships: Guide a small delivery team (a Solution Architect and specialists) to the result. Set clear goals, keep everyone on the rails, unblock, and hold the quality bar, leading by clarity and example.

  • Keep it grounded in the real need: Stay close to what the client actually needs and make sure the team builds to that, catching drift early.

  • Make it hold up: Put the work in front of real usage, find what falls short, and drive it to a product that does the job well.

In summary, the Value Builder is a maker who leads: product judgment and the ability to build, plus the leadership to bring a team to a real result. It is the role for someone who has shipped their own work and taken teams through complex delivery.

Requirements

Ideal Candidate Profile

Our ideal Value Builder has the Product Builder core and has led teams to deliver. There is no need to match every line: the essentials are a record of building and shipping, and of leading delivery.

  • A track record of shipping: Products or tools they personally built and put in front of users (side-projects count). We ask to see something they made.

  • Building with AI, and product judgment: They can turn a direction into a working product and make pragmatic calls on how to build it well.

  • Team leadership with results: They have taken complex projects home with a small team, on time, on budget, with a happy client, leading by clarity and example.

  • Learning agility: Every engagement is different; they get competent quickly and they are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • Practical: Native or C2-level Italian, and based in Italy. We value a track record of delivery and the things they have built.

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need:

As a Cloud Ops Engineer on our ELN Platform Cloud Operations team, you will help build, operate and improve robust, scalable and secure AWS-based infrastructure that enables engineering teams to build, deploy and operate their services effectively. You’ll work closely with engineering, security and DevOps teams to improve platform reliability, automation and operational efficiency.

In this role you'll get to:

  • Build and Maintain Cloud Infrastructure: Help develop and maintain highly available, secure and scalable AWS-based infrastructure supporting multiple products and services.

  • Enhance Platform Reliability: Contribute to observability, monitoring and incident response practices to maintain reliable and resilient services.

We're looking for people who have:

Around 4+ years of experience working with cloud infrastructure and production services, ideally with hands-on experience in AWS. You’ll be comfortable working in a DevOps-focused environment, troubleshooting infrastructure and operational issues, and automating repetitive tasks. You’ll also be able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues and work collaboratively within a wider engineering team.

The key skills we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience operating production workloads in AWS, using DevOps best practices
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python (required) or a related language such as PowerShell or Bash
  • Experience working with Linux and/or Windows environments
  • Experience automating operational workloads and infrastructure on AWS
  • Experience with at least one configuration management tool, such as Ansible, Chef, Puppet or similar
  • Good Python scripting skills, with some experience in at least one of the following: .NET, Ruby, Java or PowerShell
  • Good understanding of CI/CD concepts, tools and pipeline design
  • Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments
  • Experience supporting distributed and highly available applications or services on AWS
  • Solid Linux administration skills and working knowledge of Windows systems
  • Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, load balancing and firewalls
  • Experience with or understanding of serverless architectures, such as AWS Lambda and API Gateway
  • Experience participating in peer code reviews and following software engineering best practices

jobs.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Enterprise Software Engineering team, you will design and build the applications, services, and integrations that keep Shield AI's business running – connecting the systems our engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and finance teams depend on every day. You will work primarily in C#/.NET with React on the frontend, building distributed, message-driven systems in the cloud and bringing AI capabilities into the tools our people use.

This is a hands-on, senior engineering role, where you will drive solutions from requirements, system design through deployment and support – sometimes leading a project, and at other times working closely with your teammates on a shared codebase. We move fast, so we are looking for someone who learns quickly, hits the ground running, and is comfortable making sound decisions with incomplete information.

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, and maintain enterprise applications, APIs, and services using C#/.NET and React, with Python where it is the right tool for the job.
  • Architect and implement distributed, event-driven systems using message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus, MQTT) and service frameworks such as NServiceBus or MassTransit.
  • Build reliable integrations between enterprise systems (e.g., PLM, ERP, identity, and engineering platforms), handling long-running workflows, retries, and failure recovery.
  • Apply proven system design patterns – such as Saga/process managers, outbox, CQRS, and idempotent consumers – to deliver scalable, resilient, maintainable solutions.
  • Design and integrate AI capabilities into applications, such as LLM-powered features, agents, and intelligent automation.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and review.
  • Deploy and operate services in Azure and/or AWS for our team and other teams across the business, applying sound practices for security, networking, identity, reliability, and cost.
  • Use existing CI/CD and developer platforms (GitLab, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Artifactory, SonarQube) to build, test, and ship software; contribute pipeline changes as your projects require.
  • Instrument services for observability and troubleshoot asynchronous and distributed processes in production.
  • Collaborate closely with fellow Staff engineers – contributing to design reviews, code reviews, and the team's engineering standards – and lead projects when the work calls for it.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand problems, shape requirements, and deliver solutions with measurable impact.

Required qualifications:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep expertise in C# and .NET (.NET 6+ / ASP.NET Core, an open-source web development framework | .NET Core), including building RESTful APIs, background services, and Entity Framework or similar data access.
  • Professional experience building frontends with React (TypeScript preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with messaging and event-driven architecture using RabbitMQ, Kafka, MQTT, Azure Service Bus, or similar technologies, including an understanding of delivery guarantees, ordering, retries, and dead-letter handling.
  • Strong knowledge/experience in architecting and using Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tools
  • Strong understanding of system design and architectural patterns, including distributed systems, microservices vs. modular monoliths, eventual consistency, and resiliency patterns.
  • Cloud experience is a must – preferably Azure or AWS. Solid grasp of core cloud concepts at an associate-certification level (e.g., AZ-204, AZ-104, AWS Solutions Architect – Associate, AWS Developer – Associate), including security, networking, identity and access management (IAM/RBAC), compute, storage, and managed services.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD and deployment practices – comfortable building, deploying, and troubleshooting applications through pipelines, though platform administration is not a primary responsibility.
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), including data modeling and query performance.
  • Strong experience with AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and practical judgment about how to use them effectively and safely.
  • Strong testing discipline, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment – learns new domains and technologies quickly and delivers value early.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated commitment to ownership, continuous improvement, and being a reliable, respectful team member.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience implementing the Saga pattern (orchestration and/or choreography) for long-running business processes.
  • Experience with NServiceBus and the Particular Service Platform (ServicePulse, ServiceInsight, ServiceControl), or comparable tools for monitoring and troubleshooting asynchronous, message-based systems.
  • Proficiency in Python for services, scripting, data processing, or AI/ML workloads.
  • Active Azure or AWS certification (associate level or higher).
  • Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, AKS/EKS) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep).
  • Experience with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Application Insights, Grafana, Datadog, or similar).
  • Experience integrating with enterprise identity platforms (Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect, SSO, RBAC).
  • Experience integrating enterprise business systems such as PLM (e.g., Teamcenter, Arena), ERP (e.g., Costpoint), or similar.
  • Experience developing software in a DoD, defense, or government contractor environment, including Azure Government or AWS GovCloud.
  • Familiarity with secure software development practices and frameworks such as NIST 800-218 (SSDF).
  • Experience working as a peer on a small senior team, sharing a codebase and alternating between leading and contributing to projects.

jobs.description:
About F12: F12 was built by uniting IT consulting firms across Canada with a shared vision: to reduce risk and complexity by crafting technology platforms that empower leaders to focus and thrive. We elevate IT conversations from ingredients to outcomes, delivering fully designed solutions with no bad options. If you’re looking for the fast lane into an IT career or want to supercharge your professional development, you’ve come to the right place. At F12, you’ll collaborate with a diverse team and gain exposure to technology services across countless businesses—building a resume rich with experience and accomplishments. Our mission is to elevate our employees by building and retaining an elite team of IT professionals equipped to deliver unmatched service to Canadian business leaders. We value humble service, continuous improvement, and hard work—and we’re looking for like-minded individuals to join us.

The Position: Reporting to the Enterprise Service Delivery Manager (SDM), the Enterprise Endpoint Specialist is a hands-on operational role within managed services, responsible for the day-to-day delivery of Microsoft endpoint managed services across multiple enterprise clients. The role owns investigation, recurring service execution, standard administration and remediation, ticket progression, reporting inputs, client follow-through, and evidence-based escalation across Microsoft Intune and related endpoint technologies. Endpoint and Intune remain the anchor of the role, with defined operational coverage across Azure, Azure Security, Entra, Microsoft 365, and transactional CSP. The specialist works alongside the Endpoint Solutions Architect, who provides architecture, standards, complex engineering, and advanced escalation. This role requires a working understanding of how endpoint management interacts with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint, Azure dependencies, and Microsoft 365, so that issues are investigated accurately and routed to the correct technical owner. This position remains directly involved in day-to-day service delivery, including incident response, escalation handling, troubleshooting, reporting, and change execution within client-specific change controls. It is a hands-on managed-service execution role rather than an architecture, presales, or project delivery position.

Responsibilities:

Endpoint and Intune Operations

  • Operate and support Microsoft Intune across multiple managed-service clients.
  • Investigate enrollment, Autopilot, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, update policies, encryption, device security, and endpoint performance issues across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices.
  • Deploy, configure, and test mobile device management policies for iOS and Android, and support clients through rollout and ongoing policy changes.
  • Review endpoint health, operating-system currency, patch compliance, Office update status, Defender status, BitLocker status, device compliance, startup performance, and application reliability where included in client scope.
  • Perform approved standard platform changes, testing, and remediation in accordance with client-specific change controls and documented procedures.
  • Coordinate investigation and remediation of endpoint vulnerabilities, failed patches, non-compliant devices, and configuration exceptions.

Azure, Azure Security, and Entra Operations

  • Provide initial investigation and standard operational support for assigned Azure, Azure Security, and Entra requests.
  • Review relevant monitoring, resource-health, alert, access, identity, and configuration information to establish the issue, impact, and correct technical path.
  • Perform approved standard administration and remediation using documented procedures and client-specific change controls.
  • Coordinate Microsoft support cases and escalate architecture, complex engineering, security design, and material risk decisions to the Azure and Security Architect.

Modern Workplace (M365) Support

  • Investigate assigned Microsoft 365 operational requests within the team’s documented service scope.
  • Resolve standard administrative and support issues within capability and access, and escalate advanced workload-specific matters through the established Modern Workplace path.
  • Maintain ownership of ticket status, evidence, client communication, and follow-through until resolution or formal reassignment.

Transactional CSP Support

  • Execute authorized standard license transactions after training and documented client approval.
  • Initiate Microsoft support requests for eligible clients and maintain the required transaction and case records.
  • Escalate licensing advisory, pricing exceptions, renewals, non-standard commercial requests, and broader CSP matters to the responsible CSP resource.

Managed Service Delivery, Reporting, and Escalation

  • Own assigned incidents, service requests, recurring activities, and remediation actions through resolution or evidence-based escalation.
  • Prepare and validate technical inputs for recurring client service reports and operational reviews.
  • Interpret what the reporting data shows, and explain exceptions, risk, recommendations, owners, and next steps in clear business language.
  • Escalate complex cases with a clear problem statement, business impact, investigation completed, logs and evidence, changes attempted, results, and a specific request for assistance.
  • Identify when work requires architectural review, another team, or scope and commercial validation.
  • Maintain accurate technical notes, evidence, test results, client updates, and handoff information in the ticketing system.

Requirements:

  • Five or more years of relevant hands-on endpoint or Microsoft cloud operations experience, with demonstrated personal ownership of the environments you supported.
  • Hands-on experience operating Microsoft Intune in a production environment, including PowerShell scripting for remediation and automation.
  • Practical troubleshooting experience across enrollment, Autopilot, compliance, configuration profiles, application deployment and packaging, Windows updates and Autopatch, encryption, and endpoint security.
  • Hands-on experience managing macOS and mobile devices (iOS and Android) through Intune, including enrollment, policy configuration, compliance, and application management.
  • Working knowledge of Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, LAPS, and Windows Hello for Business.
  • Hands-on operational experience with Azure, Azure Security, and Entra ID, including Conditional Access, monitoring, resource health, access, and standard administration or remediation.
  • Experience owning technical tickets through investigation, remediation, stakeholder communication, escalation, and closure.
  • Ability to support multiple client environments with different scopes, configurations, access models, and approval processes.
  • Strong written documentation and the ability to communicate technical findings clearly to client and internal stakeholders.
  • Sound judgment about what sits inside a managed service, and the confidence to confirm scope before acting on requests that look like project, architecture, or out-of-scope work.
  • Post-secondary education in information technology, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to work during normal Canadian business hours and participate in occasional approved after-hours maintenance or incident activity where client scope requires it.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required client access and comply with company and client security, privacy, and change-management requirements.

Considered an Asset

  • MSP or multi-client managed-service experience.
  • Experience preparing or presenting recurring technical service reports.
  • Hands-on experience with standard Microsoft 365 tenant administration and Tier 1/2 troubleshooting.
  • Experience coordinating Microsoft support cases.
  • Relevant current certifications such as MD-102, AZ-104, SC-300, MS-102, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

Competencies:

  • Empathy-driven communication & user-centric mindset
  • Problem-solving & critical thinking
  • Detail orientation with disciplined execution
  • Ownership and follow-through on assigned work
  • Effective facilitation & consultative communication
  • Organization and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Team collaboration and willingness to share knowledge

Where Your Time Will Go: This role is built around endpoint management, with real breadth across the wider Microsoft cloud stack. The balance shifts with client demand.

  • Endpoint and Microsoft Intune operations – the core of the role and where the majority of your week is spent.
  • Azure, Azure Security, and Entra operations – a substantial second focus, working alongside our Azure and Security Architect.
  • Microsoft 365 and transactional CSP support – recurring operational work that rounds out the role and broadens your exposure across the tenant.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Contracted endpoint services are delivered consistently and on time, with clear evidence in the ticketing system.
  • Every assigned incident and request has an owner, a current status, and a defined next step, with the client kept informed throughout.
  • Routine operational work is resolved independently, and complex engineering reaches the architect with a complete technical picture.
  • Client reports are accurate, explain exceptions and risks in plain language, and lead to remediation that is tracked to closure.
  • Scope is confirmed before work is undertaken outside the managed service.

What You Can Expect from Us: We are proud of our forward-thinking, dynamic culture that champions diversity, inclusivity, and a respectful working environment. We also want to make sure that however you get IT done in all parts of your life, we’ve got your back. Our comprehensive total rewards program includes:

  • Work-Life & Growth: Three weeks vacation plus extra Flex Days, leadership development opportunities, growth coaching, and reimbursements for educational advancement and certifications.
  • Health & Financial Well-Being: Health Spending Account or RRSP matching, extended health care, dental and vision coverage, disability and life insurance, and an employee assistance program.
  • Additional Perks: Tuition reimbursement, paid time off, on-site parking, high-class office amenities, and company events.

Our Equal Opportunity Commitment:

  • F12.net practices as an equal opportunity employer in all services locations. We are committed to building and maintaining a workforce diverse in experience, skills, and knowledge. The company maintains a strict policy to ensure equal employment opportunities and do not discriminate based on any grounds and elements protected by law.
  • For those requiring assistance with disabilities, information relating to accommodation and accommodation measures addressed confidentially. Please notify us in advance if any accommodations required.

Please note that this position represents a true vacancy and we do not currently use artificial intelligence (AI) to at any stage of the hiring process to screen, assess or select candidates.

Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to take primary responsibility for maintaining and supporting our existing Virscidian product portfolio.

Our current products will remain important to customers for the next several years. During that time, they will require ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, bug fixes, customer support, and selected new features. This role is intended to provide clear technical ownership of that existing product stack while allowing other engineering resources to remain focused on our future product development.

This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone who is comfortable working with the Microsoft-based technology stack and enjoys solving practical product and customer problems. The primary focus is keeping our existing products stable, supportable, and responsive to customer and business needs. When appropriate, the engineer may also contribute to new product development, including our SaaS platform, scientific algorithms, performance improvements, and other engineering initiatives.

The ideal candidate has strong C#/.NET experience, understands desktop and server-side applications, and is comfortable working across application code, databases, APIs, deployment, and customer environments.

In this role you will get to

  • Take primary engineering ownership for the maintenance and support of existing Virscidian products.
  • Investigate and resolve software defects, production issues, and customer-reported problems.
  • Work with Support, Business Development, Product Management, and engineering teams to understand issues, priorities, and customer impact.
  • Implement new features and product enhancements on a case-by-case basis as customer and business needs evolve.
  • Maintain and enhance existing C#/.NET applications, including desktop UI (WPF, WinForms), services, Web APIs, and supporting components.
  • Work with SQL Server databases, data access layers, stored procedures, and application data models.
  • Support Azure hosted resources and existing DevOps, build, deployment, and release processes.
  • Troubleshoot issues across software, database, configuration, deployment, and customer environments.
  • Help improve the visibility and communication of product issues so priorities are clear to engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with engineers working on future products when knowledge of the existing products, workflows, or domain is needed.
  • Contribute to new product development when appropriate, including SaaS platform work, scientific algorithms, performance and scalability improvements, and related engineering efforts.

What we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced software engineer who is comfortable taking ownership of mature products and keeping them reliable for customers. This role is well suited to someone who values practical engineering, understands that established products still require active development, and is comfortable working independently across a broad technical stack.

The person should be able to investigate issues with limited initial information, communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and drive problems through to resolution.

The key skills we are looking for

  • C# / .NET: Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining applications using C# and the .NET platform.
  • Desktop Application Development: Experience maintaining Windows desktop applications and user interfaces.
  • SQL Server: Strong experience with relational databases, SQL Server, data access, troubleshooting, and performance considerations.
  • Web APIs: Experience developing and supporting REST APIs and application integrations.
  • Azure: Experience working with applications and services deployed in Microsoft Azure.
  • DevOps / Build and Release: Experience with source control, automated builds, deployment, release management, and troubleshooting deployed applications.
  • Product Maintenance: Experience supporting mature production software, including bug fixes, maintenance releases, and incremental feature development.
  • Troubleshooting: Strong analytical skills and the ability to diagnose problems across application, database, infrastructure, and customer environments.
  • Ownership: Comfortable taking responsibility for a product area, managing priorities, and following issues through to completion.
  • Communication: Ability to work directly with Support, Business Development, Product Management, developers, and other stakeholders to clearly understand and communicate technical issues.
  • Autonomy: Comfortable working independently and making practical engineering decisions within an established product architecture.
  • Collaboration: Able to work constructively with multiple engineering teams and share knowledge across existing and future product development.
  • New Product Development: Ability to contribute beyond maintenance when needed, including SaaS architecture and development, scientific and analytical algorithms, performance optimization, and scalability work.

You may also have

  • Experience with scientific or laboratory software.
  • Experience with chromatography, mass spectrometry, CDS, LIMS, ELN, or other laboratory informatics systems.
  • Experience maintaining software used in regulated or enterprise customer environments.
  • Experience with legacy or long-lived Microsoft technology stacks.
  • Experience supporting customer-specific configurations and integrations.
  • An electrical engineering, software engineering, computer science, or related technical background.

Ultimately, we are looking for someone who enjoys owning and improving established software products, solving real customer problems, and providing the engineering continuity needed to keep our current product portfolio stable and effective for the next several years, while also being able to contribute to new product development when it makes sense.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are seeking an Alliance Partner Manager to lead the technical dimension of our alliances and partnering function for Luma, our AI-Native Multimodal Research Platform for Scientific Intelligence. Sitting at the intersection of business and engineering, you'll own how our platform connects with, integrates into, and creates value alongside the products of our strategic technology partners, such as Databricks and AWS.

This position is based in EMEA, working globally across time zones, with potential future expansion of channel partnerships into NAM. It is a senior role with broad scope, where you'll act as the bridge between partner engineering teams and our own product, engineering and commercial organizations, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales, as well as colleagues at Siemens, with room to design and build the technical alliance capability around you.

While the focus is strategic, this remains a hands-on role: you'll need enough technical depth to scope integrations credibly, validate them in sandboxes, and hold your own in a conversation with a partner's engineering team. We're looking for someone with an engineering-minded, "application scientist" type approach — comfortable understanding the technical requirements involved in onboarding a partner, and operating confidently within a large company mindset and environment.

In this role you will get to:

  • Define, build, and execute the technical partner strategy, prioritising which integrations and joint solutions to build, developing and implementing joint go-to-market plans (co-sell, co-build, co-deliver), aligning teams and facilitating sales enablement and training of partners.
  • Own engineering level relationships across partner organisations through effective communication, structured governance and business reviews, and joint business planning.
  • Scope integration feasibility early in partner conversations, translating vague partner asks into clear, buildable technical specifications and setting realistic expectations.
  • Oversee solution architecture, use-case mapping, partner product certification and sandbox / proof-of-concept development to design and validate joint solutions.
  • Engage partners to develop differentiated solutions through joint collaboration, market and competitive analysis, and the creation of joint marketing collateral.
  • Evangelise partnerships internally, working closely with Sales, Legal, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Support and Pre-Sales stakeholders, and with colleagues at Siemens, feeding partner needs into the roadmap and organising collaborative events.
  • Define, track and analyse key partnership metrics, collaborating with partners to optimise performance, and represent Dotmatics/Siemens at alliance and partner conferences and events.
  • Focus specifically on systems integration partners, bringing on partners that will meaningfully increase the bottom line.

We are looking for candidate's who have 7+ years in technology partnerships, alliances, solution architecture or pre-sales engineering, including several years leading strategic technical partner or ISV relationships at enterprise scale. You've built integrations, not just managed them, and you can move fluently between a business review and a whiteboard session with a partner's engineers. You're comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy on complex, ambiguous pursuits, and you set realistic expectations that engineering can actually deliver on.

Just as importantly, you lead through influence. You can align engineering, marketing and sales teams, internally and across partner organisations, behind a shared plan without direct authority, and you're motivated by building a partnering function and team, not just running one. While not a traditional "sales" person, you're comfortable navigating sales-style conversations, combining technical knowledge with strong relationship management and communication skills.

Key Skills:

  • Technical partnership leadership - a proven track record defining and executing partner or alliance strategy with ISVs, technology platforms or system integrators, with measurable partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue impact.
  • Hands-on integration fluency, including practical depth with APIs, authentication and data-exchange patterns, and the ability to scope, spec and validate integrations through sandboxes and proof-of-concept builds.
  • Joint go-to-market execution - experience developing co-sell, co-build and co-deliver plans, aligning internal and partner teams, facilitating sales enablement and creating the collateral that makes joint solutions land.
  • Executive-level relationship management - comfort owning senior stakeholder relationships across partner organisations, running structured business reviews (QBRs), and resolving conflict constructively when internal and partner priorities clash.
  • Data-driven partner management, with the habit of defining, tracking and analysing partnership KPIs and leading indicators of partner health and acting on them before issues escalate.

You may also have:

  • Experience with cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) or OEM / embedded partnership motions.
  • Experience structuring and negotiating complex commercial and technical agreements alongside legal teams.
  • Familiarity with tiered partner certification programmes.
  • A background or interest in scientific, life-sciences or research software, or another domain-deep industry such as Oil & Gas or Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG).

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

  3. Experience developing analytical, computational, or simulation-based engineering solutions.
  4. Practical proficiency with coding agents.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist for our Integrated Risk Management team to help develop risk models and analytical frameworks that support key business decisions across credit, financial, and operational risk domains. In this role, you will work on complex quantitative challenges, build predictive and diagnostic models, and partner with stakeholders across the organization to improve risk visibility, portfolio performance, and decision-making.

Challenges that await you:

  • Develop and implement advanced statistical models for our credit portfolio at both per-account and aggregate levels to predict behavior and optimize performance
  • Create sophisticated Net Present Value (NPV) models and their core components on a per-account basis for our various credit products
  • Model critical financial metrics, including FX position, liquidity, reserves, and other balance sheet items to support robust financial management
  • Analyze and model not only expected outcomes but also their deviations, distributions, and uncertainty, recognizing the inherently probabilistic nature of financial and risk data
  • Design diagnostic and forecasting models that help identify, monitor, and mitigate risks across the organization
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to investigate model performance, understand deviations from expectations, and improve decision-making processes
  • Contribute to the development of quantitative methodologies and risk frameworks across credit, financial, and operational risk domains

What makes you a great fit:

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or a related discipline
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Quantitative Analytics, Risk Modeling, or a similar role
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, probability theory, and uncertainty quantification
  • Experience developing predictive models and working with financial, risk, or other highly stochastic datasets
  • Strong proficiency in Python or R and experience with statistical and analytical libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Statsmodels, Scikit-learn)
  • Experience with classical statistical methods, forecasting techniques, and modern machine learning approaches when appropriate
  • Experience modeling distributions, confidence intervals, and risk metrics rather than focusing solely on point estimates
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently drive analytical initiatives from problem definition to implementation
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Our ways of working:

  • Innovative Spirit: a commitment to creativity and groundbreaking solutions
  • Honest Feedback: valuing open, transparent communication
  • Supportive Team: a strong, collaborative community
  • Celebrating Achievements: recognizing our wins together
